VisionDesc.SourceString:
该物品异象状似一副由绳串联的红色拳击手套，可飘浮于空中，出拳迅速、稳健，力道通常较为微弱，不具备杀伤力。
极少数情况下，也会出现拥有实战级拳击力量的特殊个体，这一类个体则往往会以无主的姿态游荡于街头巷尾，霸占一处空旷地点独自进行着挥拳练习。
虽然目前未接到有关主动攻击市民的报告，但据说存在着挑衅或驱赶过路者的现象，对市民生活、城市设施维护等各方面构成不便。
VisionDesc.LocalizedString:
This Object Anomaly appears as a pair of red boxing gloves connected by a string, capable of floating in the air. The punches are swift and steady, but generally weak and non-lethal.
In rare cases, certain individuals of this Anomaly type can possess combat-level boxing strength. They often wander the streets to find an open area to practice their jabs alone.
Although there have been no reports of active attacks on citizens, they're said to have been spotted provoking or driving away passersby, causing inconvenience to citizens' lives and city facility maintenance.

HouseCondition.SourceString: 在擂台战斗中将其击败
HouseCondition.LocalizedString: Defeat it in a boxing match.

AnnihilateCondition.SourceString: （推测）与挑衅行为有关
AnnihilateCondition.LocalizedString: (Speculation) Related to provocative behavior.

VisionDesc.SourceString:
该物品异象状似一副由绳串联的红色拳击手套，可飘浮于空中，出拳迅速、稳健，力道通常较为微弱，不具备杀伤力。
极少数情况下，也会出现拥有实战级拳击力量的特殊个体，这一类个体则往往会以无主的姿态游荡于街头巷尾，霸占一处空旷地点独自进行着挥拳练习。
有着足以被称为「拳王」级别实力的「欧拉拳套」特殊个体，总是在寻找合格的斗士、渴求着一场真正热血偾张的擂台较量。如果有强者回应它的挑衅，并在擂台上堂堂正正取得胜利，它便会为其折服。
VisionDesc.LocalizedString:
This Object Anomaly resembles a pair of red boxing gloves connected by a string, capable of floating in the air. The punches are swift and steady, but generally weak and non-lethal.
In rare cases, certain individuals of this Anomaly type can possess combat-level boxing strength. They often wander the streets to find an open area to practice their jabs alone.
These especially strong Ora Punchers are constantly seeking capable fighters in hopes of experiencing a truly thrilling match in the ring. If someone worthy responds to its taunts and achieves victory in the ring, it gladly submits to the victor.

HouseCondition.SourceString: 在擂台战斗中将其击败
HouseCondition.LocalizedString: Defeat it in a boxing match.

AnnihilateCondition.SourceString: 关键词「胆小鬼」
AnnihilateCondition.LocalizedString: Keyword: Coward.

Content.SourceString:
我有发现过一次那类特殊个体，是在夜勤下班后的街边。
因为我家也有一个差不多的「欧拉拳套」，平时会用作按摩工具疏解肌肉的劳损，于是当时我理所当然以为这也是别人落在这的，正想要不要捡起来给失物招领处的时候，突然发现周身不知什么时候立起了栏杆和警示灯一类东西，脚下也浮起了一座擂台，把我给抬了起来……
我意识到不太对劲，总之还是赶紧翻出擂台，与那副拳套拉开了距离。然而，回头再看时，那个擂台已经消失不见，只有拳套安静地躺在地上……
如果不是现在确认了「欧拉拳套」之中是有具备如此能力的类型，我可能真会以为是那天太累了才出现幻觉……
Content.LocalizedString:
I once encountered that type of special entity after a night shift on the street.
Because I have a similar Ora Puncher at home, which I use as a massage tool, I naturally thought someone lost theirs and was considering taking it to lost and found. But then railings and warning lights suddenly appeared around me, and a ring rose up under my feet, lifting me up…
I realized something was wrong and quickly climbed out of the ring, distancing myself from the puncher. When I looked back, the ring had disappeared, and the puncher lay quietly on the ground…
If the Ora Punchers' abilities hadn't been confirmed, I'd have thought I was seeing things from exhaustion…

Sign.SourceString:
--凡德米尔
异象管理局联合特遣队
Sign.LocalizedString:
- Vandemir
Bureau of Anomaly Control, Joint Task Force

DisplayText.SourceString: 「欧拉拳套」无论如何都不能忍受被人挑衅说「胆小鬼」，因此只要用这个方法，就可以刺激到它全力进攻。在擂台战中，如果超过限定的回合时间他就会重振旗鼓并愈战愈勇。好在，它承认败北的态度很爽快，如此看来也怀有类似于「斗士尊严」的东西。
DisplayText.LocalizedString: The Ora Punchers can't stand being called a wuss under any circumstances. Therefore, this is an easy way to provoke it to attack with full force. If the time limit of a round is exceeded in the ring, it will rally and fight even harder. Fortunately, it admits defeat gracefully, suggesting that it possesses a surprising amount of dignity.

DisplayText.SourceString: 「欧拉拳套」无论如何都不能忍受被人挑衅说「胆小鬼」，因此只要用这个方法，就可以刺激到它全力进攻。在擂台战中，如果超过限定的回合时间他就会重振旗鼓并愈战愈勇……我认为它的目的，只是想要与真正的斗士进行一场真正的擂台较量。
DisplayText.LocalizedString: The Ora Punchers can't stand being called a wuss under any circumstances. Therefore, this is an easy way to provoke it to attack with full force. If the time limit of a round is exceeded in the ring, it will rally and fight even harder. I believe that all it really wants is a duel with a true warrior.

DisplayText.SourceString: 就这？
DisplayText.LocalizedString: That's it?

VisionDesc.SourceString:
该物品异象外形呈现为一台老式放映机。热衷在其出现场所虚构一段影片，多为事故内容。参与者可在影片的任意进度中进行探寻。一旦找出影片中的奇点——多为事故源头，「时空放映机」便会自然泯除。
奇怪的是，「时空放映机」每次被泯除时会播放一段留言，在官方记录的现有47段留言中，有7次提及到类似于「帮助了ta们所在的时空」这样的描述。结合每次留言内容，部分专家认为「时空放映机」的内容是发生在其他时间线上的事故，被储存的事故信息会通过「时空放映机」的泯除来否定此次事故的存在。也有部分专家判断这只是「时空放映机」自导自演的闹剧。
VisionDesc.LocalizedString:
This Object Anomaly resembles an old-fashioned projector. It tends to create fabricated videos at the sites of its appearance, mostly footage involving incidents. Participants can explore further at any point during the video's progress. Once the nexus in the video is found—usually the source of the incident—the Spacetime Projector will naturally undergo nullification.
Interestingly, each time the Spacetime Projector is nullified, it plays a message. Out of the 47 messages officially recorded, 7 mention something about aiding the spacetime they are in. Based on the content of each message, some experts believe that the content displayed by the Spacetime Projector involves incidents that occurred in other timelines, and the incidents themselves become negated through the nullification of the Spacetime Projector. However, some experts also consider this to be merely a farce orchestrated by the Spacetime Projector itself.

HouseCondition.SourceString: 找到「影片」的「答案」
HouseCondition.LocalizedString: Find the Answer in the Video.

AnnihilateCondition.SourceString: 揭示「影片」中的事件源头
AnnihilateCondition.LocalizedString: Reveal the source of events in the Video

Content.SourceString: 提醒！提醒！异象猎人请看这里！「时空放映机」危险评级定为Ⅰ级，主要依据是进入「影片」中的参与者可以随时退出，并且「时空放映机」暂未显现主动性的破坏行为。但是！但是！「影片」中存在Ⅱ级以上的歧骸！各位在处理时务必保持警惕！

So keep your eyes peeled and stay sharp in there!

--莎莎
异象管理局联合特遣队

- Sasha
Bureau of Anomaly Control, Joint Task Force

The video contains footage of events with casualties, though no clear clues have been found to determine their authenticity. Hopefully, those are just fictional occurrences created by the Anomaly.

DisplayText.SourceString: 「时空放映机」放映过程中，「影片」的进度条可能会出现一小段不稳定的波段，在波段范围内寻找影片线索，便能最短时间完成线索的全部收集，以达成泯除条件。投映区域并没有出现过类似的事故，但它的储存信息又格外真实……影片内容究竟是源自其他时间线的真实事故……还仅仅是一场虚构的闹剧？
DisplayText.LocalizedString: During the screening of the Spacetime Projector, there may be a brief unstable segment on the video's progress bar. Search this segment and collect all clues in the shortest time to meet the nullification criteria. No similar incidents have occurred in the projection area, but the stored information does seem exceptionally realistic… Is the content in the video based on real accidents from another timeline… or is it all just a fictional farce?

VisionDesc.SourceString:
形似一团废弃胶卷的物体异象，周围漂浮着散落的照片，中心有「Keep the room dark」这类暗房常见字样。无明显的主动攻击意图，喜欢以摄像框锁定目标，暗中「记录」、「捕捉」。伴随快门声，被捕捉目标可能出现从原地消失、变为相片等情况，进入「负片空间」。「负片空间」中，散溢的胶卷本体可以直接对目标进行物理攻击，也有用已经被记录的影像化形攻击的可能。
「胶卷-MANISH」首例出现于桥间地「菲林轨迹」照相馆，后由异象猎人组织「伊波恩古董店」完成泯除。「MANISH」是以生产胶卷、摄影化学品、相机等摄影相关产品而闻名的「瞬光影像公司」的胶卷产品，曾是历史上最受欢迎的胶卷系列之一。随着新型相机技术的兴起，传统的胶片相机逐渐退出市场主流，导致「MANISH」销量锐减，最终停产退出历史舞台。调查推断，这也极可能是「胶卷-MANISH」异象化的主要原因。
VisionDesc.LocalizedString:
An Object Anomaly resembling a discarded roll of film, surrounded by scattered floating photos, with common darkroom language like "Keep The Room Dark" in the center. It shows no clear intent to attack but prefers to lock onto targets with a camera's viewfinder, stealthily recording and capturing them. With each shutter click, the captured target may vanish, turn into a photograph, or be cast into the Negative Space. In the Negative Space, the fragmented film entity can launch physical attacks or attack with previously recorded images.
The first instance of Film - MANISH appeared at the Film Orbit Studio in Bridge Crossings, only to be nullified by the Anomaly Hunter organization, Eibon Antique Shop. Manish hailed from Lux Imaging Company's esteemed lineup. The celebrated company was famed for its photographic films, chemicals, cameras, and related gear. The advent of new photography technologies nudged traditional films out of the limelight, plummeting MANISH sales and leading to its eventual phase-out. This decline is believed to have sparked the anomalization of Film - MANISH.

HouseCondition.SourceString: 寻找并击败其「负片空间」中的本体
HouseCondition.LocalizedString: Find and defeat its Negative Space body.

AnnihilateCondition.SourceString: 超过其自身负荷的伤害
AnnihilateCondition.LocalizedString: Overloading Damage

Content.SourceString:
「能详细说说你遇到的情况吗？」
「那晚天已经黑了，路灯也坏了，我一个人走在路上，也看不清周围有什么东西……只是听到了快门声。」
「快门声？」
「对，现在想想，这大半夜的，看不见人看不见光的，谁会在那儿拍照！」
「之后还有发生什么吗？」
「听到那声音后，我当时也没多想，就回家去了。硬要说点什么的话……下次拍照能不能先提醒一下，我都没来得及调整姿势和表情管理……当时那个表情，肯定很丑！」
Content.LocalizedString:
"Can you describe what you encountered in detail?"
"It was already dark. The streetlights were broken, and I was walking alone down the road. I couldn't see what was around… but I heard the shutter clicks."
"Shutter clicks?"
"Yeah. Now that I think about it, who would take pictures in the middle of the night when you can't see anyone or any light?!"
"Did anything else happen afterward?"
"After hearing those sounds, I didn't think much and went home. If you must know… next time, I'd like a heads-up before taking pictures. I didn't have time to pose or anything… I must have looked mighty ugly!"

Sign.SourceString:
--凯利
异象管理局联合特遣队
Sign.LocalizedString:
- Kelly
Bureau of Anomaly Control, Joint Task Force

Content.SourceString:
「能详细说说你遇到的情况吗？」
「我就是路过，突然听到『咔嚓』一声，然后我面前的垃圾桶就凭空消失了！一丁点都没留下！」
「然后呢？」
「我还以为是自己看错了，在那地方多转了两圈，就被什么东西打中了屁股！就当是什么垃圾，谁知道一转头就跟一团黑乎乎的东西大眼瞪小眼了！」
「然后就被路过的异象猎人救了。」
「这种事情就不要再提了吧……」
Content.LocalizedString:
"Can you describe what you encountered in detail?"
"I was just passing by and suddenly heard a click, and then the trash can in front of me vanished into thin air! Not a trace left!"
"And then?"
"I thought I was seeing things, so I walked around that spot a few more times, and then something hit my butt! I thought it was trash, but when I turned around, I was staring eye-to-eye with a dark mass!"
"Then you were saved by an Anomaly Hunter who happened to pass by."
"Let's not bring that up again…"

Sign.SourceString:
--凯利
异象管理局联合特遣队
Sign.LocalizedString:
- Kelly
Bureau of Anomaly Control, Joint Task Force

DisplayText.SourceString:
「摄像框」会导致「镜头」范围内的物体消失，可以利用这类痕迹锁定暗处的胶卷本体。被「捕捉」后会进入「负片世界」，对胶卷本体灌注超其负荷的异能伤害即可泯除该异象。
审美极佳的摄影大师，光影，构图，瞬间捕捉能力都无可挑剔。如果拍完照后能把「记录」的东西原地归位就更好了。
DisplayText.LocalizedString:
The Viewfinder causes objects within its range to disappear. These traces can be used to locate the hidden film itself. Once captured, the victim enters the Negative Space. This Anomaly can be nullified if the film itself is infused with Esper damage beyond its capacity.
A photography master with a keen eye for stunning scenes. Capable of impeccably capturing pictures with outstanding lighting and composition. If only it would return its captured items to their original place after taking the photos…

「听到那声音后，我当时也没多想，就回家去了。硬要说点什么的话……下次拍照能不能先提醒一下，我都没来得及调整姿势和表情管理……当时那个表情，肯定很丑！」
Content.LocalizedString:
"Can you describe what you encountered in detail?"
"It was already dark. The streetlights were broken, and I was walking alone down the road. I couldn't see what was around… but I heard the shutter clicks."
"Shutter clicks?"
"Yeah. Now that I think about it, who would take pictures in the middle of the night when you can't see anyone or any light?!"
"Did anything else happen afterward?"
"After hearing those sounds, I didn't think much and went home. If you must know… next time, I'd like a heads-up before taking pictures. I didn't have time to pose or anything… I must have looked mighty ugly!"

「摄像框」会导致「镜头」范围内的物体消失，可以利用这类痕迹锁定暗处的胶卷本体。被「捕捉」后会进入「负片世界」，对胶卷本体灌注超其负荷的异能伤害即可泯除该异象。

VisionDesc.SourceString:
作为一个现象异象，该异象会附着在一个敞口的箱子上，从表面上看是一个黑色的敞口箱子，箱子上有黄色字母「C」，被附着后往往会增殖出一些其他的箱形物体悬浮在本体周围，这被认为是辨认该异象最直接的方式。当「增殖的C」一定范围内出现其他生物的活动迹象时，「增殖的C」会对这一行为做出反应，具体表现为凭空出现大量箱形物体阻碍其他生物靠近「增殖的C」。试图关闭「增殖的C」可能招致它的攻击，主要是通过本体的撞击及生成各种各样的箱子进行攻击。成功将其关闭后，「增殖的C」会变回原本的样子。
经调查，「增殖的C」会附着在任意一个长期没有封口的箱子上，无论是纸箱、集装箱甚至是手办盒，太久无人过问，这些箱子会从原本的位置消失，凭空出现在城市的其他角落。考虑到「增殖的C」中可能存在的内容物，在泯除过程中对「增殖的C」本体的操作应小心进行，且在泯除过程中最好对操作进行拍摄留证或留下其他记录凭证，以避免可能引发的纠纷。泯除完成后请联系治安所，后续寻找失主的过程由治安所完成。
部分「增殖的C」在被泯除后会消失，针对这种情况异象猎人只需确认已经将「增殖的C」封住即可。
VisionDesc.LocalizedString:
As a Phenomenon Anomaly, this Anomaly attaches to an open box, appearing as a black open box with a yellow letter "C" on it. Once attached, it typically spawns other box-like objects that float around the main body, which is considered the most direct way to identify this Anomaly. When Proliferative C detects signs of activity from other living beings within a certain range, it reacts by manifesting large numbers of box-like objects out of thin air to block others from approaching Proliferative C. Attempting to close Proliferative C may provoke its attacks, primarily through ramming with its main body and generating various types of boxes for offensive purposes. After successfully closing it, Proliferative C will revert to its original form.
Investigation reveals that Proliferative C can attach to any box that has remained unsealed for an extended period, whether it's a cardboard box, shipping container, or even a figurine box. If left unattended for too long, these boxes will disappear from their original location and reappear in other corners of the city. Considering the potential contents within Proliferative C, operations on the main body during the nullification process should be conducted carefully, and it's recommended to record the operation through filming or other documentation methods to avoid potential disputes. After nullification is complete, please contact the Security Office, which will handle the subsequent process of locating the original owner.
Some Proliferative C instances disappear after nullification. In such cases, Anomaly Hunters only need to confirm that they have successfully sealed Proliferative C.

HouseCondition.SourceString: 穿越箱子形成的迷宫，找到「增殖的C」附着的箱子
HouseCondition.LocalizedString: Navigate the maze to find the box possessed by Proliferative C.

AnnihilateCondition.SourceString: 「增殖的C」附着的箱子
AnnihilateCondition.LocalizedString: Box possessed by Proliferative C.

Content.SourceString:
最近的快递实在是太多了，打包到一半忽然接了个催件的电话，就把手头这个给忘掉了！丢件可是要赔付的，还好找了半天我想起这单还在仓库里没有打包......才刚刚松口气，谁知道一推开门眼前全是纸箱！稍微走两步纸箱还更多了，跟一堵墙似的！我就奇了怪了，哪儿来这么多件！
哎哟，你都不知道走在一大堆摞起来的纸箱之间有多吓人，总感觉这些纸箱下一秒就会塌下来！还好我把那个没封口的快递封好之后，这些箱子就消失了，里面的东西也没事。不然我这个月不就白干了！现在想来，总觉得那玩意跟个迷宫似的......我这儿爆单够严重了，再来这种乱七八糟的快件，我就去送外卖了！
Content.LocalizedString:
Man, the deliveries are non-stop lately. Got sidetracked by a rush order and nearly lost a package. Would've cost me! Finally found it in the warehouse, unwrapped… Just as I breathed a sigh of relief, I opened the door to find a cardboard box city! The more I walked, the more boxes there were, and they almost formed a wall! I was baffled: where did all these packages come from?
Oh, you have no idea how scary it is to walk among a pile of stacked cardboard boxes. It felt as if they could collapse any second! Luckily, after sealing the package, the boxes disappeared, and the items inside were fine. Otherwise, this month's work would have been for nothing! Thinking back, it felt like a maze… If I run into that mess again, I'm switching to food delivery, no joke!

DisplayText.SourceString: 「增殖的C」会根据人的行动增殖出箱子，形成迷宫来阻挡人前进，泯除其的方式则是封上「增殖的C」敞开的箱口。需注意的是，封口行为有很大概率会招来「增殖的C」主动攻击，除此以外，「增殖的C」没有任何的危险性。在泯除了随机出现的「增殖的C」后，「增殖的C」会在复原之后消失......如果「增殖的C」增殖时会带着本体的内容物一同增殖的话，还会是个发财的好方法。
DisplayText.LocalizedString: Proliferative C duplicates itself into more boxes based on people's actions, forming a maze to block their progress. You can nullify it by identifying and sealing the open box that Proliferative C has possessed. Keep in mind that sealing the box has a high chance of provoking Proliferative C into actively attacking you. Other than that, Proliferative C poses no danger whatsoever. After nullifying a randomly appearing Proliferative C, it will disappear once it reverts to its original state… If Proliferative C duplicates the contents of the original box when it multiplies, this could actually be a pretty good way to get rich.

该物品异象状似一扇被漆成红色的门。通常出现于一堵由垃圾桶、自动贩卖机等常见设施组成的「墙」上，呈开启状。站在门外向内眺望，能隐约看到门后环境杂草丛生。

Content.SourceString:
你说的东西，我在上班的路上遇到过。
我记得清清楚楚，是熬夜追连载睡过头的那天。因为想着「快迟到了！」而选了一条平时不怎么走的小路。就在我一边快步冲向2-Four，一边想着这个月多半是要告别准时出勤奖的时候，那个东西出现了。
对，和其他人看到的差不多。巷子里的垃圾桶突然活动起来，与许多不知从哪儿飞来的垃圾桶一起，在我面前组成一堵垃圾桶墙！里面甚至有一个贴着我们店的标签，我估摸着是后门那个。
一起飞来的还有那扇红色的门，怪滑稽地补上了垃圾桶墙的缺口，「吱呀」一声打开。顺便一说：每当看到门被打开，我就想说 「欢迎光临！」
不过这扇门再怎么欢迎我，我都是不会进去的……谁知道里面都是什么地方？虽说听说别人通过那扇门，会从墙的另一侧穿出来。我才不要拿我的全勤奖冒险。
话又说回来，店长听说我遇到天降异象堵路，不得不绕好大一个弯子后，特批我那天迟到不扣奖金。这算不算因祸得福？
Content.LocalizedString:
I've encountered what you're talking about on my way to work.
I remember it crystal clear. It was the day I overslept after binge-watching a series all night. Thinking "I'm going to be late!" I took a shortcut I rarely use. As I was rushing towards 2-Four, lamenting that I'd probably kiss my punctuality bonus goodbye this month, that thing appeared.
Yeah, it was similar to what others have seen. The trash can in the alley suddenly came to life, joining with many others that flew in from who knows where, forming a wall of trash cans right in front of me! There was even one with our store's label on it. I reckon it was the one from the back door.
Along with the trash cans came that red door, comically filling in a gap in the trash can wall. It creaked open with a squeak. By the way, whenever I see a door open, I can't help but want to say, "Welcome!"
But no matter how welcoming that door might be, I wasn't going in… Who knows where it leads? I've heard that others who went through ended up coming out from the other side of the wall. But I wasn't about to risk my perfect attendance bonus for that.
Speaking of which, when the manager heard I encountered an anomaly from the sky blocking the way and had to take a big detour, they approved my late arrival that day without deducting my bonus. Is this a blessing in disguise?

Content.SourceString:
说起校园，大家脑海中浮现的是什么？一份又一份宛若永远也写不完的课后作业，在操场上肆意挥洒的汗水？还是纵使考试时也怎样都按捺不住的对暑假的期待？然而我们终究会放学、毕业，随着那声下课铃响，学生生涯在我们尚未察觉时，就这样结束了。
相信许多人深夜时会梦回那段再也回不去的少年时光，而今日来信为我们分享的诺尔先生，则是真真切切再度踏入了那栋「再也回不去的」教学楼。
「阿话你好，我是你的忠实听众。听你为大家娓娓道来那些神奇的故事是我最宝贵的青春回忆之一。」——多谢！多谢你的喜欢！阿话很荣幸能一直陪伴你。
「然而就像许多人一样，我升学、毕业、开始工作。我循规蹈矩地踏上所有人都会踏上的道路，接受着这样再平凡再正常不过的人生。少年时期闪闪发光的经历，就好像随着时间流逝已彻底褪色、枯萎。我曾想……它们应该再与我无缘了。然而，那件事的确发生了。我认为绝不可能发生在我这样平平无奇的普通人身上的，波澜壮阔的冒险。」
「那天我过得很糟，下班时已经将近凌晨。天气也是差到透顶，没带伞的我已经被浇了个透。好像是嫌我遇到的麻烦不够多似的。我遇到了那个异象。街边的自动贩卖机仿佛被一只看不见的大手捏起、摆放、拼凑、组合，形成一堵结结实实的贩卖机墙。这本该是我儿时最憧憬见证的景象，但在那时候，它不过是让我心生疲惫与恼恨的，堵住我回家去路的障碍而已。」
「我只想尽快回家，倒在床上好好睡上一觉，从无止尽的工作里喘口气。为什么连这么简单的愿望都要备受阻碍！我愤愤转身，试图找出能让我稍微躲些雨、又不会绕路太多的回家路线。脑内思考的齿轮像是也被这雨泡得锈蚀，『嘎吱嘎吱』一阵后分崩离析，废铜烂铁撒了满地。哪怕是这么简单的事，对当时精疲力竭的我来说，都无法做到。」
「也许是忽然的阵风让浑身湿透的我猛一哆嗦，也许是回头看到远处公司大楼加班的灯光依旧冰冷威严，也许是我压根想不出任何这种情况下能做的、该做的事。总之在那个瞬间，说是神使鬼差也好，说是自暴自弃也罢。我的身体驱使着我自己走近了那扇红门，而我也很清楚，我绝对不是想进去避雨。」
「里面既不是火山喷发海啸汹涌，也没有童话书里的饼干屋棉花糖森林。就是那种——荒废已久杂草丛生的烂尾楼，平平无奇。唯一有不远处颜色鲜丽与灰暗的环境格格不入的门，提醒着我现在身处何处。自门的另一端，隐约传来了纸张、油墨、和原木的味道。不陌生，很好闻，像很久很久以前早已习惯，令人安心的味道。」
「图书馆。母校教学楼里的图书馆。」
「上次在图书馆好好读上一本书是什么时候？脑海里像是『啪』的弹开了一只名为回忆的旧匣子。念书的时光，学校图书馆里的漫画周刊、电影特辑、最新的《异象收藏指南》……那个时候不情愿上学，总是翘掉不喜欢的课，在图书馆里蘑菇上一整天。以书中那些奇遇为蓝本做白日梦，畅想着那些与异象的奇妙故事要是能发生在我身上该多好！」
「奇遇也的确曾发生在我身上。母校的教学楼，在某个学期开学第一天神秘『失踪』。老师们对着教学楼原址的大坑面面相觑，迫不得已宣布开学延期。哭丧着脸的学生们瞬间雨过天晴，一哄而散。不用上学真是太爽了！这一定是天意！」
「然而当时的我们只是为不用上课、不用写作业、不用考试窃喜，却从没想过学生生涯究竟意味着什么。」
「然而那栋再也无缘见到的教学楼，此刻却真真切切出现在我眼前。」
「再次见到它时我才意识到，我多想回到这里，我多想回去上学啊。」
「教室的位置我还如此熟悉，抽屉里肯定还有张被折成纸飞机的不及格考卷。我大吼大叫着，像疯了般上蹿下跳着，恨不得立刻扑进那张小小的桌椅。那个瞬间我像回到了少年时代，浑身有着怎么都使不完的劲儿。我在走廊上飞奔起来，就好像过去一样轻盈、肆意。但很快我就不得不扶着墙大口大口的喘气，膝盖很也应景地发出一声脆响。」
「这个时候，我已经走到了教学楼的尽头。那扇艳丽到仿佛红色颜料刚刚才被刷上去的门再度出现在我眼前。它敞开着，外面是绵密不断的雨帘。」
「如果出去，一切就会到此为止。会被现实的雨再度浇个透，向其他人说起这段奇遇也只会被怀疑的眼光上下打量，说那一定是我风寒感冒而臆想的胡言乱语。」
「这里，是我的庇护所。它保管着我遗失的那段时光，也是因此再与我相遇的——我如此笃信。我想留下来。我要留下来。」
「我的手搭上了门把手，坚定地把它往里拉。」
「门关上了。然后……就像告诉我这里不能留下，我无法回去一般。这个空间逐渐消融瓦解，消散得干干净净。我再度置身暴雨下，和走进那扇门前没有分别。」
「原来是这样啊。」
「那扇门，那堵墙都消失了。能证明我曾回到那栋教学楼的东西，通通都不见了。这一切发生得太快，到底是我太过疲惫妄想的梦？还是我的体温已经不正常到急需就医？」
「也许那些都不重要。我只需知道遗失的那段时光仍在某个角落被珍藏着，已足矣。」
「也许……能够重逢，便已是最惊艳的奇迹。对我来说，这已是有幸能遇到的，最伟大的冒险。」

——来信到这里就结束了，感谢与我们分享的诺尔先生。阿话很荣幸能够收到你的来信，与你、以及无数听众朋友一同见证这段冒险。最后，阿话想说的是：我们可能会遇到很多失意、难过，让你觉得是生活如此枯燥灰暗的事。但无论如何，都请不要放弃期望与梦想。它们可能随时都会来到你身边，等待你的见证。甚至，它们正在悄然发生，只要你愿意相信。
Content.LocalizedString:
What comes to mind when you think of school? Endless homework? Sweat pouring down on the playground? Or the irrepressible anticipation for summer vacation, even during exams? Eventually, we all leave school and graduate. With the final bell, our student days end before we realize it.
Many of us dream of those irretrievable youthful days. Today, Mr. Noel shares with us his experience of literally stepping back into that "unreturnable" school building.
"Hello, Chatty. I'm your loyal listener. Hearing you narrate those magical stories is one of my most cherished memories of youth." Thank you! Thank you for your support! Chatty is honored to have been with you all this time.
"Like many others, I went to college, graduated, and started working. I followed the path everyone takes, accepting an ordinary, normal life. The shining experiences of my youth seemed to have faded and withered with time. I thought… they were gone for good. But then, it happened. A grand adventure I never thought possible for someone as ordinary as me."
"That day was terrible. It was nearly dawn when I left work. The weather was awful too, and I was soaked without an umbrella. As if I needed more trouble, I encountered that anomaly. The street's vending machines were lifted, arranged, and combined by an invisible hand, forming a solid wall. This should have been a sight I'd dreamed of as a child, but at that moment, it was just an exhausting, frustrating obstacle blocking my way home."
"I just wanted to get home, collapse into bed, and catch a breath from endless work. Why was even this simple wish obstructed? I turned around angrily, trying to find a route home that would shelter me from the rain without too much of a detour. The gears in my brain felt rusted by the rain, creaking before falling apart, scattering useless mental scrap everywhere. Even something this simple was beyond me in my exhausted state."
"Maybe it was a sudden gust making my drenched body shiver, or seeing the cold, imposing lights of the office building where people were still working overtime, or perhaps I simply couldn't think of anything to do in this situation. Whatever it was, call it divine intervention or giving up, my body drove me towards that red door. I knew very well I wasn't looking for shelter from the rain."
"Inside wasn't a volcanic eruption or a raging tsunami, nor a fairytale gingerbread house or cotton candy forest. It was just an abandoned, overgrown building site. Utterly ordinary. Only a vibrant door in the distance, starkly contrasting with the gloomy surroundings, reminded me where I was. From the other side of the door wafted the faint smell of paper, ink, and raw wood. Familiar, pleasant scents that felt safe, like something I'd known long, long ago."
"The library. The library in my old school building."
"When was the last time I'd properly read a book in a library? A box of memories seemed to spring open in my mind. School days, manga magazines in the school library, movie specials, the latest Anomalies Guide… Back then, I was reluctant to go to school, often skipping classes I didn't like to spend whole days mushrooming in the library. Daydreaming based on the adventures in books, fantasizing about experiencing such wonderful anomaly stories myself!"
"And indeed, an adventure did happen to me. The school building mysteriously "disappeared" on the first day of a new semester. Teachers stared at each other in bewilderment at the large pit where the building used to be, forced to postpone the start of school. The gloomy-faced students instantly brightened up and scattered. No school was amazing! It must have been fate!"
"But back then, we were just secretly happy about no classes, no homework, no exams. We never thought about what our student life really meant."
"And now, that school building I thought I'd never see again was right before my eyes."
"Seeing it again, I realized how much I wanted to come back here, how much I wanted to go back to school."
"I still knew the classrooms so well, surely there was still a failed test paper folded into a paper airplane in the desk drawer. I shouted and jumped around like a madman, desperate to throw myself onto that small desk and chair. At that moment, I felt like I was back in my youth, full of boundless energy. I started running down the hallway, feeling as light and free as in the past. But soon I had to lean against the wall, gasping for breath, my knees making an all-too-appropriate cracking sound."
"By this time, I had reached the end of the school building. That door, so vividly red as if the paint had just been applied, appeared before me again. It was open, with a steady curtain of rain beyond it."
"If I went out, everything would end. I'd be drenched by the rain of reality again, and if I told others about this experience, they'd just look at me suspiciously, saying it must be delirious ramblings from a cold."
"This place was my sanctuary. It safeguarded the time I had lost, and that's why we met again—I firmly believed this. I wanted to stay. I had to stay."
"I put my hand on the doorknob, firmly pulling it closed."
"The door shut. And then… as if telling me I couldn't stay, that I couldn't go back, this space gradually dissolved and disappeared completely. I was back in the pouring rain, no different from before I entered that door."
"So that's how it is."
"The door, the wall, they all vanished. Everything that could prove I had returned to that school building was gone. It all happened so fast—was it just a dream born from my exhaustion? Or was my body temperature so abnormal that I needed urgent medical care?"
"Perhaps none of that matters. I only need to know that those lost times are still treasured somewhere, and that's enough."
"Maybe… the chance to meet again is already the most dazzling miracle. For me, this was the greatest adventure I could have hoped to encounter."

…This is where the letter ends. Thank you for sharing, Mr. Noel. Chatty is honored to have received your letter and witnessed this adventure with you and countless listeners. Lastly, Chatty wants to say: We may encounter many disappointments and sadness, making life feel dull and gray. But no matter what, please do not give up hope and dreams. They may come to you at any moment, waiting for you to witness them. In fact, they might be happening quietly, as long as you are willing to believe.

该生物异象身穿黑色机车服，骑在一辆燃烧着火焰的机车上，每逢午夜零点后便会游荡在都市街头，对深夜飙车的暴走族实施惩戒。目击者称，如果被追上，将被呼啸的黑色火焰吞噬，可怖的镰刀将带走失败者的灵魂。在此事传开后，都市夜晚的暴走族一改往日的嚣张气焰，但仍有好事者，在试图找到它，证明谁是真正的街头车王。

有着黑雾凝实的巨大长柄镰刀，配合高速摩托冲刺状态下的斩击，让它在飙车中无往不利，它对破坏暴走族的机车异常执着，挥舞的镰刀带走了无数暴走族的暴走之魂。以审判暴走族的名义，完成对于「无首铁驭」的审判，它将自我泯除。
VisionDesc.LocalizedString:
This Bio Anomaly wears a black biker suit and rides a motorcycle engulfed in flames, wandering the city streets at night to punish night-racing gangs. Witnesses claim that if caught, one would be consumed by roaring black flames, and a fearsome scythe would claim the soul of the defeated. Following the spread of this tale, the city's night racers have curbed their arrogance, though some thrill-seekers still attempt to find it, aiming to prove who is the true king of the street racers.

With a massive scythe formed from dense black mist, combined with slashes executed during high-speed motorcycle dashes, it becomes unstoppable in races. It is exceptionally obsessed with destroying the motorcycles of night-racing gangs, with its swinging scythe claiming countless racing souls. Completes the judgment of the Headless Rider, and it will nullify itself.

Content.SourceString:
我曾在深夜执勤追捕其他异象时偶遇过它，当时出于追捕需要，该路段全程处于封锁状态，为了尽快将异象收容，我使出了练习已久的「Z字摆尾」势必将其拿下！但是仪表盘突然出现了一些莫名奇妙的乱码，还以为是加班太晚导致眼花……直到一个机车异象冒着蓝火出现在车道，一路飞驰而去，哪怕我的爱车已经完成尾翼、引擎、悬挂系统等方面的改造，也追赶不上，当晚还以为自己遇到了车王……

最后落入了一个异常空间，它那巨大的镰刀和轰鸣的机车，让人印象深刻。结局并不美好，异象使出了一些让人眼花缭乱的机车组合招数，即使拼尽全力也无法取胜。不过从那以后，我再也没有超速驾驶过，也算是因祸得福吧。
Content.LocalizedString:
I once encountered it while on night duty, pursuing other Anomalies. The section was under lockdown for containment purposes, and to swiftly contain the Anomaly, I used the long-practiced "Z Drift" to ensure its capture! However, the dashboard suddenly displayed inexplicable gibberish, which I initially attributed to late-night fatigue… until a motorcycle Anomaly with blue flames appeared on the road, speeding away. Even though my beloved car had modifications to the spoiler, engine, and suspension system, it couldn't keep up. That night, I thought I had met the king of racers…

Ultimately, I fell into an anomalous space, its enormous scythe and roaring motorcycle left me a deep impression. The ending wasn't pleasant, as the Anomaly executed dazzling motorcycle combo moves that couldn't be overcome despite my best efforts. However, since then, I haven't driven over the speed limit, which is a blessing in disguise.

Content.SourceString:
（故意模仿一些动漫开局的声音）深夜的暴走族呼啸而过……骑着黑色摩托的无头骑士于街头穿梭，用冒着蓝火的镰刀对暴走族审判……一个月黑风高的夜晚，为了竞争下个季度的「闪电狂潮无敌竞速准点快递员」的称号，一场名为「快递的战争」在海特洛市正式打响！下面有请事件当事人——斯特利准点记录保持者、人间完全放电、抽卡神威十连十金欧皇眷属的哈尼娅讲述自己遭遇「无首铁驭」的第一视角。

咳咳（换回自己的声音）我可是和它打过几次交道……深夜加急快递嘛……虽然九原姐一直强调要遵守规则，听得人耳朵都长茧子了……但是情况特殊，它突然出现，大半夜的，一辆冒着蓝火的黑色摩托气势汹汹地跟随我，一看就是反派！虽说有了解过附近发生的怪事，但是为了早点送到，抄近路也顾不得这么多！不过嘛，我是谁？哈尼娅——「斯特利速递」御三家快递员，小小异象怎能耽误派件大计。街头小巷、秘密暗道可都是我常年霸占快递准点记录的秘密武器，只需略施小计，这点小麻烦轻松甩开。至于快递派送，当然是不负「精英快递员之名」，好评稳稳拿下！

嘿嘿，如果您有任何快递的需求，请联系「斯特利速递」，如果指明「哈尼娅」快递员，五星好评拜托拜托(≧∇≦)ﾉ
Content.LocalizedString:
(Mimicking the voice of some anime opening) The biker gangs roar in the night… the headless rider on a black motorcycle weaves through the streets, bringing judgment to the bikers with a blue-flamed scythe… On a moonless, windy night, to compete for the title of "Courier of the Quarter," a battle known as "Delivery Wars" has ignited in Hethereau! Now, let's invite the person involved in the incident—Sterry's punctuality record holder, humanoid perpetual machine, the Midas of gacha games, Haniel, to narrate her close encounter of the third kind with the headless rider.

Ahem… Cough cough… (switching back to own voice) Oh, the headless rider? Yeah… I've been there… Those late-night deliveries… Though Jiuyuan always mentions the rules, which gets quite repetitive and boring… but it was no occasion for rules. It suddenly appeared, and in the dead of night, a black motorcycle with blue flames aggressively followed me, clearly up to no good! Although I had heard rumors of strange things around the blocks, I couldn't be bothered! Who am I? Haniel! The top couriers of Sterry Express! How could a mere anomaly delay my orders? The streets, the alleys, and the beaten paths are my secret weapons for dominating the punctuality record over the years. With some tricks up my sleeve, of course I will prevail in the face of adversity. As for the order, of course, Sterry Express's elite courier secured another satisfied customer!

Hehe, if you have any delivery needs, go for Sterry Express! You could be my next satisfied customer! (≧∇≦)ﾉ

Content.SourceString:
都说「灵感终结者」是创作者的死敌，「灵感终结者」出没之处犹如蝗虫过境，谁都别想留下一个好点子。但我必须为这群讨厌的小东西们正名一下，它们也不是什么都吃。
没错，我亲眼看到了「灵感终结者」进食的瞬间。它晃晃悠悠，一飞一颤地降落在猎物的后脑勺上。一看就是久没吃饭，都饿到飞不动了。
可惜有那家伙的头发挡住，实在看不清它吸灵感的细节。总之我远远看见茂密的头发间逐渐亮起了一个小点儿，就知道它得手了。我立刻捏好了我的苍蝇拍，屏息等待着……
结果你猜怎么着？那个亮点飞到半空，忽闪忽闪，猛地抽搐了一下，震出来个灰色的小光球。那光球飘飘忽忽地晃回原主人那里，而「灵感终结者」悬在半空，像是半天没晃过神来。我见此眼疾手快，一苍蝇拍击毙灵感小偷。
然而被盯上的受害者仿佛完全没意识到刚刚发生了什么，依旧伏案奋笔疾书着。不由得让人好奇，他这失而复得的灵感……究竟是在想什么呢？不管怎么说，灵感小偷肯定觉得这玩意不好吃，宁可饿着肚子都要吐出来。
Content.LocalizedString:
They say Inspiration Terminators are the bane of creators, devouring good ideas like locusts. But honestly, they're quite picky eaters.
I saw one in action once. It wobbled through the air, barely staying aloft, and landed on its target's head. The poor thing was starving and couldn't go any further.
I couldn't see much through the victim's hair, but a tiny light appeared, and I knew it was feeding. I readied my flyswatter and waited.
And guess what? The light flickered and twitched, then expelled a small grey orb back to its owner. But the Inspiration Terminator just hung there, stunned. One swift smack from me, and it was history.
The victim, oblivious, kept writing furiously. Makes you wonder what kind of inspiration got returned… Whatever it was, the thief clearly found it unpalatable, even on an empty stomach.

Content.SourceString:
「灵感终结者」偷取的灵感可能存在某种「关联性」，绝不仅仅只是偷走了你的一个点子。
这个结论基于我的亲身经历，说来还怪不好意思。总之情况大概是这样的：
前阵子给编辑寄去了我的新书稿后，我原打算好好放松一阵，没想到大脑怎样都没办法停下来！既然如此便趁热打铁，补充补充新作完结后的故事……没曾想被「灵感终结者」盯上，偷走了番外的灵感。
乘着灵感这阵东风而畅快疾奔的思路，就这样硬生生踩了个急刹车！那滋味别提多难受了。更糟糕的是，不仅是番外受到影响，就连本篇写作的思路，我都想不起来分毫。编辑给我打电话来讨论稿子的修改，我支支吾吾什么都说不出来。我当时为什么要这么写？心里只有这一个念头。
直到请异象猎人来解决掉「灵感终结者」，桌上那一沓白纸重回书稿，这场恐怖的噩梦才总算结束。现在想来，番外的设定和思路，某种意义上来说是本篇的延续，所以「灵感终结者」所影响的，不仅仅是正在构思的这个灵感，和它联系紧密的想法思路也会被阻遏。
哎呀哎呀，看来下次写稿前我得先备足杀虫剂。
Content.LocalizedString:
Inspiration Terminators don't just steal one idea—they seem to feed on all related thoughts.
I came to this conclusion based on my own experience, though it's still embarrasing:
After sending my manuscript to my editor, I tried writing a spinoff since I couldn't relax. That's when an Inspiration Terminator struck.
It felt like slamming the brakes on a speeding train. I couldn't remember anything about my main story either, and sounded like an idiot when my editor called…
Only after hiring an Anomaly Hunter did my nightmare end, and my manuscript finally came back to life. Reflecting on it, the spinoff's setting and plot were extensions of the main story. So, when an Inspiration Terminator strikes, it doesn't just block your current idea—it suppresses all related thoughts and concepts too.
Looks like I'll need more insecticide for my next writing session.

VisionDesc.SourceString: 「不可自拔」是乘着互联网的便利之风，在社交网络上广为流传的异象影片。观看者会在短短数秒内就会沉迷影片，不可自拔。在被「不可自拔」夺取注意力的早期（一般为观看影片的一分钟内）尚可通过自制力摆脱异象影片的吸引与控制。一旦沉迷影片过久，将无法主动脱离影片的吸引，维持观看的状态直至影片正常放映结束。幸运的是，这种奇妙吸引力只会对第一次观看者生效。对已完整观看过影片的人来说，它与其他普通影片没什么区别。
VisionDesc.LocalizedString: Doomscroll is an Anomaly in the form of video that had spread widely on social media, hijacking the internet. Viewers become engrossed in the video within seconds. In the early stages of attention being captured by Doomscroll (usually within the first minute), one can still escape the video's allure and control through self-discipline. Once deeply engrossed, it becomes impossible to voluntarily break away from the video's pull until the video ends. Fortunately, this peculiar attraction only affects first-time viewers. For those who've already watched the video, it's no different from any other ordinary video.

HouseCondition.LocalizedString: Play the video to its end.

Content.SourceString:
一不小心就刷到了「不可自拔」什么的，现在还蛮常见。我反正觉得对我个人的影响不算太大。
也许是因为习惯用二倍速、四倍速加速看东西吧，我已经记不清上一次沉下心来好好看完整部电影是什么时候了。不止对我来说——其实绝大多数人都觉得没有这种必要吧？毕竟想要看的内容，大都已被剪辑成那种「带你五分钟看完xx」的系列短视频，只要想看随时就能点开。不太专心看画面也没关系，反正有整理好梗概重点的解说，像速食一样喂到你嘴边。总之点开视频，短短几分钟就足以了解整个故事的梗概，用作茶余饭后的谈资。然而因为「不可自拔」的特性，我可以认认真真看完好几部异象影片。这种久违的感觉还挺不错。
就是这类影片的剧情趣味性还可以加强加强。如果运气不好碰上了无聊的烂片，还必须从头到尾看完……也太难受。
Content.LocalizedString:
It's quite common nowadays to inadvertently come across Doomscroll. Personally, I don't feel it affects me much.
Maybe it's because I'm used to watching things at 2x or even 4x speed, I can't even remember the last time I sat down and watched a movie. Not just for me—most people probably think there's no need for it, right? After all, the content you want to see has mostly been edited into those "OOXX SUMMARIZED IN 5 MINUTES" short videos that you can click on anytime. It's okay not to focus too much on the screen, as there are summaries and key points neatly explained, like fast food fed into a tube that connects to your mind. In short, just a few minutes of video can give you the gist of the story, perfect for casual conversation. However, due to the nature of Doomscroll, I can actually watch several Anomaly Videos, all focused. It's a refreshing experience.
These videos' plots could use more excitement. If you're unlucky enough to watch a boring one, having to see it from start to finish is quite unbearable.

Content.SourceString:
最近「不可自拔」捣鼓出来最大的动静，就是被误操作投放到广场大型广告牌上，导致所有路过的人都伸长了脖子盯着看个不停的那次吧？
说来我可是实打实的亲历者，那天和闺蜜逛街正好赶上了。我们看前面里三圈外三圈围了一圈人，还以为在举行什么明星见面会呢，就抱着凑凑热闹的心态走近了瞧瞧。这不瞧不要紧，一瞧可坏了。只远远望了几眼，她就看入迷了，我怎么拉她都只会「再看一会儿、再看一会儿。」再看一会儿的后果就是，仿佛腿在地上生了根，直挺挺地一动也不动，能和旁边的行道树称兄道弟了！这个时候我再怎么和她说话，告诉她我们电影要开场了，用手在她眼前晃……都没用！除了大屏幕上播放的异象影片，她什么都看不到、听不见、顾不上。幸运的是她被影片控制的时候已接近尾声，我和我的「僵尸」闺蜜并没有维持太久。
你问我为什么没受影响？看看这比酒瓶底还厚的镜片！明白了吗？
Content.LocalizedString:
Recently, the biggest stir caused by Doomscroll was when it was mistakenly displayed on a large outdoor billboard, making everyone passing by stop and stare, right?
I was actually there that day with my best friend, shopping, and we happened to see it. We saw a crowd gathered and thought it was a celebrity meet-and-greet, so we went closer to check it out. That was a mistake. Just a few glances and she was entranced, refusing to move, whispering "just a little longer, just a little longer". The result was that she seemed rooted to the spot like a tree! No matter what I said or did to remind her that our movie was starting, it was useless! Other than the Anomaly Video on the big screen, she couldn't see, hear, or focus on anything else. Fortunately, the video's control over her was almost over, so my "zombie" friend and I didn't have to wait too long.
Why wasn't I affected? Check out these glasses thicker than a bottle bottom! Got it?

In the rain alley, Rainmen don't always attack from behind; direct confrontations are also common. The only way to escape is to defeat the Rainman. For ordinary citizens, being pulled into these alleys poses significant danger.

Content.SourceString:
看到街边放着的无人看管的雨伞，心想着莫不是有人遗落在这，要尽快交给失物招领处才好？
本人要提醒大家多长个心眼！先别这么急，与雨伞保持一定安全距离，仔细观察：伞下是否有一滩呈黑色的泥泞水渍？伞面是否垂下了疑似触手的不明物体？如果答案是：是。本人建议各位市民朋友们立刻远离现场，以及立刻与JTF联系，将「雨伞」交由专业人士处理。所谓的「雨伞」其实是非雨夜状态下的异象「雨人」，贸然接近可能导致非常严重的后果。
Content.LocalizedString:
See an unattended umbrella on the street and think about turning it in to the lost and found? 
Let me remind everyone to stay alert! Don't rush—keep a safe distance and take a closer look. Is there a black, muddy puddle underneath it? Are there any suspicious, tentacle-like objects dangling from the umbrella? If the answer is yes, I urge all citizens to leave the area immediately and contact the JTF. Let the professionals handle it. What looks like an umbrella is actually the Anomaly known as the Rainman in its dormant state. Approaching it recklessly could have serious consequences.

Content.SourceString:
街边伪装成雨伞的雨人，相信大家都有见过。那么，到了下雨的晚上，情况会如何呢？是不是会立刻变成我们熟知的模样？
如此好奇的异象猎人绝对不在少数，但愿意亲身验证得出结论的恐怕只有我了吧？然而结论恐怕会令大家大失所望：什么都没有发生！想象中伞里细细长长的触手扭曲伸展伪装成人形，呈现出西装上班族的样子后颤颤巍巍爬起来的情形，根本不存在啊！难道它不打算加入伙伴们的狩猎吗？
咨询某位在异象研究上颇有造诣的专家后，对方给了我这样的答复：如果将它静止不动的行为理解为「驻守原地」，或许就能说得通了。我们平常离它太近就会被拖入雨人的领地，不是么？或许它出现的位置，就是雨人那边的世界与我们世界的连接处。它要作为其他伙伴返家的「信标」，牢牢坚持在原地，等待雨夜的结束……
也就是说它们还是群非常情义的家伙啰？
Content.LocalizedString:
We've all seen Rainmen disguised as umbrellas on the streets. But what happens on rainy nights? Do they immediately transform into their recognizable forms?
II'm sure many Anomaly Hunters share this curiosity, but I might be the only one daring enough to investigate firsthand. The result, however, might disappoint you: Nothing happened! That imagined scene of thin, elongated tentacles twisting and stretching from the umbrella to form a suited office worker shakily standing up—it never occurred! Was it simply not planning to join its companions in the hunt?
After consulting an expert in Anomaly research, they provided this explanation: It makes sense if we view their stationary behavior as standing guard. Normally, we're dragged into Rainman territory when we get too close, right? Perhaps their appearance marks the connection point between their world and ours. They might stay rooted as beacons for their companions to find their way home, standing firm until the rainy night passes.
So, in a way, they're actually quite loyal to one another, aren't they?

Content.SourceString:
那天是我第四十八次面试失败，先前还有投出去并毫无回应的一百二十份简历。
从末班车下来后，我穿着老妈买的西装，公文包里还装着第一百六十九号至一百八十号简历。路过工地时，我看到地里好像插着一根棍子。
我不知道为什么要去好奇一根出现在工地中的棍子，但是我也没什么事情做，手机上毫无回应的邮箱界面泛着惨白的冷光，刚好能照见那根棍子——不，是武士刀。
我觉得这是一种暗示，一种解脱。
我发誓我当时只是想拔出来看看能不能换一顿晚饭，结果我刚碰到刀柄周围就起雾了，然后一只穿着西装的手突然出现拔出了那把刀，和我身上这件西装一模一样！！！它，那个胳膊，或者说我的右手，握着那把刀就朝我冲了过来！
太可怕了！太可怕了！太可怕了！！！
现代西装和古旧武士刀的搭配真是太可怕了！我的右手还是更适合用来写简历啊！
「附件1 孝志-简历.zip」
Content.LocalizedString:
That day marked my 48th failed interview, with 120 resumes sunk into the job market.
After getting off the last bus, I was wearing the suit bought by my mom, with my briefcase holding Resume 169 to Resume 180. Passing by a construction site, I saw a rather peculiar stick stuck in the ground.
I don't know what made me curious about a stick at a construction site, but I had nothing better to do. The cold light from my phone's rather empty email screen just happened to illuminate the stick—that was not a stick, but a katana.
I felt it was a hint, a kind of liberation, some form of divine intervention.
I swear I only wanted to pull it out to see if I could sell or pawn it for dinner, but as soon as I touched the hilt, fog arose around it. A hand appeared, pulling out that blade, wearing the same suit as I was! It, that arm, or rather, MY RIGHT HAND, holding that blade, charged towards me!
Nope! Nope! Nope!
Not how I imagained the crossover of a modern suit and an ancient katana! Better keep my hands on me so I could keep writing those resumes.
"ATTACHMENT 1: Takashi_resume_final_181.zip"

Content.SourceString:
我已经打过很多次市政电话了，这鬼地方到底在建什么啊，什么时候能建完啊？
早上？早上怎么能动工，早上是要拿来睡觉的好吧？晚上？那晚上更别说了，天黑就别干活了，开灯不要钱啊？雨天也别修，弄得这附近全是泥水，晴天也不好，那个灰尘乱飞，难受死了。
所以我说，什么时候能建好啊？又不是我不让你们弄，现在挂把刀在那是什么意思啊？赶紧的，别管早晚也别管天气了，该建什么建什么，拖着很影响我房租的啊！
Content.LocalizedString:
I've called the hotline many times. What is even being built here? Will it ever be finished?
Morning? Drilling and thumping in MORNING? Isn't the morning for sleeping? Evening? Even less so. When it gets dark, stop working. Daylight saving time was invented for a reason! Don't work on rainy days either, it's all muddy around here, and on sunny days, the dust flies everywhere, it's unbearable.
So, I ask, will it ever be finished? It's not like I'm protesting against the entire project, but don't get me started with that blade stuck in the dirt now. Did some cosplayer got into the site and halted all your progress? Get your arses together, work day, work night, work rainy, work sunny, work whatever, I honestly don't care, but get it done. It's affecting housing prices 'round here.

（异象管理局录音）
小姐……女士，可以开始了？
事情要从前天傍晚说起。我跟兄弟们吃饭，那几个小兔——呃，家伙，轮流跟我拼肚量。我们喝掉的海特威瓶子在桌边堆成小山，把店家都吓到了。
最后不记得谁赢了，也不记得几点散的伙，我只知道是在那条巷子碰到的它。
当时，我深一脚浅一脚地拖着自己在泥地里迈步，头痛到要爆炸，路灯一会是两个，一会是四个……看了没几眼，我就扶着墙哇哇吐。然后……然后那家伙就出现了。
我看见墙里突然伸出两对……三对手臂，朝我抓来。 「真可爱！爷刚吐，闻着味儿就来收罚金了？」我一下来了精神，想把它从墙上拽下来揍一顿，结果脚一滑……就什么都不记得了。
您问我醉成这样，怎么记得具体地点？嘿嘿，确实不记得。等我醒来，人已经在医院了，一翻手机，就看到治安所发来的罚款短信。您看，这儿写了我被发现的时间地点，还附带了呕吐物的照片……咦，图片有点小。请稍等，我来点击放大！

(BAC recording)
Miss… Madam, can we start?
The story begins the evening before last. I was having dinner with my buddies, and those ass… uh, guys, were taking turns challenging my drinking capacity. The Heitwein bottles we finished were piled up like a small mountain by the table, scaring the store owner.
In the end, I don't remember who won or what time we dispersed. All I know is I encountered it in that alley.
At the time, I was stumbling through the mud, my head pounding as if it would explode. The streetlights were sometimes two, sometimes four… After a few glances, I leaned against the wall and vomited. Then… then that thing appeared.
I saw two pairs… three pairs of arms suddenly extend from the wall, reaching for me. "How cute! I just threw up, and you're here to collect the fine this quick?" I suddenly felt energized and wanted to pull it down from the wall and give it a beating, but my foot slipped… and then I remembered nothing.
You ask how I remember the exact location despite being so drunk? Haha, I really don't. When I woke up, I was already in the hospital. I checked my phone and saw the fine message from the Security Office. Look, it even states the time and place I was found, along with a photo of the vomit… Oh, the picture is a bit small. Content.SourceString:
治安所案件记录：催泪瓦斯包裹事件
记录内容：
清晨5时47分，治安所接到报案电话，报案人为市民乔许。根据乔许电话中的描述，他在晨练的途中，路过巷子听到有人呼喊救助，走近先是闻到辣椒的刺鼻气味，紧接着眼睛感到剧烈刺痛、流泪不止。推测其遭遇了催泪瓦斯。
警员于5分钟后赶到案发地，见到了报案人乔许。催泪瓦斯泄露处为户外，有害气体已经散去，乔许并无大碍。警员在附近搜寻，很快发现了另一名伤者，以及一地破损的塑料瓶。该伤者身着速递员工作服，被发现时紧闭双目、咳嗽不止。转送到医院后，次日，速递员特伦特来到治安所进行案件笔录。
据特伦特描述，那天凌晨他接到一个加急单，要求6点将包裹准点送至广场约定处。取货时，特伦特没有看见寄件人，其费用是在网上提前支付完成。虽然感到有些怪异，特伦特也并未多想。在途经广场东侧的小巷时，特伦特描述自己被某物绊倒。包裹里是易碎物品，特伦特立即上前检查，没注意到墙上的彩色涂鸦动了起来，墙里伸出手臂将包裹抢夺过去。
特伦特察觉到可能遭遇了异象，他想将包裹夺回再逃走。抢夺过程中，彩色涂鸦怪物从墙体中钻了出来。
据特伦特回忆，包裹受到剧烈摇晃，发出轻微的嘶嘶声。怪物将包裹抛至空中，包裹突然炸开，而怪物则踏上滑板扬长而去。在浓烈刺鼻的气味中，很快特伦特便睁不开眼，只能呼救。
特伦特呼救时间点与报案人乔许的描述吻合。
后续会重点调查包裹寄件人，自制催泪瓦斯弹已严重违反海特洛法律，若包裹顺利送达至人员密集的广场中心，极可能造成更为严重的后果。
记录备注：
彩色涂鸦怪物——形似人，身形高大；身体由鲜艳色块组成，与墙面喷漆相似；使用滑板。（已通知异象管理局）
Content.LocalizedString:
Security Office Case Record: Tear Gas Package Incident
Record Content:
At 5:47 AM, the Security Office received a report call from citizen Josh. According to Josh's description in the call, while jogging in the morning, he passed an alley and heard someone calling for help. Upon approaching, he first smelled a pungent chili odor, and then his eyes felt intense pain and he couldn't stop tearing up. It is suspected that he encountered tear gas.
Officers arrived at the scene five (5) minutes later and met the reporter Josh. The tear gas leak was outdoors. The gas had dissipated, and Josh was unharmed. Officers searched the vicinity and quickly found another injured person, along with scattered broken plastic bottles. The injured person, wearing a courier uniform, was found with eyes tightly shut and coughing uncontrollably. After being transferred to the hospital, the next day, the courier, Trent went to the Security Office for a case record.
According to Trent, he received an urgent order that early morning, requiring a package to be delivered to the square by 06:00 sharp. When picking up the goods, Trent didn't see the sender, and the payment was completed online in advance. Although finding it odd, Trent didn't think much of it. While passing through a small alley on the east side of the square, Trent described being tripped by something. The package contained fragile items, so Trent immediately went to inspect it, not noticing the colorful graffiti on the wall moving. Arms extended from the wall and snatched the package away.
Trent sensed he might have encountered an Anomaly and wanted to retrieve the package and escape. During the struggle, the colorful graffiti goof emerged from the wall.
According to Trent's, the package was shaken violently and emitted a faint hissing sound. The creature threw the package into the air, and it suddenly exploded, while the creature rode off on a skateboard. Amid the strong pungent smell, Trent soon couldn't open his eyes and could only call for help.
The timing of Trent's distress call matches the description from the reporter Josh.
The follow-up will focus on investigating the package sender. Homemade tear gas is a serious offense against Hethereau laws; and if the package had successfully reached the densely populated square center, it could have caused more serious consequences.
Record Note:
Colorful Graffiti Monster; humanoid, tall; body composed of bright colors, similar to wall spray paints; uses a skateboard. (BAC informed)

DisplayText.SourceString: 波普对藏匿处选择有特殊的喜好。根据这种特性，可以尝试主动引诱它现身。发现后与之交战并击败它，即可泯除。这种喜好随着涂鸦潮流的变迁，或许会发生改变，后续需要持续观察记录。
DisplayText.LocalizedString: Bopp has a special preference for hiding spots. Based on this trait, Bopp can be lured out. Once discovered, engage and defeat it to complete nullification. This preference may change with the shifts in graffiti trends, requiring continued observation and record.

DisplayText.SourceString: 波普对藏匿处选择有特殊的喜好。根据这种特性，可以尝试主动引诱它现身。发现后与之交战并击败它，即可泯除。波普的战斗力并不强，滑板倒是运用自如，要小心它打不过就开溜。
DisplayText.LocalizedString: Bopp has a special preference for hiding spots. Based on this trait, Bopp can be lured out. Once discovered, engage and defeat it to complete nullification. Bopp's combat power isn't strong, but it's adept at using skateboards, so be cautious of it escaping when losing.

DisplayText.SourceString: 波普对藏匿处选择有特殊的喜好。根据这种特性，可以尝试主动引诱它现身。发现后与之交战并击败它，即可泯除。这种喜好随着涂鸦潮流的变迁，或许会发生改变。而波普的涂鸦本身，似乎也在促进海特洛街头文化的发展。艺术只是人类荒谵的妄想吗？若是如此，异象是否也能参与其中？
DisplayText.LocalizedString: Bopp has a special preference for hiding spots. Based on this trait, Bopp can be lured out. Once discovered, engage and defeat it to complete nullification. This preference may change with the shifts in graffiti trends. Bopp's graffiti itself seems to be promoting the development of Hethereau street culture. Is art merely a human delusion? If so, can Anomalies participate in it too?

VisionDesc.SourceString:
伴随从天际流淌下来的水柱一路洄游至此的，是无实体、半透明的鲤鱼们。遵照长年维持的规律，这些鲤鱼只有在完成特定的某种试炼后，游回天上，该异象现象才能暂时告一段落。
偶尔有市民会被那梦幻般的奇观所吸引，加之发现徘徊的鲤鱼并无恶意而靠近。需要注意它们具有对「龙门」发起挑战的强烈本能。当没有找到「龙门」时，则会转而向经过的生物发起其他形式的挑战。
虽然在古代，「龙门」试炼的形式一般是准备万全严阵以待的歌舞仪式等，但现在这种现象出现得相当频繁，并没有这个余裕每次都去通过优雅和平的方式处理。
VisionDesc.LocalizedString:
Accompanying the water columns flowing down from the sky to this place are intangible, semi-transparent carps. According to long-standing rules, these carps can only return to the sky after completing a specific trial, temporarily ending this Anomaly.

Occasionally, citizens are drawn to this dreamlike spectacle, and upon discovering that the wandering carps have no ill intentions, they approach. It is important to note their strong instinctive drive to challenge the Dragon Gate. When they cannot find the Dragon Gate, they will turn to other forms of challenges with passerbys..

Although in ancient times, the Dragon Gate trials were typically elaborate song and dance ceremonies, nowadays, this phenomenon occurs quite frequently, and there is no luxury to handle it elegantly and peacefully every time..

HouseCondition.SourceString: 充当自天洄游之鱼的试炼
HouseCondition.LocalizedString: Complete the trial of the Dragon Gate.

AnnihilateCondition.SourceString: 使「洄天鱼幡」完成对飞跃「龙门」的挑战
AnnihilateCondition.LocalizedString: Enable the Skyfish Banner to complete the trial of leaping over the Dragon Gate.

VisionDesc.SourceString:
伴随从天际流淌下来的水柱一路洄游至此的，是无实体、半透明的鲤鱼们。遵照长年维持的规律，这些鲤鱼只有在完成特定的某种试炼后，游回天上，该异象现象才能暂时告一段落。
偶尔有市民会被那梦幻般的奇观所吸引，加之发现徘徊的鲤鱼并无恶意而靠近。需要注意它们具有对「龙门」发起挑战的强烈本能。当没有找到「龙门」时，则会转而向经过的生物发起其他形式的挑战。
虽然在古代，「龙门」试炼的形式一般是准备万全严阵以待的歌舞仪式等，但现在这种现象出现得相当频繁，并没有这个余裕每次都去通过优雅和平的方式处理。
如果本次的飞跃以失败告终，鲤鱼们将游回高空消失，等待下次挑战。很可惜，从人类社会安全的角度，需要尽力保证他们每次都无法通过这样的试炼——也就是异象危险等级不会因此提升。
VisionDesc.LocalizedString:
Accompanying the water columns flowing down from the sky to this place are intangible, semi-transparent carps. According to long-standing rules, these carps can only return to the sky after completing a specific trial, temporarily ending this anomaly.

Occasionally, citizens are drawn to this dreamlike spectacle, and upon discovering that the wandering carps have no ill intentions, they approach. It is important to note their strong instinctive drive to challenge the Dragon Gate. When they cannot find the Dragon Gate, they will turn to other forms of challenges with passerbys..

Although in ancient times, the Dragon Gate trials were typically elaborate song and dance ceremonies, nowadays, this phenomenon occurs quite frequently, and there is no luxury to handle it elegantly and peacefully every time..

If this leap ends in failure, the carps will swim back to the sky and disappear, waiting for the next challenge. Unfortunately, from the perspective of human society's safety, ensuring they fail each trial is necessary—meaning the Anomaly's threat rating will not increase.

HouseCondition.SourceString: 充当自天洄游之鱼的试炼
HouseCondition.LocalizedString: Complete the trial of the Dragon Gate.

AnnihilateCondition.SourceString: 帮助「洄天鱼幡」完成对飞跃「龙门」的挑战，不论结果成败
AnnihilateCondition.LocalizedString: Assist the Skyfish Banner in completing the trial of leaping over the Dragon Gate, regardless of success or failure.

Content.SourceString:
嘿！我们正在征集对运动能力有自信的人！尤其是做后卫的……足球？篮球？橄榄球？不是运动社团的也行啦，你是哪个部的都行！我们实际上还找了跳街舞的人来，「奇闻部」的大家为了这事还提前换了个新摄像机，因为那异象出现的瞬间特别惊艳，能拍到的话效果绝对会特别好。
我们想做的，是拍一个小型活动纪录片作为暑假实践，内容就是尝试通过以前的方法来泯除「起潮洄天」这种现象异象，呃，放在古时候或许应该叫……「退治」？「退散」？
啊无所谓啦，你知道吗？那个异象，虽然算是个奇观异象，异象猎人们不是基本上只要通过战斗就能处理掉吗？确实是很简单粗暴啦，但是据说最传统的做法是放一个「龙门」在那——我会请手工艺部的人帮我们做一个纸糊的。总之需要通过一些像竞技游戏一样的流程阻止那些鱼越过「龙门」，而那些鱼也会使出各种花招陪我们玩儿，只要我们足够诚心诚意地成为试炼中的一分子，即使结果是飞跃失败，它们也会满足离去的。
很有趣吧？我也觉得很有趣，如果这个方法可行的话，岂不是就连我们也能做到泯除异象这种事！我觉得这是一个好机会，我们社团也能算跨过革命的一步……
呃、不好，教导主任来了……！这事下次再商量吧，你回去记得考虑一下啊！放假前给我答复！
Content.LocalizedString:
Hey! We are recruiting people confident in their athletic abilities! Especially those who play as defenders… Football? Basketball? Rugby? It's fine even if you're not in a sports club, you can be from any department! We've even found street dancers! Everyone from the occult club got a new camera just for this occasion, hoping to capture the stunning moment when the Anomaly manifests!
What we want to do is shoot a small activity documentary as a summer practice, trying to use old methods to nullify the Phenomenon Anomaly "Tidal Ascension". Uh… maybe "exorcism"? Or "dispersal"? 
Ah, anyways! You know what? That Anomaly, although it's quite a Spectacular Anomaly, aren't the Anomaly Hunters basically able to deal with it just by fighting? It's indeed quite straightforward and brutal, but supposedly the most traditional method is to place a "Dragon Gate" there—I will ask the people from the handicraft club to help us make a paper one. In short, we need to go through a process like a competitive game to stop those fish from leaping over the "Dragon Gate", and those fish will play various tricks on us. As long as we sincerely and earnestly become a part of the trial, even if the result is a failed leap, they will leave satisfied.
Interesting, isn't it? I also find it very interesting. If this method works, we might be able to nullify an Anomaly by ourselves! I think this is a great opportunity, and our club might even take a revolutionary step…
Uh-oh, the headteacher is coming…! Let's talk about this next time, remember to think about it when you go back! Give me a reply before the holiday!

Sign.SourceString:
--间宫
克莱门学园 奇闻部

Content.SourceString:
在能够查阅到的资料中，对于不慎放任「龙门」被跃过，导致异象进化后的具体详情是没有记载的。但「洄天鱼幡」有着会刻意配合对手能力和动作的倾向，我认为只要态度足够诚恳，认真地对待这场比试，就不会有太大的风险。
不过，像娜娜莉那样想往高处走尝试着去看水柱最高延伸到哪里是非常不明智的行为，很危险。
以及，像早雾那样想当然对鬼郎丸许诺说「明天给你吃鱼肉大餐」也是不可取的。即使看似被吞下去了，鬼郎丸也不会有饱腹感，只是胀着肚子……嗯……我想那里面实际含着的，恐怕只是个吐出来的水泡。所以，鬼郎丸才会很失望，回家再叫了几声饿还又被早雾骂了一顿，那时候它的样子看起来也很……迷茫。唔，我的意思是，早雾可以试着体谅一下鬼郎丸的真实情况，毕竟它其实，真的什么都没吃到……
Content.LocalizedString:
In the materials available for reference, there is no record of the specific details of an Anomaly evolving due to the inadvertent leap over the "Dragon Gate." However, the "Skyfish Banner" tends to deliberately match the opponent's ability and movements. I believe that as long as the attitude is sincere and the match is taken seriously, there shouldn't be too much risk.
However, attempting to see how high the water column extends, like Nanally, is very unwise and dangerous.
And promising Kiroumaru a "fish feast" tomorrow, like Sakiri, is also inadvisable. Even if it seems to have been swallowed, Kiroumaru won't feel full, just bloated… Hmm… I suspect that what's inside might just be a bubble of water spat out. So, Kiroumaru ends up very disappointed, goes home, cries in hunger, and gets scolded by Sakiri, as usual. At that time, it also looks very… confused. Uh, what I mean is, Sakiri could try to understand Kiroumaru's difficulties and predicament, as it, in fact, really didn't get to eat anything…

DisplayText.SourceString: 名为「起潮洄天」的异象实际上是由天上流淌而下的细长水柱河流，而「鱼幡」的幻影是组成该现象的一部分，或者说，装饰物？战斗于它们而言其实只是流于形式的「试炼」，完成后就会离去，并不会造成实际的损害。该现象出现的地点，清澈的水珠自然浮向空中，而周围悬浮有大量缤纷的鱼影，脚下绿意丛生，其美丽令人难忘。
DisplayText.LocalizedString: The Anomaly known as Tidal Ascension is actually a slender water column flowing from the sky, with the illusion of Fish Streamers being part of (or a decoration of?) this phenomenon. To them, the trial is merely a formality, which they leave after completing without causing actual damage. At the location of this phenomenon, clear water beads naturally float into the air, casting the shadows of the fishes onto the ground, with greenery at their feet. An unforgettable sight to say the least.

DisplayText.SourceString: 名为「起潮洄天」的异象实际上是由天上流淌而下的细长水柱河流，而「鱼幡」的幻影是组成该现象的一部分，或者说，装饰物？战斗于它们而言其实只是流于形式的「试炼」，完成后就会离去，并不会造成实际的损害。异象猎人协会的通用处理方案可能并不是最佳策略，但考虑到成本是可以让人理解的……这种「鱼」莫非也存在「洄游旺季」的说法？
DisplayText.LocalizedString: The Anomaly known as Tidal Ascension is actually a slender water column flowing from the sky, with the illusion of Fish Streamers being part of (or a decoration of?) this phenomenon. To them, the trial is merely a formality, which they leave after completing without causing actual damage. The general approach of the Anomaly Hunter Association may not be the best strategy, but considering the cost, it is understandable… Could it be that these "fish" also have a "migration season"?

DisplayText.SourceString: 名为「起潮洄天」的异象实际上是由天上流淌而下的细长水柱河流，而「鱼幡」的幻影是组成该现象的一部分，或者说，装饰物？战斗于它们而言其实只是流于形式的「试炼」，完成后就会离去，并不会造成实际的损害。鱼类洄游，绝大多数会在途中或目的地就死亡，而那些不灭的「鱼幡」却仿佛是特地前来促进生命的成长与循环，实在耐人寻味……
DisplayText.LocalizedString: The Anomaly known as "Tidal Ascension" is actually water columns cascading from the heavens. The phantom "Fish Streamers" are a part of this phenomenon… or perhaps, they could be considered mere ornaments? To them, a battle is nothing more than a ritualistic "trial." Once it is concluded, they vanish, leaving no actual damage in their wake. In nature, most fish die during their migration or upon reaching their destination. Yet these immortal "Fish Streamers" seem to exist solely to nurture and sustain the cycle of life. It's truly a curious thing…

VisionDesc.SourceString: 具有一定伪装能力的歧骸，偶尔以一辆具有章鱼触手的老旧拖车的形态出现在海特洛市各处的公路上。一般情况下，「拖车艄」会尽可能的遵守交通规则以融入周围的环境中，但同样存在「拖车艄」对周围的路人及设施发起攻击的情况。鉴于无法预知其在何种情况下会发起攻击，建议各位市民发现「拖车艄」存在后与其保持距离。
VisionDesc.LocalizedString: An oddity with decent camouflage abilities that occasionally appears on roads throughout Hethereau in the form of an old trailer truck with octopus tentacles. Under normal circumstances, Octowpus will try its best to follow traffic rules to blend into its surroundings, but there are also cases where Octowpus attacks nearby pedestrians and facilities. Since it's impossible to predict when it will attack, citizens are advised to keep their distance once they spot Octowpus.

HouseCondition.SourceString: 攻击「拖车艄」柔软的章鱼部分
HouseCondition.LocalizedString: Attack the Octowpus's soft octopus parts

AnnihilateCondition.SourceString: 靠近「拖车艄」的过程中，「拖车艄」会喷出墨汁以形成异象空间，或许是泯除它的关键
AnnihilateCondition.LocalizedString: Approach Octowpus to trigger its ink spray and reveal the Anomalous Realm. This might be the key to its nullification.

VisionDesc.SourceString:
"具有一定伪装能力的歧骸，偶尔以一辆具有章鱼触手的老旧拖车的形态出现在海特洛市各处的公路上。一般情况下，「拖车艄」会尽可能的遵守交通规则以融入周围的环境中，但同样存在「拖车艄」对周围的路人及设施发起攻击的情况。鉴于无法预知其在何种情况下会发起攻击，建议各位市民发现「拖车艄」存在后与其保持距离；对于各位异象猎人来说，「拖车艄」对于周围的威胁十分敏锐，一旦进入它的警戒范围便会立刻脱离伪装态准备战斗，同时会破坏周围的环境阻断交通以创立对自己有利的战斗区域。
在泯除「拖车艄」或「拖车艄」主动离开之前，任何进入战斗区域内的移动物体均会被其视作敌人并攻击，因此被阻断的交通需在「拖车艄」消失后方能恢复。"
VisionDesc.LocalizedString:
An oddity with decent camouflage abilities that occasionally appears on roads throughout Hethereau in the form of an old trailer truck with octopus tentacles. Under normal circumstances, Octowpus will try its best to follow traffic rules to blend into its surroundings, but there are also cases where Octowpus attacks nearby pedestrians and facilities. Since it's impossible to predict when it will attack, citizens are advised to keep their distance once they spot Octowpus. For Anomaly Hunters, Octowpus is highly sensitive to threats in its vicinity. Once you enter its alert range, it will immediately drop its disguise and prepare for battle, destroying the surrounding environment and blocking traffic to create a favorable battle zone for itself.
Until Octowpus is nullified or leaves on its own, any moving object that enters the battle area will be considered an enemy and attacked. Therefore, blocked traffic can only be restored after Octowpus disappears.

HouseCondition.SourceString: 攻击「拖车艄」柔软的章鱼部分
HouseCondition.LocalizedString: Attack the Octowpus's soft octopus parts

AnnihilateCondition.SourceString: 在「拖车艄」通过喷墨形成的异象空间中击败「拖车艄」
AnnihilateCondition.LocalizedString: Defeat Octowpus within the Anomalous Realm created by its ink spray.

Content.SourceString: 那天我送完最后一单，从未闻浦回桥间地的时候在Z42环海公路遇到了这玩意。一开始只看到车斗里有漏出来的章鱼触手，我还以为兄弟是运海鲜的想上去提醒下，谁知道开车追上去之后发现驾驶室里是一只大章鱼……该说不说，我这运气还挺好，遇到的是伪装态的「拖车艄」，不然我这一个月可是白干咯。
Content.LocalizedString: That day I finished my last delivery and was heading back from Unheard Shores to Bridge Crossings when I ran into this thing on Coastal Highway Z42. At first I only saw octopus tentacles sticking out of the truck bed, so I thought the guy was hauling seafood and wanted to give him a heads-up. But when I caught up to warn him, I discovered there was a giant octopus in the driver's seat… I gotta say, my luck was pretty good running into a disguised Octowpus, otherwise this whole month would've been a waste.

DisplayText.SourceString: 大多数情况下，「拖车艄」并不会主动对周围的事物发起攻击，考虑到它在受伤时可能缩回拖车内以及对进入警戒范围内的威胁过激的反应，或许「拖车艄」一切行为的底层逻辑均是为了生存。但「拖车艄」确实存在主动攻击行人以及各种设施的情况。在不确定什么会刺激它进行攻击的情况下，发现「拖车艄」后主动出击泯除或许是最佳选择。
DisplayText.LocalizedString: In most cases, the Octowpus does not actively attack surrounding objects. Considering that it may retreat into its trailer when injured and its extreme reactions to threats entering its alert range, perhaps all of the Octowpus's behavior follows an underlying survival logic. However, the Octowpus does sometimes actively attack pedestrians and various facilities. Since we cannot determine what triggers its attacks, taking the initiative to nullify it upon discovery may be the best option.

DisplayText.SourceString: 大多数情况下，「拖车艄」并不会主动对周围的事物发起攻击，考虑到它在受伤时可能缩回拖车内以及对进入警戒范围内的威胁过激的反应，或许「拖车艄」一切行为的底层逻辑均是为了生存。但「拖车艄」确实存在主动攻击行人以及各种设施的情况，即使这一行为对它的生存毫无帮助……或许「拖车艄」出现在公路上还有其他的原因？
DisplayText.LocalizedString: In most cases, the Octowpus does not actively attack surrounding objects. Considering that it tends to retreat into its trailer when injured and it has extreme reactions to threats entering its alert range, perhaps all of the Octowpus's behavior follows an underlying survival logic. However, the Octowpus does sometimes actively attack pedestrians and various facilities, even when this behavior offers no survival benefit… Perhaps there are other reasons why the Octowpus appears on highways?

DisplayText.SourceString: 大多数情况下，「拖车艄」并不会主动对周围的事物发起攻击，考虑到它在受伤时可能缩回拖车内以及对进入警戒范围内的威胁过激的反应，或许「拖车艄」一切行为的底层逻辑均是为了生存。但「拖车艄」确实存在主动攻击行人以及各种设施的情况。就算可能引起异象猎人的注意也要造成破坏，难道说它……饿了？
DisplayText.LocalizedString: In most cases, the Octowpus does not actively attack surrounding objects. Considering that it tends to retreat into its trailer when injured and it has extreme reactions to threats entering its alert range, perhaps all of the Octowpus's behavior follows an underlying survival logic. However, the Octowpus does sometimes actively attack pedestrians and various facilities. It causes destruction even when it might attract Anomaly Hunters… Could it be… hungry?

VisionDesc.SourceString:
该物品异象为一组电子音乐制作、演出设备。这些设备能在未通电的情况下运转，并组合成特定的形态、自主行动，主要活动地点为克莱门音乐角的公共演出广场。
「音霸魔王」存在类似关闭和激活的状态切换。关闭状态下，其呈现为倒放在广场中的设备，激活后，该异象将悬浮并自主行动，对广场内的人发起挑战。
挑战启动时，「音霸魔王」将播放电子音乐，并在广场内形成示意音量的荧光投影。其发起挑战行为的原因尚未探明，但可以确认的是，该异象会按照其音乐的节奏发起攻击，来迫使被挑战者做出契合律动的动作。如果被挑战者动作失误，会受到强烈的声浪攻击，严重可致昏迷。
VisionDesc.LocalizedString:
This Object Anomaly consists of a set of electronic music production and performance equipment. These devices can operate without power and combine into specific formations that move autonomously, appearing and active in the Clement Music Corner.
The Beat King can be dormant or activated. When dormant, it appears as equipment scattered across the plaza. When activated, the Anomaly hovers and moves autonomously, challenging people in the plaza.
When a challenge begins, the Beat King plays electronic music and creates glowing projections in the plaza that indicate volume levels. The reason for its challenging behavior remains unknown, but it's confirmed that the Anomaly attacks following the rhythm of its music, forcing challengers to make actions that match the beat. If challengers make mistakes, they suffer intense sound wave attacks that can cause unconsciousness in severe cases.

Content.SourceString:
诶？现在采访吗？我打卡快迟到了啦……但是解答市民的问题也是职责之一……那、那就尽快吧！
「音霸魔王」……哦！那个声音超级大的异象！我的确和它交手过！
那天我在绘空町附近执行公务，突然有个学生跑过来，说克莱门学院东侧有异象在袭击市民！我想着救人要紧，我就直接赶过去了，然后大老远就听到了那种……好像很潮很动感的音乐？我到现场一看，地上横七竖八倒着好几个昏迷的学生！那个像是一堆音响和琴键组成的异象看到了我，发出超大的声浪冲了过来……
当时可头疼了！我既不知道这个异象的习性，又不清楚学生们的受伤状况，情急之下，只能靠反应去躲开它的进攻，避免激怒它伤害学生……我慢慢发现，它的招式有种「动次打次」的固定节奏！在成功躲开几轮攻击后，我摸清了它的规律，就一边卡着节拍行动，一边把学生们扛出了它的活动范围。
还好它没有追出来，只是回到了场地中央孤零零地放歌，没过多久就安静下来，变回一堆普通设备了。说起来，那家伙身上有一股很复杂的气味……像是灰尘、铁锈，又像是烧焦的气味，让人闻着就想皱眉头！

当时救人要紧我和同事把他们送去了医院，还好都没出事……听他们说，呗果上在流行一个挑战，比谁连续躲避「音霸魔王」的攻击次数多，还会录视频发到呗果上！真是不让人省心……啊对了！还有个看热闹的家伙，也把我救人的过程录下来发上网了，明明这是不允许的！
——而且那个视频播放量超级高！评论区也都在说一些我看不懂的话，什么锁屏可打、目押大师、全连首杀……我完全看不懂啦！
Content.LocalizedString:
Huh? An interview now? I'm gonna be late clocking in… But answering citizens' questions is part of the job too… O-okay, let's make it quick then!
The Beat King… Oh! That super loud Anomaly! I definitely fought it before!
That day I was on duty near Illusion Town when suddenly a student ran up to me, saying there was an Anomaly attacking citizens on the east side of Clement Academy! I thought saving people was the priority, so I rushed right over. From way off I could hear this… really trendy, upbeat music? When I got to the scene, there were several unconscious students lying scattered on the ground! That Anomaly, which looked like a pile of speakers and keyboards cobbled together, spotted me and sent this massive sound wave charging at me…
It was such a headache! I didn't know this Anomaly's behavior patterns, and I wasn't sure about the students' injuries. In desperation, I could only rely on my reflexes to dodge its attacks while avoiding making it angry enough to hurt the students… I slowly realized its moves had this fixed "boom-boom-pow" rhythm! After successfully dodging several rounds of attacks, I figured out its pattern. I started moving to the beat while carrying the students out of its activity range.
Luckily it didn't chase after us, just went back to the center of the area and played music all alone. Before long it quieted down and turned back into a pile of ordinary equipment. Speaking of which, that thing had this really complex smell… like dust and rust, but also like something burnt, the kind that makes you want to wrinkle your nose!

Since saving people was urgent, my colleague and I rushed them to the hospital. Thankfully everyone was fine… I heard from them that there was a trending challenge on Bagel, competing to see who could dodge the Beat King's attacks the most times in a row, and they'd record videos to post on Bagel! So much trouble… Oh right! There was also some bystander who recorded me rescuing people and posted it online, even though that's not allowed!
And that video got super high views! The comments were all saying stuff I couldn't understand, like "frame-perfect timing," "combo master," "perfect clear"… I have no idea what any of that means!

DisplayText.SourceString: 在回应「音霸魔王」的挑战时，对节奏感和音乐的理解非常重要，过快或过慢的行动都可能导致错拍，从而受到音浪的攻击。但如果对于音乐、节奏方面的感受较为薄弱，就只能考虑承受影响强行收容……以后处理有相似性质的异象时，建议尽量避免派遣不了解音乐的人员。
DisplayText.LocalizedString: When responding to the Beat King's challenge, understanding rhythm and music is crucial. Actions that are too fast or too slow can cause you to miss the beat, resulting in sound wave attacks. However, if one's sensitivity to music and rhythm is weak, the only option is to endure the effects and forcibly contain it… For future encounters with similar Anomalies, it's recommended to avoid deploying personnel who lack musical understanding.

DisplayText.SourceString: 在回应「音霸魔王」的挑战时，对节奏感和音乐的理解非常重要，过快或过慢的行动都可能导致错拍，从而受到音浪的攻击。放松地感受、跟随音乐的律动摇摆起来，或许正是它所期待的回应……不过，比起一场战斗，那更像是一次兴趣相投、灵魂合拍的共舞吧。
DisplayText.LocalizedString: When responding to the Beat King's challenge, understanding rhythm and music is crucial. Actions that are too fast or too slow can cause you to miss the beat, resulting in sound wave attacks. Relaxing and swaying along with the music's rhythm might be exactly the response it expects… Rather than a battle, it feels more like a dance between kindred spirits who share the same beat.

DisplayText.SourceString: 在回应「音霸魔王」的挑战时，对节奏感和音乐的理解非常重要，过快或过慢的行动都可能导致错拍，从而受到音浪的攻击。此外，该异象疑似具备自主创作音乐的能力，且自诞生之初就引起了许多市民的关注和喜爱，建议在收容该异象后定期录制并上传它的新作，或许能为海特洛市带来更多独特且悦耳的声音。
DisplayText.LocalizedString: When responding to the Beat King's challenge, understanding rhythm and music is crucial. Actions that are too fast or too slow can cause you to miss the beat, resulting in sound wave attacks. Additionally, this Anomaly appears to have the ability to create original music, and has attracted attention and love from many citizens since its emergence. It's recommended that after containing this Anomaly, we regularly record and upload its new compositions, so it can continue to bring unique and pleasant sounds to Hethereau.

VisionDesc.SourceString:
执着于寻找并跨越「龙门」，鲤鱼们不断地从天上到此地，在失败后又返回天上。但这场看不到尽头的洄游于它们而言并非毫无收获，当经历了多次失败洄游的鲤鱼再次自天上而来，带来的暴风雨正是它们不断蜕变的证据——对于生活在这里的人们来说，伴随这场洄游而来的风雨，未尝不是潜在的祸患。
当然，尽管自身在不断地蜕变，对「龙门」的追求始终未变。它们仍然会积极地对一切可能是「龙门」的事物发起挑战……
VisionDesc.LocalizedString:
Obsessed with finding and crossing the Dragon Gate, the carp continuously descend from the heavens to this place, only to return to the sky after failing. But this endless migration is not without merit—when carp that have experienced multiple failed journeys descend from the heavens once more, the storms they bring are proof of their constant transformation. For the people living here, the winds and rains that accompany this migration are nothing if not a potential calamity.
Of course, despite their continuous transformation, their pursuit of the Dragon Gate remains unchanged. They will still actively challenge anything that might possibly be the Dragon Gate…

HouseCondition.LocalizedString: Enable the Skyfish Banner to complete the trial of leaping over the Dragon Gate.

AnnihilateCondition.SourceString: 帮助「洄天鱼幡」完成对飞跃「龙门」的挑战，不论结果成败

Content.SourceString:
那天临下班时刷到了朋友在呗果上发的夕阳照片，你们也知道，天气预报说了最近一周都是大晴天，这种天气就是容易出现质量非常高的晚霞。朋友发的照片看得我心痒痒的也想拍一张，谁知道到了窗边却发现外面下起了大暴雨……得，来上班没拿伞，回家都是个问题，只能叫外卖送个伞过来咯。至于那张夕阳的照片……说不定他现在不在海特洛呢？
等了不久伞就送到了，现在想想就很奇怪了，明明下着这么大的雨，外卖员怎么没穿雨衣还一点事都没有呢？不过当时我也没注意这么多，拿了伞收拾收拾就下楼了，结果出门发现不仅没下雨，甚至连地面都是干的！我的天，一开始我都以为我见鬼了，还是晚上刷呗果才知道到底是怎么回事……该说不说，这异象可真缺德，白给人添麻烦。
Content.LocalizedString:
So that day, just before getting off work, I was scrolling through Bagel and saw a friend's sunset photo. You know how it is—the Weather Report said it'd be sunny all week, that kind of weather always produces amazing sunsets. I wanted to snag a beautiful photo too, but it was pouring when I got outside… I didn't bring an umbrella, so getting home was gonna be a problem. I had no choice but to order an umbrella delivery! As for that sunset photo… maybe my friend isn't even in Hethereau right now?
The umbrella arrived pretty quickly, but thinking back on it now, it's really weird—it was raining so hard, so how come the deliveryman wasn't wearing a raincoat and seemed completely unbothered? I didn't think much of it at the time though. I grabbed the umbrella, packed up my stuff, and headed downstairs. But when I stepped outside, not only was it not raining, even the ground was completely dry! My god, at first I thought I was seeing things! It wasn't until I was browsing Bagel that night that I finally figured out what happened… I gotta say, that Anomaly's really messed up, what a troublemaker…

Content.SourceString:
早有人猜测挑战「龙门」即使失败也会让参与「起潮洄天」的「洄天鱼幡」变强，而「祸兮洄游」的出现印证了这一猜测……虽然「祸兮洄游」带来的天气变化仅仅只能影响一小部分区域，但仍然无法忽视它可能带来的危害，好在它的行为模式与「起潮洄天」相比变化不大……
需要注意的是，因为前往「祸兮洄游」的过程需要乘坐「洄天鱼幡」，且「祸兮洄游」常出现在比「起潮洄天」更高的楼顶，多人一同前往泯除的话一定要小心，毕竟「洄天鱼幡」能提供的落脚处有限。
还有，如果有不是很听话的契约歧骸的话，还是尽可能不要把它当做目标吧……
Content.LocalizedString:
People have long suspected that challenging the Dragon Gate, even when unsuccessful, would strengthen the Skyfish Banner participating in Tidal Ascension, and the appearance of Tides of Misfortune has confirmed this theory… While the weather changes brought by Tides of Misfortune can only affect a small area, we still cannot ignore the potential harm it might cause. Fortunately, its behavioral patterns haven't changed much compared to Tidal Ascension…
It's important to note that since reaching Tides of Misfortune requires riding the Skyfish Banner, and Tides of Misfortune often appears on rooftops higher than Tidal Ascension, groups attempting Nullification together must be very careful, as the Skyfish Banner only provides limited footing.
Also, if you have contracted Oddities that aren't very obedient, it's best not to make them your target…

Content.SourceString: 目前的鲤鱼们带来的风雨远谈不上什么灾祸，更需要防备的还是它们越过「龙门」后会出现的家伙。尽管由于年代过于久远，尤克阿什庭的记录中并没有祂的详细记载，仅有些许传闻，但在那次大灾害之后……总之，既然「祸兮洄游」出现了，或许祂的降临也不远了，望各位多关注「起潮洄天」及其衍生异象，认真对待与它们的比试，过程中有任何新情报均可上报尤克阿什庭。
Content.LocalizedString: The storms brought by the current carp are hardly what you'd call a disaster, but what we really need to guard against is whatever appears after they cross the Dragon Gate. The records are too ancient and the Yggash Court's archives contain only scattered rumors of Him, but after that great catastrophe… In any case, since Tides of Misfortune have appeared, perhaps His arrival isn't far off either. We ask everyone to pay close attention to "Tidal Ascension" and its derivative Anomalies, take your trials with them seriously, and report any new intel gathered during the process to the Yggash Court.

DisplayText.SourceString: 「祸兮洄游」作为「起潮洄天」的衍生异象，与「起潮洄天」拥有相同的奇点和伴随的「洄天鱼幡」，唯一的不同或许就是与「祸兮洄游」一同出现的暴风雨……奇怪的是，出现在「祸兮洄游」的「鱼幡」们似乎非常的……焦躁？若是对久未完成的挑战感到焦躁，是否意味着它们后续还会以更危险的形式出现？
DisplayText.LocalizedString: Tides of Misfortune is a derivative Anomaly of Tidal Ascension, sharing the same Nexus and accompanying Skyfish Banner as Tidal Ascension. The only difference might be the storm that appears alongside Tides of Misfortune… Strangely, the Fish Streamers that appear in Tides of Misfortune seem extremely… restless? If they're becoming restless over challenges that have long remained incomplete, could this mean they will appear in even more dangerous forms in the future?

DisplayText.SourceString: 「祸兮洄游」作为「起潮洄天」的衍生异象，与「起潮洄天」拥有相同的奇点和伴随的「洄天鱼幡」，唯一的不同或许就是与「祸兮洄游」一同出现的暴风雨……奇怪的是，出现在「祸兮洄游」的「鱼幡」们似乎非常的……焦躁？最直接的表现便是「迎接」对手前往「祸兮洄游」的一只「鱼幡」，尽管这一段路程有些危险，但还是非常奇妙的体验……
DisplayText.LocalizedString: Tides of Misfortune is a derivative Anomaly of Tidal Ascension, sharing the same Nexus and accompanying Skyfish Banner as Tidal Ascension. The only difference might be the storm that appears alongside Tides of Misfortune… Strangely, the Fish Streamers that appear in Tides of Misfortune seem extremely… restless? The most direct manifestation of this is a Fish Streamer that "welcomes" opponents on their way to the Tides of Misfortune. Though the journey is somewhat dangerous, it's still quite a wondrous experience…
