Content.SourceString:
居民协会会不定期举办一些免费活动，主要是为了社区内的老人和孩子。活动经费一般是平时募集来的，然后大家一块凑凑，凑够了就热闹一下。我也是被朋友喊来帮个忙，扮成玩偶逗孩子们开心一下，所以看到有个扮成大熊玩偶的人的时候我还挺震惊。别说，那玩偶服虽然看起来有点旧，上头还有几个补丁，但是他动起来特别灵活，铠甲的碰撞声听起来简直就像是真货，那套行头肯定很贵。孩子们都可喜欢他了，一个两个全围着他，爬上爬下的，活动结束了都还不肯走，连我在旁边发青蛙气球都没人要。不过活动结束后，我去找志愿者还玩偶服的时候，问他们这次怎么舍得租这么好的玩偶服，他们却告诉我说：「大熊玩偶？没有啊，我们就找了你一个。」
应该是哪个不愿透露姓名的好心人吧，算了，只要孩子们开心就好了。
Content.LocalizedString:
The Resident Association holds free events from time to time, mainly for the elderly and children in the community. The event funds are usually collected in advance, and everyone chips in together. Once we have enough, we throw a little celebration. A friend called me over to help out by dressing up as a mascot to entertain the kids, so I was pretty shocked when I saw someone else dressed as a big bear mascot. I have to say, even though that costume looked a bit worn with some patches on it, the person moved incredibly smoothly! The clanking of the armor sounded so realistic, that outfit must have been really expensive… The kids absolutely loved him. They all crowded around, climbing all over him, and even after the event ended they didn't want him to leave. Nobody even wanted the frog balloons I was handing out nearby. But after the event, when I went to return my costume to the volunteers, I asked them how they managed to splurge on such a nice bear costume this time. They told me: "Bear mascot? There wasn't one. We only hired you."
…It must have been some kind-hearted person who didn't want to reveal their identity. Oh well, as long as the kids were happy, that's all that matters.

Content.SourceString:
#我的童年伙伴
谢邀。刷到这个话题的时候，题主刚好在收拾家里，刚好翻到了小时候的日记本，还是当时小卖部里最贵的那种密码本。题主已经不记得密码了，但因为时间太久，密码锁的塑料壳子已经变得非常脆，很容易就能打开。虽然百分百肯定是自己的日记，不过陌生的字迹和毫无印象的事情，总有一种在偷看别人日记的感觉。
铺垫好像有点太长了，总之发现了一些挺有意思的东西，所以想在呗果上记录一下。
「为什么爸爸妈妈看不到妮妮呢？明明妮妮就坐在板deng上，她的白裙子好好看，我也想要和她一样的裙子，但是妈妈不给我买。」
「阿麦说他也看不见妮妮，于是我告诉他妮妮扎着两条麻花bian，穿着很好看的白裙子，和我一样高，然后阿麦也能看见妮妮了。我又告诉了林林和松子，他们也都可以看见妮妮。只有大人们看不见，好吧，果然大人们也不是什么都知道的。」
「林林说他的朋友力气很大，是真的，他可以单手举起一把椅子。阿麦的朋友有点haixiu，但是他也yuan意和我们一起玩。松子的朋友是一只白色的小狗，我们每个人都摸到了。这是我们之间的mimi。」
「妮妮是坏人，我讨厌她。」
「妮妮把她的小xiong玩具送给我了，我们和好了。」
……
「林林看不到妮妮了，我告诉他妮妮就在我旁边啊，他就说我sahuang，他不要和我玩了。明明阿麦和松子都能看到，我也不要和林林玩了。」
……
「阿麦的朋友不见了，松子的小狗也不见了。我问松子他的白色小狗呢，松子说他从来没有养过什么白色小狗，他们的朋友都不见了。」
「现在只有我能看到妮妮了。」
……
「为什么他们都看不到呢？他们都说我撒谎，我现在会查字典了。可是我没有撒谎，妮妮就在这里啊。」
「阿麦也不愿意和我玩了，所以我撒谎了，我说我也看不到妮妮了。于是我又能和阿麦他们一起玩了，但是我还是最喜欢和妮妮一起玩。」
……
后面就没再出现「妮妮」这个人了，题主发消息问了下父母，父母说题主小时候并没有名叫妮妮的小伙伴，小熊玩偶倒是买过几个，也都不知道去哪了，小时候真是充满想象力啊。
剩下日记里就没什么意思了，题主准备把这些东西都整理一下然后当废品处理了，无后续。
Content.LocalizedString:
#MyChildhoodFriends
Thanks for the invitation. When I came across this topic, I happened to be cleaning up at home and stumbled upon my childhood diary, one of those expensive password journals from the corner store back then. I couldn't remember the password anymore, but since so much time had passed, the plastic casing of the lock had become very brittle and I pried it open easily. Even though I was 100% sure it was my own diary, the unfamiliar handwriting and events I had no memory of made it feel like I was peeking into someone else's diary.
Maybe I'm setting this up too much, but anyway… I found some pretty interesting stuff, so I wanted to record it on Bagel.
"Why can't Mommy and Daddy see Nini? Nini is sitting right there on the bench, her white dress is so pretty, I want a dress just like hers too, but Mommy won't buy it for me."
"Amai said he couldn't see Nini either, so I told him Nini has two braids and wears a really pretty white dress, and she's as tall as me, then Amai could see Nini too. I also told Linlin and Songzi, and they could all see Nini. Only the grown-ups can't see her, oh well, I guess grown-ups don't know everything after all."
"Linlin said his friend is really strong, and it's true, he can lift a chair with one hand. Amai's friend is a bit shy, but he's willing to play with us too. Songzi's friend is a white little dog, and we all got to pet it. This is our secret."
"Nini is a bad person, I hate her."
"Nini gave me her little bear toy, and we made up."
…
"Linlin can't see Nini anymore, I told him Nini is right next to me, and he said I was lying, he doesn't want to play with me anymore. But Amai and Songzi can still see her, so I don't want to play with Linlin anymore either."
…
"Amai's friend disappeared, and Songzi's little dog is gone too. I asked Songzi where his white little dog was, and Songzi said he never had any white little dog, all their friends are gone."
"Now only I can see Nini."
…
"Why can't they all see her? They all say I'm lying, that I'm making it all up… But I'm not lying, Nini is right here."
"Amai doesn't want to play with me anymore either, so I lied, I said I couldn't see Nini anymore too. Then I could play with Amai and the others again, but I still like playing with Nini the most."
…
After that, "Nini" never appeared again. I messaged my parents to ask, and they said I never had a friend named Nini when I was little. They did buy me a few teddy bears though, but they don't know where those went either. Kids really are so imaginative.
The rest of the diary wasn't very interesting, so I'm planning to organize all this stuff and throw it out as recyclables. No follow-up.

DisplayText.SourceString: 伤心英熊的具体诞生时间已不可考，它将被遗忘的玩偶们都收集起来，放进自己破损的棉花心脏中。在伤心英熊的童话故事里，它会化身成为勇敢的战士，带着玩偶们和那无形的，让孩子变成大人的「怪物」，进行永远没有结果的战斗。
DisplayText.LocalizedString: The exact time of Saddy Teddy's birth is unknown. It collects all the forgotten dolls and places them inside its damaged cotton heart. In Saddy Teddy's fairy tale, it transforms into a brave warrior, leading the dolls in an endless battle against the invisible "monster" that turns children into adults.

DisplayText.SourceString: 伤心英熊的具体诞生时间已不可考，它将被遗忘的玩偶们都收集起来，放进自己破损的棉花心脏中。它诞生于孩子们不再相信童话的时候，它也消失在童话破碎的时候。但只要有孩子还愿意相信童话，伤心英熊就会继续战斗下去，因为英熊永不倒下。

It is born when children stop believing in fairy tales, and it disappears when fairy tales are shattered. Though, as long as there are children who still believe in fairy tales, Saddy Teddy will continue to fight… because hero bears never fall.

DisplayText.SourceString: 伤心英熊的具体诞生时间已不可考，它将被遗忘的玩偶们都收集起来，放进自己破损的棉花心脏中。高攻高防的伤心英熊如同故事里不败的守护神，唯有胸口的旧伤成为了阿喀琉斯之踵。究竟是谁为它缝合这道旧伤？
DisplayText.LocalizedString: The exact time of Saddy Teddy's birth is unknown. It collects all the forgotten dolls and places them inside its damaged cotton heart. With high attack and high defense, Saddy Teddy is like an undefeated guardian from the stories, only the old wound on its chest serving as its Achilles' heel. Who exactly stitched up this old wound for it?

VisionDesc.SourceString:
「长明灯」是随着电灯的发明，一起随之出现的异象。
该异象常在夜间小巷中出现，偷取附近的电力。当其出现时，周围区域会完全停电，并伴以弥漫的黑色雾气，致使整个街区陷入黑暗之中，对周围居民的生活造成较大影响。同时，其对电力的偷取行为也会导致供电设施损坏。
偷取电力为自己充满电后，该异象会进入饱食状态并逐步进化，异象等级随之逐步提升，需求的电力也会越来越多。
VisionDesc.LocalizedString:
Eternal Lamp is an Anomaly that emerged alongside the invention of electric lighting.
This Anomaly commonly appears in nighttime alleyways, stealing electricity from the surrounding area. When it manifests, the surrounding region experiences complete power outages accompanied by spreading black fog, plunging entire city blocks into darkness and significantly disrupting the daily lives of nearby residents. Additionally, its electricity theft causes damage to power supply circuit boards.
After stealing electricity to fully charge itself, the Anomaly becomes "full" and gradually evolves, with its anomaly level progressively increasing and its electricity demands growing ever greater.

VisionDesc.LocalizedString:
Eternal Lamp is an Anomaly that appeared alongside the invention of electric lighting.
This Anomaly commonly appears in nighttime alleyways, stealing electricity from nearby sources. When it manifests, the surrounding area experiences complete power outages accompanied by a pervasive black fog, plunging entire city blocks into darkness and significantly impacting the daily lives of nearby residents. Additionally, its electricity theft causes circuit board damage to power supply facilities.
After stealing electricity to fully charge itself, the Anomaly becomes "full" and gradually evolves, with its Anomaly level progressively increasing and its electricity demands growing ever greater.
Eternal Lamps collapse when they take excessive damage. If other active Eternal Lamps are present in the area, they will move to their fallen companions to charge and resurrect them. Once all Eternal Lamps in the same area have collapsed, they will simultaneously undergo nullification.
This Anomaly seems particularly stingy with its stored electricity, strictly controlling power usage with each attack. If its electricity is extracted externally, it will exhibit fierce resistance.
After the Anomaly's nullification, power facility damage caused by its behavior will automatically restore, and the surrounding fog will dissipate.

Content.SourceString:
这几天我们这儿老停电，一到晚上就黑灯瞎火的，什么都看不见。
一开始大家说是区域检修，以为第二天就好了，结果第二天还是这样，大家又以为第三天就能好，结果好多天过去了，晚上还是没有电，这才有人觉得不对劲。
我听别人说，是有个偷偷摸摸的「省电侠」在作怪，那家伙看不惯我们这儿每天灯火通明热热闹闹的，觉得这样浪费电，所以一到晚上就把这片电闸全拉了。但我觉得有点没道理啊，省下来的电费又进不了他的口袋，何苦呢？
你问我为什么看起来对这件事一点也不担心？
……猜猜我每天晚上要在公司加班到几点？晚上家里有电还是没电，对我根本就没什么影响……
Content.LocalizedString:
We've been having constant blackouts around here lately. Every night it's pitch black and you can't see a thing.
At first everyone said it was just routine maintenance, and figured it'd be fixed the next day. The next day was the same though, so we thought it'd have be fixed by the third day. Well, many days have passed now and we still have no power at night, that's when people started to think something was off.
I heard from others that it's some sneaky "Power Saver" causing trouble. The guy can't stand how our area is all bright and lively every day, thinks it's a waste of electricity, so every night he goes and cuts the power to this whole block. But that doesn't make much sense, right? The money he saves on electricity bills doesn't go into his pocket anyway, so what's the point?
You're asking why I don't seem worried about this at all?
…Guess how late I have to work overtime at the company every night? Whether there's power at home or not makes absolutely no difference to me…

Content.SourceString:
XX月XX日
今天执行的是「长明灯」的收容任务，本来一切都很顺利，收容也很快完成了。但不知道为什么，我脑子忽然抽了个风，想到要是把灯里的电力抽出来，会不会更保险一些……
结果它就爆炸了。幸好样本不止一只……

XX月XX日
听说「长明灯」从零角实验室逃出来了，原因是实验室小规模停电，针对它的收容措施暂时失效。印象里实验室的管理应该很严格吧，理论上不会停电？
跟实验室的朋友打听了下情况，听说是因为「长明灯」耗电太多，实验室来不及交电费才导致了停电……说不定，这家伙就是为了享受实验室的免费电力，才故意被抓住的吧？
还好这次重新收容的任务没安排到我头上，我真是对它有心理阴影了……

XX月XX日
啊？又要收容长明灯？我？之前不是安排给别人了吗？那次任务失败了？好吧……
Content.LocalizedString:
XX/XX
Today I carried out an Eternal Lamp containment mission. Everything was going smoothly at first, and the containment was completed quickly. But for some reason, I had a momentary lapse in judgment and thought that draining the electricity from the lamp might be safer…
It exploded. Good thing there was more than one specimen…

XX/XX
I heard that an Eternal Lamp escaped from Zerogon Laboratory because of a small-scale power outage at the lab, which temporarily disabled its containment measures. I thought the lab's management was supposed to be really strict? In theory, there shouldn't be any power outages, right?
I asked a friend at the lab about the situation, and apparently it was because the Eternal Lamp consumed too much electricity that the lab couldn't pay the electric bill in time, which caused the blackout… Maybe it deliberately got itself caught just to enjoy the lab's free electricity?
I'm glad that re-containment quest wasn't assigned to me, I really have trauma from dealing with it…

XX/XX
Huh? I have to contain an Eternal Lamp again? Me? Wasn't it assigned to someone else before? Did that mission fail? Alright then…

Since Eternal Lamps are so fond of electricity, there might even be cases where different Eternal Lamps in the same area compete with each other for power…

VisionDesc.SourceString:
"该异象外形上为美术教室常见的素体人偶，关节处为活轴，可模仿人类肢体进行活动，目前数量未知。人偶不具备隐私和羞耻意识，不爱穿着服饰，因其只在夜间「20—6点」出现，有效避开了该校风纪管理上的漏洞。
早期素徊偶也曾尝试在日间行动，帮一名患有「睡眠延迟综合症」（该病多发于青少年、夜猫型作息者之间）的学生进行代课，在老师点到该生姓名时，因人偶缺乏正常的声带发音功能，遭到老师当众批评「你是木头吗」之后果然一语成谶，致使该老师因过度惊吓诱发心疾，代课人偶被拆除后永久封存于杂物室。
目前学校区域内，仍能监测到活动迹象的人偶有欢迎型、疾跑型、猜杯型、演奏型和捉迷藏型……其均表现出强烈的社交需求，会主动发起「人偶游戏」，以此获取人类对象的陪伴互动。当人偶感受到「关注度」下降时，可能导致其对游戏对象产生「惩罚意识」，建议尊重人偶的「游戏规则」，拒绝游戏等于主动认输，它们从不惩罚违规者……但游戏会永远进行下去。"
VisionDesc.LocalizedString:
This Anomaly appears as standard artist mannequins commonly found in art classrooms, with articulated joints that allow them to mimic human limb movements. Their current numbers remain unknown. The dolls lack any sense of privacy or shame and show no interest in wearing clothing. Since they only appear during nighttime (20:00–06:00), they effectively avoid violating the school's dress code policies.
Early on, the Wandering Puppets attempted daytime activities, including substituting for a student suffering from Delayed Sleep Phase Syndrome (a condition common among teenagers and night owls). When the teacher called the student's name during attendance, the doll's inability to produce normal vocal sounds led to the teacher publicly criticizing it with "Are you made of wood?" This comment proved prophetic, causing the teacher to suffer a heart condition from excessive shock. The substitute doll was subsequently dismantled and permanently stored in the storage room.
Currently, dolls with detectable activity within the school grounds include Welcome-type, Sprint-type, Shell Game-type, Performance-type, and Hide-and-Seek-type variants. All exhibit strong social needs and actively initiate "games" to gain companionship and interaction from human targets. When the dolls sense declining attention, they may develop punitive attitudes toward their game partners. It is recommended to respect the dolls' game rules—refusing to play equals voluntary surrender. They never punish rule-breakers… but the games will continue forever.

VisionDesc.SourceString:
"对于「素徊偶」展现出来的怪异举止，所有遭遇者均描述了一种「被刻意引导参与游戏」的既视感，这是否暗示其具有「渴望陪伴」的需求。
若参与者主动向人偶提出「演出邀约」，所有异常活动会立即停止，转变为充满礼节性的互动——演奏人偶会主动让出钢琴凳，并在游戏对象演奏时为其翻谱；烘焙人偶的杯子下，藏着为游戏对象精心烹制的美味甜食；跑步人偶比起速度，更喜欢和游戏对象肩并肩，在操场上漫无目的地转圈，享受晚风吹拂身体的感觉。
当人偶感受到参与者予以的善意回应后，孤独感消弭，会自行返回美术室，之后一周内不再活动。
建议维持每月一次的「人偶联谊会」，这是目前最有效的收容措施——它们要的从来不是赢下游戏，它们只是想要朋友。"
VisionDesc.LocalizedString:
Regarding the strange behaviors exhibited by the Wandering Puppets, all witnesses describe a sense of "being deliberately guided to participate in games." This may suggest they possess a need for companionship.
When participants actively propose "performance invitations" to the dolls, all abnormal activities immediately cease and transform into courteous interactions. The musical doll will voluntarily give up the piano bench and turn pages for the participant during their performance; beneath the baking doll's cup lies delicious sweets carefully prepared for the participant; the running doll prefers to jog shoulder-to-shoulder with participants rather than compete for speed, aimlessly circling the playground together while enjoying the evening breeze.
Once the dolls sense kind responses from participants, their loneliness dissipates. They'll then return to the art room on their own, remaining inactive for the following week.
It is recommended to maintain monthly "Social Gatherings" as this is currently the most effective containment measure. They never wanted to win the games—they just wanted friends.

Content.SourceString:
最近学校里突然冒出一堆怪事，搞得大家人心惶惶，作为奇闻社社员，我已洞悉了背后的规律，并总结成手记《关于校内神秘现象的六大不靠谱猜想》，经费有限，不做印刷，请大家自发传递。
（警告：观测手记禁止在教导主任可视范围内传阅）

「无限循环的105教室」，这只能是教导主任的手笔！「补课型自律教室」！专门用来惩罚爱抄作业的学生，受罚者将不断重写同一道题，直至产出原创答案。想要离开105教室……思考是唯一的钥匙。
「深夜走廊的咚咚怪响」，别怕，是体育老师的秘密特训！那些看不见的撞击，正是为了训练学生的反应能力，被看不见的东西撞到还能站稳，才能学会躲避球的入门秘技。
「烘焙教室的猜杯子游戏」，少女们的恋爱占卜罢了。在三个倒扣的摇晃杯子之间，猜中哪个杯底写着暗恋者的名字……但据我所知，猜是永远猜不中的！因为占卜者一定会否认！但这样才是青春啊。对错并不重要，要紧的是占卜者的反应，往往视线还在逃避，呼吸已叛变成鼓，杯子轻撞叩问的是心跳，少女的脸红胜过言语。
音乐教室里，似乎有架「喜欢自娱自乐的钢琴」——没人弹奏时就会在半夜自弹自唱，拿手曲目是《G大调数学之舞》，曲目精密繁复，听完真的像上了堂数学课。弹累了……还会用低音区弹摇篮曲哄自己睡觉，真是只顾自己开心，不顾他人死活的钢琴啊！值得内心脆弱的同学学习。
操场上「瞬移的作弊人偶」——这是田径社某位前辈的执念！由于比赛时总被超车，才会疯狂练习「偷跑」技巧，时间久了想要赢的执念就诞生出这个人偶。现在裁判老师一低头，它就瞬间跑没影，技艺已修炼得炉火纯青。
还有两个神秘的「魔术师人偶」，一个擅长「隐身逃遁」，一个擅长「使人漂浮后瞬移」。这背后肯定有一个荡气回肠的故事！比如，它们是被诅咒的共生体，曾是一对亲密的人类兄弟，私生子哥哥，从小就是隐形的「家族阴影」，存在感被抹去后，一生不得出现在公众的视野里。弟弟是向往自由的继承人，但诅咒让他永远无法摆脱控制，因此心底萌生出强烈的逃避欲，将人定格在「即将触碰」的安全距离内，拒绝任何人的靠近。
两个魔术师人偶彼此触碰才能解除诅咒，但能力设计上……它们永远无法触碰到彼此。这就是命运的逗弄，戏谑又充满恶意。

结论：总之……这些怪异现象虽不致命，却会让人陷入无尽麻烦。期末临近，要是被缠上错过考试就完蛋了。请大家务必小心！毕竟……你也不想被关进循环的105教室补习吧？
Content.LocalizedString:
Strange incidents have been popping up all over school lately, leaving everyone on edge. As a member of the Mystery Club, I've uncovered the patterns behind these events and compiled them into my notes: "Six Unreliable Theories About Campus Supernatural Phenomena". Limited budget means no printing—please share this manually.
(Warning: Do not circulate these observation notes within the dean's line of sight)

"Forever 105"—this has to be the dean's handiwork! A "Remedial Self-Discipline Classroom!" Specifically designed to punish students who love copying homework. Those being punished must rewrite the same problem over and over until they produce an original answer. To escape Room 105… you'll have to use your brain, literally…
"Mysterious Thumping in Late-Night Hallways"—don't worry, it's the PE teacher's secret training! Those invisible impacts are meant to train students' reflexes. If you can stay standing after being hit by something invisible, you'll master the basics of dodgeball.
"Cup Guessing Game in the Baking Classroom"—just girls doing love divination. Among three upside-down shaking cups, guess which one has your crush's name written on the bottom… but from what I know, you'll never guess right! The person guessing will always deny it! Well, that's what youth is all about. Right or wrong doesn't matter—what's important is the guesser's reaction. Often their eyes are still looking away while their breathing has already betrayed them like a drum. The cups gently tap, questioning heartbeats, and a girl's blush speaks louder than words.
In the music room, there seems to be a "Piano That Loves Entertaining Itself"—when no one's playing, it performs solo concerts at midnight. Its specialty is "Mathematical Dance in G Major," a piece so intricate and complex that listening to it really feels like attending a math class. When it gets tired… it even plays lullabies in the lower register to put itself to sleep. What a selfish piano that only cares about its own fun and not others' well-being! Worth learning from for students with fragile hearts.
On the playground, there's a "Teleporting Cheater Doll"—this is some track team senior's obsession! They were always getting overtaken during races, and even frantically practiced techniques to avoiding false starts. Over time, their strong desire to win gave birth to this doll. Now whenever the referee looks down, it instantly vanishes, having perfected its craft.
There are also two mysterious "Magician Dolls"—one specializes in "Invisibility and Escape," the other in "Making People Float Then Teleport." There must be an epic story behind this! For instance, they're cursed symbiotes who were once a pair of close human brothers. The illegitimate older brother was always the invisible one in the family. His presence erased, forbidden from appearing in public view for life. The younger brother was an heir yearning for freedom, but the curse made it impossible for him to escape control. This bred a strong desire to flee, freezing people at a safe distance, refusing anyone's approach…
The two magician dolls can only break the curse by touching each other, but their abilities are designed so that they can never get close to one another. This is fate's mockery—playful yet full of malice.

Conclusion: Anyway… while these weird phenomena aren't deadly, they'll trap you in endless trouble. With finals approaching, getting caught up in this and missing exams would be disaster. Everyone please be careful! After all… you wouldn't want to be locked in the looping Room 105 for remedial study, would you?

Content.SourceString:
我从来没想过，那个被丢在美术室的素描人偶会成为我的搭档。
它叫「咔嗒」，是个坏掉的模型——毕竟它的左腿关节松了，右手食指也缺了一截。但上周五晚上，我一个人在教室练习素描时，它在我眼前动了起来。
我连忙遮住画作，向咔嗒道歉，它长得可比我画出来好看多了。咔嗒却很感激我，用断掉的食指比了比画面，我这才发现，自己虽然画技拙劣，却依靠想象将咔嗒的手掌补全了。
素描追求真实，所有人都会着重「刻画」咔嗒的残缺，而我误打误撞地……抚平了它的「疤痕」。
接下来的事情简直像做梦。我就算草草勾出轮廓，咔嗒也会在第二天变成一模一样的姿势，同学们无不艳羡我「超写实」的画功，只有我知道角落里的人偶正微微调整着肩膀的角度——使其看起来和我画面里的高度一致。
「天赋怪！这双眼睛简直是照相机！」美术老师激动的声音在走廊回荡。在她的盛赞之下，校长找到我，让我给全校老师画肖像，用来更新教师墙。
我硬着头皮画完后，内心如一片死水。
原来，没有咔嗒我根本不行……这个念头让我在凌晨撬开了美术室的门锁。人偶静静立在月光里，我颤抖着去碰它的手掌，请求咔嗒再帮我一次。它没有表情，但你似乎就是能在那张空白面孔上，感受到它在沉思。
然后它的脖子僵硬地、咔哒咔哒地点了点头。
但是……它好像误会我的意思了。
我是想让人偶帮我「作弊」啊！趁着夜色溜进每个老师家里，把我画得不对称的数学老师的脸真的打歪，把忘画了的校长的头发剪成地中海，把不小心给体育老师加的「欧拉拳套纹身」在现实里也给他纹上……总之，只要把真实世界的人，变得跟我的画一样，我不就永远是天才了嘛！
可是咔嗒却把105教室变成了无限延伸的白色牢笼，然后在画架前不断变换着姿势，告诉我只有画对才能离开。起初我以为它在开玩笑，但当我发现无论如何拧动门把手，背后都是105教室时，我意识到它是认真的。
画纸很快淹没了脚踝，每当我即将画完，那该死的关节又会「咔嗒」一响，耍赖地变动姿势，这样下去只能是徒劳，我永远画不出一模一样的咔嗒！
直到某个凌晨，我崩溃地掀翻画架。咔哒突然静止了，它用缺指的手指向满地画稿——那些被我认为是废稿的纸上，从最初的僵硬线条到最后几乎要跃出纸面的生命力，曾经没有的技法与天赋，在这段时间的苦练里，早已被画笔记住。
月光穿过人偶松脱的关节，在地板上投下星群般的斑点，我才明白这间画室原来没有锁，或者说……是我在和自己「较量」的过程中，真正找到了推开门的力量。
Content.LocalizedString:
I never imagined that the sketch mannequin abandoned in the art room would become my partner.
Its name is Click-Clack, it's a broken model.  Its left leg joint is loose and its right index finger is missing a piece. Anyway, last Friday night, when I was alone in the classroom practicing sketches, it started moving before my eyes.
I quickly covered my artwork and apologized to Click-Clack—it looked so much better than what I had drawn. But Click-Clack was grateful to me, pointing at the drawing with its broken finger. That's when I realized that despite my clumsy drawing skills, I had used my imagination to complete Click-Clack's palm.
Sketching pursues realism, and everyone would focus on depicting Click-Clack's flaws, but… I had accidentally smoothed over its scars…
What happened next felt like a dream. Even when I roughly sketched an outline, Click-Clack would pose exactly the same way the next day. My classmates all envied my hyperrealistic drawing skills, but only I knew that the mannequin in the corner was subtly adjusting its shoulder angle—making it match the height in my drawing.
'You're a natural! Those eyes are like a camera!' The art teacher's excited voice echoed through the hallway. Under her praise, the principal approached me and asked me to paint portraits of all the school teachers to update the faculty wall.
After forcing myself to finish the paintings, my heart felt like stagnant water.
I realized I was nothing without Click-Clack… This thought drove me to pick the art room lock at dawn. The mannequin stood quietly in the moonlight. I tremblingly touched its palm, begging Click-Clack to help me one more time. It had no expression, but somehow you could sense it was deep in thought on that blank face.
Then its neck stiffly nodded with a click-clack sound.
But… it seemed to misunderstand what I meant.
I wanted the mannequin to help me cheat! Sneak into each teacher's house under cover of night, punch the math teacher's face crooked to make it look just how I'd drawn it asymmetrically, cut the principal's hair into a receding hairline since I'd forgotten to draw it, tattoo the PE teacher with the Ora Puncher tattoo I accidentally added… In short, if I could make the real world match my paintings, I'd be a genius forever!
But Click-Clack, it turned Room 105 into an infinitely extending white cage, then kept changing poses in front of the easel, telling me I could only leave by drawing correctly… At first I thought it was joking, but when I discovered that no matter how I turned the door handle, Room 105 was always behind me… I realized it was serious.
Drawing papers soon reached my ankles. Every time I was about to finish, that damn joint would click-clack again, cheating by changing its pose. This would be futile—I'd never be able to draw Click-Clack exactly the same!
Until one dawn, I collapsed and knocked over the easel. Click-Clack suddenly froze, pointing with its broken finger at the drawings scattered on the floor—on those papers I had considered failed drafts, from the initial stiff lines to the final works that almost seemed to leap off the page, techniques and talent I never had before had already been remembered by my brush through this period of grueling practice.
Moonlight streamed through the mannequin's loose joints, casting star-like spots on the floor. I finally understood that this art room had never been locked, but rather… it was through my struggle with myself that I truly found the strength to push open the door.

They're truly afraid of being alone.

"Please, enjoy the show. They need an audience."

VisionDesc.SourceString:
R-1851[Or]为大型生物异象，外观与鲸类相近，体表存在一对带状肉鳍和触须状异形器官，或为多种海洋生物性状的杂糅。该异象无法在现实空间中观测，而是活动于一处入口随机出现于海底隧道附近的异象空间中，所有目击者均有「驾车穿越海底隧道时突然进入异象空间」的经历，且一致声称听到了类似鲸歌的复杂鸣叫。
据目击者描述，该异象空间为一处「连接着血海的冰原」，且出现「空中的锁链」、「巨型船锚」等超现实景观。多数目击者在异象空间中选择了躲藏或下车，并被安全传送回海底隧道，极少数声称跟随R-1851[Or]抵达了异象空间深处，并遭到了R-1851[Or]的攻击。历史资料显示，疑似有异象猎人小队失踪案件与该异象有关，请小心处理。
值得注意的是，包含在遭遇攻击的人员在内，所有受访者均对R-1851[Or]表达了不同程度的担忧和同情，目前暂未查明是该异象的特殊能力、异象空间对人情绪的影响，还是其他原因。
VisionDesc.LocalizedString:
R-1851(Or) is a large Bio Anomaly with an appearance similar to cetaceans, featuring ribbon-like flesh fins and tentacle-like aberrant organs on its surface, possibly a fusion of multiple marine organism characteristics. This Anomaly cannot be observed in real space, but instead operates within an Anomalous Realm whose entrance randomly appears near the undersea tunnel. All witnesses share the experience of suddenly entering the Anomalous Realm while driving through the undersea tunnel, and consistently report hearing complex calls resembling whale songs.
According to witness descriptions, this Anomalous Realm is a frozen wasteland connected to seas of blood, featuring surreal landscapes such as chains in the sky and giant ship anchors. Most witnesses chose to hide or exit their vehicles within the Anomalous Realm and were safely teleported back to the undersea tunnel. A very small number claim to have followed R-1851(Or) to the depths of the Anomalous Realm and were attacked by R-1851(Or). Historical records indicate that some Anomaly Hunter team disappearances may be connected to this Anomaly. Please handle with caution.
It is noteworthy that all interviewees, including those who encountered attacks, expressed varying degrees of concern and sympathy for R-1851(Or). It remains unclear whether this is due to the Anomaly's special abilities, the Anomalous Realm's influence on human emotions, or other reasons.

VisionDesc.SourceString:
主体为鲸鱼的大型生物异象，体侧及腹部存在多处异形器官，或为受创后愈伤组织异化形成；背部有一狭长金属突起，经确认为一老式捕鲸叉的后端，中前端已深度嵌入鲸鱼躯干。据专家推测，该捕鲸叉形态接近船载式重型捕鲸炮的配件，但其尺寸显著大于历史上应用过的所有同类型装备。推测该异象为历史捕鲸活动中遇难的鲸鱼转化而来，而其体内的捕鲸叉则同步转变为伴生型异象R-1851-1[Ob]。但需要注意的是，不同于通常的伴随或隶属关系，捕鲸叉与鲸鱼之间的共存模式更接近「寄生」。
R-1851[Or]具有特异能力，能够创造连接异象空间与现实海域的狭窄通道，并用鲸歌影响其选中的车辆驾驶员，诱导其进入通道，与它一同回归异象空间。在通道内，该异象表现相对平静，少数调查者称能感受到它在试图与自己对话。但进入异象空间后，R-1851[Or]有时会突然表现出强烈的刻板行为，伴随凄厉的嚎叫，并开始失控地攻击异象空间中的事物或调查者本人，目前原因暂未查明。
一种猜想是，R-1851[Or]所属的异象空间并非由它生成，究其内部的船锚、锁链、血海及城市景观，更有可能与R-1851-1[Ob]存在联系。R-1851-1[Ob]可能比R-1851[Or]更早转变为异象，并且具有强烈的控制、监禁、虐待行为倾向，并创造了该异象空间，囚禁了被它命中却幸存的鲸鱼并进行折磨，最终鲸鱼转变为异象，并通过各种方式引诱人类进入该空间，为它终结这漫长的苦难。该推论未经验证，也永远无法得到验证。
VisionDesc.LocalizedString:
A large Bio Anomaly with a whale as its primary body, featuring multiple aberrant organs along its sides and abdomen, possibly formed from scar tissue mutations after trauma. The back displays an elongated metallic protrusion, confirmed to be the rear end of an antique harpoon, with the middle and front sections deeply embedded in the whale's torso. Expert analysis suggests this harpoon resembles components from ship-mounted heavy whaling cannons, though its size significantly exceeds all historically documented equipment of similar type. The Anomaly is theorized to have transformed from a whale that perished during historical whaling activities, while the harpoon within synchronously converted into a parasitic Anomaly designated R-1851-1(Ob). It should be noted that unlike typical accompanying or subordinate relationships, the coexistence mode between the harpoon and whale more closely resembles parasitism.
R-1851(Or) possesses anomalous abilities, capable of creating a narrow passage connecting Anomalous Realms to actual ocean areas, and sings whale songs in the passage to influence selected vehicle drivers, luring them into the passage to go into the Anomalous Realm with it. Within the passage, this Anomaly exhibits relatively calm behavior, with some investigators reporting they could sense it attempting to communicate with them. However, after entering the Anomalous Realm, R-1851(Or) sometimes suddenly displays intense repetitive behaviors, accompanied by piercing wails, and begins attacking objects within the Anomalous Realm or the investigators themselves in an uncontrolled manner. The cause remains currently unknown.
One hypothesis suggests that the Anomalous Realm inhabited by R-1851(Or) was not generated by it. The internal ship anchors, chains, seas of blood, and urban landscapes are more likely connected to R-1851-1(Ob). R-1851-1(Ob) may have transformed into an Anomaly earlier than R-1851(Or), possessing strong tendencies toward control, imprisonment, and abuse behaviors, and created this Anomalous Realm to imprison and torture the whale it struck but failed to kill. Eventually, the whale transformed into an Anomaly and began luring humans into this space through various means, seeking to end its prolonged suffering. This theory remains unverified and can never be verified.

Content.SourceString:
我听呗果上说，走海底隧道如果凭空听到鲸鱼的叫声，有可能会进入一个特殊的异象空间，讨论度特别高——作为异象探险博主，我当时就想，当然不能放过这个赚流量的机会。
……不不不，我并不是真的想去，我甚至本来都不信，只是去海底隧道拍拍视频，后期配一点鲸鱼的叫声，再咋咋呼呼表演一下，赚点流量而已，谁想得到……
——老实说，要不是你来采访，我都不愿想起那天的事。
那天，我如常架好了车顶和车内的摄影机，在海底隧道开了一阵，开始录视频。结果，我突然听见了鲸鱼的叫声……那声音很奇特，很美，把我所有的注意力都吸走了……
等我回过神的时候，我发现周围漆黑一片，只有眼前隐隐有一条路，耳朵里鲸鱼的叫声越来越近，我完全慌了，只好加速往前开。
然后，一头……很像鲸鱼的怪物贴着我的头顶飞了过去，一道强光照的我睁不开眼，我吓得把刹车踩成了油门，猛地扎了进去……
……该死的，我想想怎么说……我冲进了一个噩梦般的地方，天上下雨，地上结冰，横断的楼房在半空飘着，几座比楼还高的船锚像墓碑一样插在血红色的海里……那头鲸鱼在红色海里哀嚎着，我感觉得到它在看我。我以为自己要死了，直接吓昏了过去……
再后来……我不记得了。我醒来时已经是在海底隧道了，我的摄像机损坏了，什么也没拍到。
但你要相信我，那绝对是真的，当时我的车胎上都还带着冰渣，那绝对不是我的噩梦……
Content.LocalizedString:
I heard on Bagel that if you drive through the undersea tunnel and suddenly hear whale calls out of nowhere, you might enter some kind of special Anomalous Realm. It was getting tons of discussion online. As an Anomaly exploration blogger, I thought to myself, of course I can't pass up this opportunity for views.
…No, no, no, I didn't actually want to go there. I didn't even believe it at first. I just planned to drive through the undersea tunnel, shoot some footage, add whale sounds in post, put on a dramatic performance, and rake in some views. Who could have known…
Honestly, if you hadn't come to interview me, I wouldn't even want to remember what happened that day.
That day, I set up my cameras on the roof and the inside of my car like usual, drove through the undersea tunnel for a bit, and started recording. Then suddenly, I heard whale calls… The sound was so strange and beautiful, it completely captured all my attention…
When I snapped back to reality, I found myself surrounded by darkness. There was only a faint path visible ahead of me, and the whale calls in my ears were getting closer and closer… I totally panicked and could only speed up, driving forward.
Then this… whale-like monster flew right over my head, and this blinding light made it impossible to open my eyes. I was so terrified I hit the gas instead of the brake and crashed right in…
Damn it, let me think about how to put this… I crashed into this nightmare of a place. There was rain falling from the sky, ice covering the ground, broken buildings floating in midair, and these massive ship anchors taller than buildings stuck in a blood-red sea like tombstones… That whale was wailing in the red sea, and I could feel it watching me. I thought I was going to die and just passed out from hyperventilating…
After that… I don't remember. When I woke up, I was back in the undersea tunnel. My cameras were damaged and didn't capture anything.
But… you have to believe me, it was absolutely real! My tires still had ice chunks on them afterward! That definitely wasn't just a nightmare…

Content.SourceString:
……事先说明，我并非以职务身份接受你的采访。
另外，我希望你的记录用词尽可能准确，避免内容偏颇，误导民众。
先说结论。我个人认为，这个异象潜在的破坏力和威胁性极大，但并非主动狩猎人类的类型，如果不慎进入异象空间，快速下车就能安全离开。
……我拒绝回答这个问题，大多数异象猎人没有到可以收容它的水平，不要贸然挑战。
我在海底隧道正常驾驶时听到了鲸鱼的声音，立刻想起了有关这个异象的记录，开始集中注意保持警戒。行驶至某个特定的位置后，我感觉车辆明显颠簸了一下，可见度骤降，鲸鱼的叫声也近了许多。我判断自己进入了异象空间。
然后它出现了，但并未表露出敌意，而是从我头顶掠过，在前方开启了一个发光的洞……像是引导我向前。我没有减速，驾车进入了那个冰原，并跟随它抵达了异象空间的中心。
你执意要问的话……算是有一些交手。
在我快要抵达异象空间深处的时候，那头鲸鱼开始发出一些不同的声音，我能感觉到它的状态有变得失控，躁动，发出非常刺耳的……鸣叫。然后，它开始向我发起攻击。
它的鸣叫……我认为并不会对人造成伤害，至少没有干预我的反应和判断……不，严格地说，还是会对状态有一些影响，但并不是直接的妨害，而是会引发一些……让人分心的哀伤情绪。
它在向我求救。
Content.LocalizedString:
First, let me clarify that I am not accepting this interview in any official capacity.
Additionally, I hope your records will use precise terminology and avoid biased content that might mislead the public.
Let me start with my conclusion. Personally, I believe this Anomaly has enormous destructive potential and poses significant threats, but it is not the type to actively hunt humans. If you accidentally enter the Anomalous Realm, you can safely exit by quickly getting out of your vehicle.
I refuse to answer that question. Most Anomaly Hunters are not at the level required to contain it. Do not attempt the challenge recklessly.
I was driving normally through the undersea tunnel when I heard whale sounds. I immediately recalled records about this Anomaly and began maintaining vigilance. After reaching a specific location, I felt the vehicle jolt, visibility dropped sharply, and the whale calls became much closer. I determined that I had entered the Anomalous Realm.
Then it appeared, but showed no hostility. Instead, it swept over my head and opened a glowing passage ahead… as if guiding me forward. I didn't slow down, instead driving into that frozen wasteland, following it to reach the center of the Anomalous Realm.
If you insist on asking… there was some combat, I suppose.
As I was about to reach the depths of the Anomalous Realm, the whale began making different sounds. I could sense that it's becoming uncontrolled, agitated, emitting very harsh… calls. Then it began attacking me.
Its calls… I believe that poses no harm, at least it didn't interfere with my reactions and judgment… No, strictly speaking, it did have some effect on my condition, but it wasn't direct interference. Rather, it induced some… distracting feelings of sorrow.
It was calling to me for help.

DisplayText.SourceString:
由遭受捕鲸船袭击的鲸鱼转化为的生物异象，背部被捕鲸叉刺入，血肉与之融为一体。该异象长期受困于一处冰川、血海构成的异象空间。捕鲸叉本身具备异象属性，其带来的痛苦正是鲸鱼在异象空间中失控的原因，但遗憾的是，由于捕鲸叉已与鲸鱼的要害部位融合，已不可能在鲸鱼存活的情况下将其移除。
目前，该异象已确认泯除。再无血海，也再无鲸歌。
DisplayText.LocalizedString:
A Bio Anomaly born from a whale attacked by a whaling vessel, with a harpoon still lodged in its back, where flesh and metal have fused into one. This anomaly has long been trapped within an Anomalous Realm of glaciers and seas of blood. The harpoon itself is a type of anomaly, and the agony it brings is precisely what causes the whale to lose control within the Anomalous Realm. Regrettably, since the harpoon has fused with the whale's vital organs, it would be impossible to remove without killing the whale.
Nullification has been confirmed. No more seas of blood, no more whale songs.

DisplayText.SourceString:
由遭受捕鲸船袭击的鲸鱼转化为的生物异象，背部被捕鲸叉刺入，血肉与之融为一体。该异象长期受困于一处冰川、血海构成的异象空间。其发出鲸歌、引导人类进入异象空间通道的目的，或许就是希望有人能明白这座囚牢的含义，并终结这漫长的折磨。
愿终有一日，生命能将彼此善待。
DisplayText.LocalizedString:
A Bio Anomaly transformed from a whale that suffered attacks by a whaling vessel, with a harpoon pierced through its back, flesh and metal fused as one. This Anomaly has long been trapped within an Anomalous Realm composed of glaciers and seas of blood. Its purpose in singing whale songs and guiding humans into the passages of the Anomalous Realm was perhaps to hope that someone might understand the meaning of this prison and bring an end to its endless torment.
May there come a day when all life treats one another with kindness.

DisplayText.SourceString:
由遭受捕鲸船袭击的鲸鱼转化为的生物异象，背部被捕鲸叉刺入，血肉与之融为一体。该异象长期受困于一处冰川、血海构成的异象空间。哀恸的鲸歌已经停止，但悲剧是否已经落幕？是否会有下一个葬身海底的幽灵？
人类给不出答案。
DisplayText.LocalizedString:
A Bio Anomaly transformed from a whale that suffered attacks by a whaling vessel, with a harpoon pierced through its back, flesh and metal fused as one. This Anomaly has long been trapped within an Anomalous Realm composed of glaciers and seas of blood. The mournful whale songs have ceased, but has the tragedy truly ended? Will there be another ghost buried beneath the waves?
Humanity has no answer to give.

VisionDesc.SourceString:
原型为工程图纸的物体异象，可在空中漂浮移动，具有主动行为能力，被多次目击于一处建筑工地，活动区域的中心疑似为该工地正在施工的大厦。
该异象疑似具备主动诱捕人类的习性，会通过展示图纸吸引目标靠近，并在目标靠近时快速展开将其包裹，随后传送至其异象空间。据亲历者称，异象空间外围存在大量类似手绘草稿的建筑群，中心区域则有一栋造型奇特的大厦，规模与工地内在建的大厦相似，但设计并不相同。
截至目前，所有进入该异象空间的目击者均在一小时内安全返回。部分目击者声称尝试攀爬了大厦的特殊外部结构，并发现了一些「会说话的设计图纸」，在阅读图纸后，感觉身边的空间发生了扭曲变化，但并未对他们造成伤害或负面影响。
VisionDesc.LocalizedString:
An Object Anomaly originating from engineering blueprints, capable of floating and moving through the air with autonomous behavioral abilities. It has been sighted multiple times at a construction site, with its activity centered around a building under construction at that location.
This Anomaly appears to exhibit active human-trapping behavior, attracting targets by displaying blueprints and rapidly expanding to envelop them when they approach, subsequently teleporting them to its Anomalous Realm. According to firsthand accounts, the Anomalous Realm's periphery contains numerous building clusters resembling hand-drawn sketches, while the central area features a uniquely designed tower similar in scale to the building under construction at the site, though with a different design.
To date, all witnesses who entered this Anomalous Realm have safely returned within one hour. Some witnesses claim to have attempted climbing the tower's unique external structures and discovered talking design blueprints. After reading these blueprints, they felt the surrounding space undergo distorted changes, though this caused them no harm or negative effects.

AnnihilateCondition.LocalizedString: In the Anomalous Realm, communicate with the strange blueprints

VisionDesc.SourceString:
原型为工程设计废案图纸的物体异象，可在空中漂浮移动，具有主动行为能力。图纸中的设计指向其所在的建筑，但该方案在建筑设计阶段被废弃。
该异象具备主动诱捕人类的习性，会通过展示图纸吸引目标靠近，并在目标靠近时快速展开将其包裹，随后传送至其异象空间。该空间疑似为设计草图在三维世界的投射，外围为手绘草图形态的建筑群，中央为符合图纸设计的建筑。该异象会将自身分散为多张图纸并在建筑各处等待，部分图纸可赋予阅读者扭曲空间的能力，生效条件尚未明确。截至目前，所有进入异象空间的目击者均在一小时内安全返回。
值得一提的是，该建筑的工程于在建设期间短暂停摆，并发生设计、承建团队更迭。据悉，该建筑最初的设计方案因风格过于特殊而被废弃，此事引起了设计团队的强烈不满，原设计师一度攀登未完工的建筑抗议，最终被驱离并免去职务。
VisionDesc.LocalizedString:
An Object Anomaly originating from discarded engineering design blueprints, capable of floating and moving through the air with autonomous behavioral abilities. The designs in the blueprints point to the building where it resides, though this proposal was abandoned during the architectural design phase.
This Anomaly exhibits active human-trapping behavior, attracting targets by displaying blueprints and rapidly expanding to envelop them when they approach, subsequently teleporting them to its Anomalous Realm. This space appears to be a three-dimensional projection of design sketches, with hand-drawn sketch-style building clusters on the periphery and a building matching the blueprint design at the center. The Anomaly disperses itself into multiple blueprints that wait throughout the building, with some blueprints capable of granting readers the ability to distort space, though the activation conditions remain unclear. To date, all witnesses who entered the Anomalous Realm have safely returned within one hour.
It's worth noting that construction of this building came to a temporary halt during the building period, with changes in both design and construction teams. According to reports, the building's original design proposal was abandoned due to its overly distinctive style, which caused strong dissatisfaction among the design team. The original architect once climbed the unfinished building in protest and was ultimately expelled and dismissed from their position.

Content.SourceString:
我就是那个工地上的，当时我们已经收工了，约着去小酌两杯。我喝到一半，突然想起工具放在楼顶没收。我记得天气预报说晚上下雨，走前还特意给机器和材料都盖了防水布，没承想忘了收工具！那玩意儿要淋了水可就坏大事了……不不，不是什么安全问题，工具坏了还能申请新的——但要扣我工资啊！这难道不坏吗？！
一想着扣工资，我当时就起身回了工地，还没上楼，就听见楼里面窸窸窣窣的声响——这大晚上的，安全员早回去了，工友在外边喝酒，门卫刚刚还在门口打盹呢，能是谁？来，你猜猜？
——嗐！当时哪能想得到是异象啊！我当然以为是贼了！像我年轻时候，可没少见上工地偷铁的毛贼……干嘛？我又没干过！你可要写清楚哈！别到时候你这委托发出去，我工作丢了！
咳……说正经的，我当时也有点怕，就拿了条水管小心凑过去……结果是一大张……报纸还是什么玩意儿，我正纳闷呢，它呼嚓一下子转过来把我给包住了！
再一睁眼，嚯！跟做梦似的，周围的房子全变成黑白样式儿的了，中间一栋大楼……好像就是我们施工的那栋，但样子不太像，外立面一大圈乱七八糟的违章结构，就悬空似的飘在那，要是安全员看了可得晕过去……
……爬？我哪敢爬！那结构看着就不稳定！再说我也想起来了，他们喝酒时是聊起过，传说工地上有个异象会把人拖进它的老巢，只要在里面什么也不做呆一会儿，就能出来。我就在那溜达了一阵，的确也出来了……唉，但我没想到，我从异象空间出来的时候，外边已经下暴雨了……
不，倒是没扣工资，毕竟我都被异象逮着了，按条例不用承担损失，但是该挨的一顿骂还是有的啦……唉……
Content.LocalizedString:
I'm the guy from that construction site. We'd already clocked out for the day and were planning to grab a few drinks, but halfway through my first beer, I realized I'd left my tools on the rooftop. I remembered the weather report said it would rain that night, and I'd even covered all the machines and materials with tarps before leaving, but somehow I forgot about the tools! If those things got soaked, it would've been a disaster… No, no, not a safety issue or anything. Broken tools can be replaced with new ones, but they'd dock my pay! Isn't that awful?!
I shot up at the thought of losing money and headed back to the site. Before I even got upstairs, I heard rustling sounds coming from inside the building. It was late at night, the safety inspector had gone home, my coworkers were out drinking, and the security guard had just been dozing at the gate… So who could it be? Come on, take a guess!
Ha! How was I supposed to know it was an Anomaly back then! Of course I thought it was a thief! Back when I was younger, I'd seen plenty of crooks sneaking onto sites to steal metal… What? I never did that myself! You better write that down clearly! Don't let this Commission get out there and cost me my job!
Ahem… seriously though, I was pretty scared, so I grabbed a water pipe and carefully crept closer… turns out it was this huge… newspaper… or whatever it was? I was still wondering what the heck it was, when… WOOSH! It spun around and wrapped me up!
Next thing I knew, whoa! Like something out of a dream, all the buildings around me had turned black and white. There was this big building in the middle… looked like the one we were working on, but not quite right? The facade had all these messy illegal structures sticking out, just floating there in mid-air. If the safety inspector saw that, he'd probably faint…
Climb? Are you kidding me! That structure looked completely unstable! Besides, I remembered what the guys had been talking about while drinking. There's this legend about an Anomaly on the construction site that drags people into its lair, and if you just stay there and don't do anything for a while, you can get out. So I just wandered around for a bit, and sure enough, I got out… But what I didn't expect was that when I came out of the Anomalous Realm, it was already pouring rain outside…
No, they didn't dock my pay after all. Since I got caught by an Anomaly, according to regulations I wasn't liable for damages. But I still got a good scolding… haaah…

Content.SourceString:
"……采访我？哼哼……没想到「柯林斯家族」的威名已经传播得这么广了——诶？不是这个？
噢……你是说那座大楼吗？我上周确实去那边转悠过，还遇到了个讨厌的异象……对！就是你说的那个，一堆乱七八糟的纸！
我当时刚在诺提克桥吃了超酥脆的青花鱼，想找座大楼来一次「360°跑酷」！一边消消食，一边还能看看风景！然后，我就相中了那栋在建的大厦……哎呀，怎么进去的你就别管了！总之我就在那栋楼上闲逛了一会儿，没一会儿就到了楼顶，然后就撞见了那个异象。
一开始，我还以为是和「碎嘴传单」差不多的家伙，想着看看纸上写了什么，还没看清，它就突然扑过来把我卷进了异象空间！一点礼貌都没有！
……里面的样子？就是一栋差不多的大厦……噢！我想起来了，在异象空间里的大厦跑酷，比外边有意思得多！它的外墙上有不少奇奇怪怪的东西，就像是专门给我设置的障碍物一样！作为「柯林斯家族」的一代目，既然收到了邀请，哪有不接受挑战的道理！
……呃——其实还是稍微遇到了点麻烦……我好不容易爬到了楼顶，但好像不算数！得收集齐那家伙放在各处的图纸才行。可我拿到它们后，完全看不懂上面画的是什么，它们倒是叽里咕噜说了一通，但我也没听明白……
总、总之！我最后还是被送出那个异象空间了！这也说明我挑战成功了……对！就是这样！"
Content.LocalizedString:
"Interview me? Heh heh… I didn't realize The Coluccis' reputation had spread so far already! Huh? T-that's not what this is about?
Oh… you mean that building? I did wander over there last week and ran into this annoying Anomaly… Right! The one you mentioned, that pile of messy papers!
I'd just finished some super crispy mackerel at Noetic Bridge and wanted to find a building for some 360 parkour! Perfect for digesting while enjoying the scenery! So I set my sights on that construction site… Hey, don't worry about how I got in…! Anyway, I just wandered around the building for a bit, and when I reached the rooftop that's when I bumped into that Anomaly.
At first, I thought it was something like a Chatterflyer, so I wanted to see what was written on the paper. Before I could get a good look, it suddenly lunged at me and pulled me into the Anomalous Realm! Hmph! No manners at all!
What was it like inside? Just a similar building… Oh! I remember now, doing parkour in that building inside the Anomalous Realm was way more interesting than outside! Its exterior walls had all sorts of weird stuff on them, like obstacles set up just for me! As the Ichi-daime of The Coluccis, how could I refuse a challenge after receiving such an invitation!
Uh… well, I did run into a little trouble… I finally managed to climb to the rooftop, but apparently that didn't count! I had to collect all the blueprints that thing had scattered around. But when I got them, I couldn't understand what was drawn on them at all. They did chatter on about something, but I couldn't make heads or tails of it…
A-anyway! I eventually got sent out of that Anomalous Realm! Which proves I completed the challenge… Right! That's exactly what happened!"

DisplayText.SourceString: 原为废弃建筑图纸的物体异象，在其最初所属的工地附近活动，会将靠近的人类拉入异象空间。在其异象空间内，可利用不同的图纸从不同方向扭曲空间，通过变换维度找到新的前进路径，不断收集图纸。虽然该异象没有危害，但异象空间内的大楼设计仍存在一定的隐患。该异象或许会很欢迎新的访客，但请收容和研究人员尽量不要因好奇而随意体验。
DisplayText.LocalizedString: An Object Anomaly originally composed of abandoned building blueprints, it operates near the construction site where it first belonged, pulling approaching humans into its Anomalous Realm. Within its Anomalous Realm, different blueprints can be used to warp space from various directions, allowing one to find new pathways forward by shifting dimensions and collecting blueprints. While this Anomaly poses no harm, the building designs within the Anomalous Realm still may present certain hazards. The Anomaly may welcome new visitors, but containment and research personnel are advised not to approach it without good cause.

VisionDesc.LocalizedString: Mammon can smell the scent of greed, and the stronger the desire, the more it's drawn to it. Wars sparked by greed were once Mammon's favorite entertainment, but in today's City, even desires only worthy of being called mere snacks are hard to come by. So, Mammon turned its attention to the wealthiest Dvořák family, and the richest cat in the Dvořák household, Ladon. Pink Paws Bank and the Gold Apple Collection Hall became the two places where Mammon appears most frequently.

Content.SourceString: 这只猫在我们呗友群里还挺有名的，我们最开始都觉得它应该是有主人的，流浪猫很少能这么干净，更别说它身上那些亮闪闪的装饰品，有个呗友是做珠宝行业的，他说这一套上随便一颗宝石都够在米格尔区中心买套大平层了。但奇怪的是，我们不少人都在喂流浪猫的时候见过它，它脾气还蛮好的，虽然不给摸但是也不咬人，群里有人想收养它，结果吃完冻干它就跑了，猫毛都没抓到一根。说起来，我几次遇到它的时候，它还蛮霸道的，每次我带过去的小鱼干全都是它一个人吃完的，吃完还蹭我，让我继续喂它，可能就是太能吃了所以才会变成流浪猫的吧。
Content.LocalizedString: This cat is pretty famous in our pet lover group. At first, we all thought it must have an owner since stray cats are rarely this clean, not to mention all those shiny accessories it wears. One of our group members works in jewelry, and he said any single gem from that collection could buy you a large open flat in central Miguel District. Here's the weird part: lots of us have seen it while feeding strays. It has a pretty good temperament, won't let you pet it but doesn't bite either. Someone in the group tried to adopt it, but after finishing the Froze'n'Dried treats, it just ran off. Couldn't even catch a single whisker. Whenever I've encountered it, it's been pretty bossy. It always eats up all the fish snacks I bring, then rubs against me demanding more. Maybe it became a stray because it just eats too much?

Content.SourceString:
这是我入职粉爪银行后第63次见到玛门了，最近玛门出现在德沃夏克家族所属领地的平均频率相较于去年已经提升了103%！
一旦玛门出现，拉冬也会出现，然后它们开始打架，两只猫就打、打起来了！一般情况下负责拉冬相关事务的是德沃夏克家族的「可琳斯娜」小姐，前来处理异象收容后续事务的是异象管理局那位叫「薄荷」的收容组成员，而接下这次委托的是来自伊波恩的异象猎人「娜娜莉」……
呜——！！！！！这个城市里有好多猫！
Content.LocalizedString:
This is the 63rd time I've encountered Mammon since joining Pink Paws Bank. Recently, Mammon's average appearance frequency in Dvořák family territory has increased by 103% compared to last year!
Once Mammon appears, Ladon shows up too, and then they start fighting. The two cats just start… attacking each other! Generally, Ladon-related matters are handled by Kolinsna from the Dvořák family, and Anomaly containment follow-up affairs are managed by that Containment Units member Mint from the Bureau of Anomaly Control, and this commission was taken on by Anomaly Hunter Nanally from Eibon…
Waaah! There are so many cats in this city!

DisplayText.SourceString: 玛门总是因为心中的欲望得不到满足而躁动不安，就算将粉爪银行的金库全部吞下也填不满贪婪的沟壑，最多也只是陷入暂时的沉睡。当旧的欲望被填满，又有新的欲望源源不断的产生，而对于金钱这一欲望，玛门从来都没有得到满足。
DisplayText.LocalizedString: Mammon is always restless and agitated because the desires in their heart remain unsatisfied. Even if they were to devour the entire vault of Pink Paws Bank, it still wouldn't fill the chasm of greed, and at most would only lead to a temporary slumber. When old desires are fulfilled, new desires will inevitably emerge, and when it comes to the desire for money, Mammon has never found satisfaction.

DisplayText.SourceString: 玛门总是因为心中的欲望得不到满足而躁动不安，就算将粉爪银行的金库全部吞下也填不满贪婪的沟壑，最多也只是陷入暂时的沉睡。玛门执着于侵占拉冬的财宝，某种意义上来说，粉爪银行其实是玛门的猫抓板吧。

Even if they were to devour the entire vault of Pink Paws Bank, it still wouldn't fill the chasm of greed, and at most would only lead to a temporary slumber. Mammon is obsessed with seizing Ladon's treasure. In a way, Pink Paws Bank is really just Mammon's scratching post.

VisionDesc.SourceString:
「你看到」源自一位天才画家的画作，这位画家意识到画作的欺骗性以及我们双眼的欺骗性，依托这一发现，他在作品中绘制了大量充满错视幻觉的奇妙图像。
于是，异象「你看到」在画家某一幅画的画布上诞生了。画布联通了纸上世界和现实世界，在观察者的视觉中构建出一个新的「画布」。当观察者意识到画作和现实的联系性后，会被带入一个奇诡的异象空间。
最初创作这些异象画作的画家已经辞世，他生前的画作流传在世界各地，这些画作均带有异象性质，常有人因此被带入异象空间。
VisionDesc.LocalizedString:
"What You See" originated from the work of a brilliant artist who recognized both the deceptive nature of paintings and the deceptive nature of our own eyes. Building upon this discovery, he created numerous wonderful images filled with optical illusions in his works.
Thus, the Anomaly "What You See" was born on the canvas of one of the artist's paintings. The canvas connects the world on paper with the real world, constructing a new "canvas" within the observer's vision. When the observer becomes aware of the connection between the painting and reality, they are drawn into its strange Anomalous Realm.
The artist who originally created these anomalous paintings has passed away. His works from his lifetime are scattered around the world, and all of these paintings possess anomalous properties. People are often drawn into the anomalous realm because of them.

此异象空间中充斥着怪诞的景物与画作，通过调整视角、改变眼中的画面，能够将空间中的某些部分联系起来，而这些被联系起来的部分，会被具象到异象空间中。观察者能够借助这一具现化方式离开此处。
该异象并不具备危险性，被带入异象空间的观察者仅仅是在其中进行类似梦境的体验，不会影响其身体和精神。离开异象空间后，观察者会发现自己仅仅是「走神片刻」而已。

This Anomaly poses no danger. Observers drawn into the Anomalous Realm simply experience something similar to a dream, with no effects on their body or mind. After leaving the anomalous realm, observers find that they have simply spaced out for a moment.

Content.SourceString:
我是在米格尔区郊游的时候看到这幅画的。一个怪异的木头人指着这幅画，我不明白那是什么意思，而且木头人的样子也有点渗人……所以我就赶紧走开了。可走开之后，我还是忍不住想回头看看那画里是什么，就这么一回头，我发现画里的门，和画板背后的门框重合了。
「还挺有意思的」，我这么想的瞬间，就被带到了异象空间里。我不是第一次进异象空间了，所以也没那么害怕。
异象空间里的谜题很简单，无非是错位和联想，我很快就找到了出口。
在走出去前，我又回了一次头。这些房间的模样虽然奇诡，但也很温馨，待久了又觉得很美。一个念头突然冒出来——我能不能就一直在这儿待下去呢？
另一个念头把它挡住——可是明天还要上学，后天还要考试。
走出来之后，感觉刚才的经历就像是走了个神，轻飘飘的，甚至天边的云都没有挪动几分。
要是真的在里面一直待下去，会发生什么呢？
Content.LocalizedString:
I discovered this painting while on a trip to Miguel District. A strange wooden figure was pointing at it, but I couldn't understand what that meant. Plus, the wooden figure looked kind of creepy… so I quickly walked away. But after walking off, I couldn't help wanting to turn back and see what was inside the painting. The moment I turned around, I noticed that the door in the painting lined up perfectly with the door frame behind the canvas.
"That's pretty interesting," I thought, and in that instant, I was transported into the Anomalous Realm. This wasn't my first time entering an Anomalous Realm, so I wasn't that scared.
The puzzles inside were simple enough, just matters of perspective. I was able to quickly find the exit.
Before leaving, I turned around one more time. Though these rooms looked bizarre, they also felt cozy, and the longer I stayed, the more beautiful they seemed. A sudden thought occurred to me: could I just stay here forever?

Another thought pushed it aside: I have school tomorrow, and an exam the day after.
After escaping, the whole experience felt like I had just spaced out for a moment. It was so light and fleeting that even the clouds in the sky hadn't moved much.
What would happen if I really did stay inside forever?

Content.SourceString:
木头小姐邀请我看她家的门，然后带我进去作客。她家很大，有三个房间，房间里悬挂着太阳、月亮和骨头。门藏在影子里，影子藏在灯光里，灯光藏在眼睛里。我穿行在太阳和月亮之间，他们默不作声地邀请我观看他们互相拥抱和吞食。
我们的影子跟在身后，但影子不是我们。他们手牵着手跳舞，脚下是书和骨头。我也同他们一样在墙壁和光束的缝隙中穿行，巨大的和渺小的都在我的眼睛里没有区别，光照会把一切都压扁，我的眼睛也把看到的所有压扁，然后压扁的和压扁的重叠成一幅新的画，在画里我是自由的，我踩上压扁的台阶，向木头小姐道别。
……怎么了？为什么这么看着我？
……这些事听起来很奇怪吗？这就是我昨天遇见的事情呀。
你想去那看看吗？你想去的话，我可以带你去呀~
Content.LocalizedString:
The wooden lady invited me to see the door to her home, then brought me inside as a guest. Her house was huge, with three rooms that had suns, moons, and bones hanging in them. Doors were hidden in shadows, shadows were hidden in light, and light was hidden in eyes. I walked between the sun and moon as they silently invited me to watch them embrace and devour each other.

Our shadows followed behind us, but the shadows weren't us. They danced hand in hand, with books and bones beneath their feet. I moved through the gaps between walls and beams of light just like they did. In my eyes, the massive and the tiny made no difference. The light flattened everything, and my eyes flattened everything I saw too. Then the flattened things overlapped with other flattened things to create a new painting. In that painting, I was free. I stepped onto the flattened stairs and said goodbye to the wooden lady.

…What's wrong? Why are you looking at me like that?

…Do these things sound strange? This is what happened to me yesterday.

Do you want to go see it? If you want to go, I can take you there!

Sign.SourceString:

Content.SourceString:
呜哇！没想到妈妈讲的故事不是用来吓唬我的，而是真的！
我遇到过那家伙！那天，我和妈妈吵架了，午饭我都没吃就一气之下离家出走了。本来想去爷爷家躲躲，可我走着走着就迷路了。回过神的时候，发现不知道为什么走到了很暗的地方，周围还起了好大的雾，什么都看不清。那个地方静悄悄的，偶尔有两声怪鸟在叫。一下子让我觉得心里毛毛的，好吓人。
然后，我听到那家伙在叫我。很像妈妈的声音，让我快回家来，外面很危险。我没多想就「嗯」了一声。下一秒，我就被一只大爪子猛地抓了起来！吓得我闭起眼睛大喊起来……等我再被放下来的时候，已经到了一个空空的很像鸟巢的地方。把我带来的是一只戴面具的大鸟，它把我围在它的翅膀里。我就偷偷从羽毛的间隙里往外看，巢里也是阴森森的，中央有颗特别特别大的蛋。我猜是大鸟的蛋宝宝，可那个蛋已经破掉了……
大鸟说话了，和雾里的那个声音一模一样。让我永远留在它、留在妈妈身边，但我说：「你不是我的妈妈呀？」它变得很生气。这时候外面闯进来一个人，我就大喊「哥哥救我！」。哥哥把我救了出去，还给我糯米团子吃。糯米团子冷掉了，但很好吃。
嗯？中间的事？哥哥说小孩子不要看，我就没看。我很听话的。
Content.LocalizedString:
Whoa! I never knew the stories mom told me weren't just to scare me. They're real!
I've actually met that thing! That day, I had a fight with mom and ran away from home without even eating lunch. I was gonna hide at grandpa's place, but I got lost… When I came to my senses, I found myself in a really dark place for some reason, with thick fog all around. I couldn't see anything! It was so quiet there, except for some weird bird calls every now and then. It gave me the creeps… So scary!
Then I heard it calling me. It sounded just like mom, telling me to come home because it was dangerous outside. I said "okay" without thinking. The next second, a huge claw grabbed me! I was so scared I shut my eyes and screamed… When I was put down again, I was in a place that looked like a bird's nest. The thing that brought me there was a big bird wearing a mask, and it wrapped its wings around me. I peeked through the gaps in its feathers, and the nest was all dark and creepy too. There was a really, really big egg in the middle. I thought it was the big bird's baby egg, but it was already broken…
The big bird spoke, and it sounded exactly like the voice in the fog. It told me to stay with it forever, to stay with mommy. I said, "You're not my mom though?" Then it got really angry. Suddenly, someone burst in from outside, so I shouted, "Save me!" He rescued me and even gave me some mochi to eat. The mochi was cold, but it was yummy.
Hm? What happened in between? He told me not to look because I'm just a kid, so I didn't. I'm a good kid.

Content.SourceString:
当时在城郊处理一些私事，突然听到有小孩的声音，就循着动静去看了看。嚯，眼皮子底下发生拐骗小孩的事，我可不能当没看见。
具体处理的细节不用说很清楚吧？要的吗？欸，可是说得那么详细很麻烦欸。别的记不清了，那鸟叽叽喳喳骂我是企图夺走它孩子的「有罪之人」，好吵。
能否总结下「囿巢鸟」筑巢地点和掳走孩童事件的规律？便于今后能及时展开救援？这……不太好说。据我所知，这鸟是对「母亲身份」有某种近乎变态的执念。拼命筑起宽阔舒适的豪华大巢，不过是为体现它是位含辛茹苦的母亲罢了。真要是位认真负责的母亲的话，为何不哺育自己的孩子，而是执着于偷走其他人的孩子，当作自己的来养？
亲生孩子不正是因为自己失职才「走失」的么？
至于为什么我会对那孩子的声音敏感，能在第一时间找到他。
没有孩子会在墓地玩吧？当时是这么想的。
Content.LocalizedString:
I was handling some personal matters on the outskirts when I suddenly heard a child's voice. Followed the sound to check it out. Heh, no way I could just ignore a kidnapping happening right under my nose.
Do I really need to go into the gory details? You want them? Ugh, such a hassle. I don't remember much anyway. That bird kept squawking at me, calling me a "thief" trying to steal its child. So noisy.
Can I summarize any patterns about where the Nestbound Bird builds its nest or how it abducts children? To help with future rescues? That's… hard to say. From what I know, this bird has some kind of twisted obsession with being a mother. It goes all out building this spacious, luxurious nest just to prove what a devoted, self-sacrificing mother it is. Though, if it were really such a responsible mother, why doesn't it raise its own child instead of stealing other people's children to raise as its own?
Didn't its real child go "missing" because of its own negligence in the first place?
As for why I was so keen to that kid's voice and found him so quickly…
No child would be playing in a cemetery, right? That's what I thought at the time.

习惯诱骗迷路孩童至自己巢穴中来的生物异象，得逞后绝不容许「孩子」离开巢穴。会将试图解救孩童的人视作企图偷走孩子的窃贼，对他们发起凶狠猛烈的进攻。
只顾把孩子永远囚禁在巢中的「母亲」，并非真正爱惜孩子，仅仅是把孩子视作母亲身份的必备品罢了。这种自我满足毫无意义，该让它醒醒了。
DisplayText.LocalizedString:
A Bio Anomaly that lures lost children into its nest. Once it succeeds, it never allows its "children" to leave. It views anyone attempting to rescue the children as thieves trying to steal them away, and launches vicious attacks against them.
A "mother" that only cares about keeping children imprisoned in her nest forever does not truly love them. She merely sees children as accessories to validate her identity as a mother. Such self-satisfaction is utterly meaningless. Time to give her a wake-up call.

A Bio Anomaly that lures lost children into its nest. Once it succeeds, it never allows its "children" to leave. It views anyone attempting to rescue the children as thieves trying to steal them away, and launches vicious attacks against them.

And if she truly were a mother, how could she take children away from their real mothers?

斑蝶，最早被目击出现于某学校附近，呈巨型蝴蝶状，色彩艳丽。其身体由大量电影票根状纸片组成，较为笨重，只能低空飞行，然而斑蝶似乎一直试图向高处飞行，从未成功。
关于斑蝶的诞生众说纷纭，其中最广为流传的来源，是一则关于一名叫做「蝶」的少女的都市传说，她收集无数电影票根，在电影的虚幻中迷失了自我，最后不知所踪。
传说并不完整，唯独能够肯定的是，「斑蝶」的诞生源自她的行为。

Swallowtail was first sighted near a school. It takes the form of a giant butterfly with vivid coloring. Its body is composed of numerous paper scraps resembling movie ticket stubs, making it only capable of low altitude flight. However, Swallowtail seems to constantly attempt flying higher in vain.

The legend is incomplete, but one thing is certain: the birth of Swallowtail stems from her actions.

VisionDesc.LocalizedString:
Swallowtail was first sighted near a school. It takes the form of a giant butterfly with vivid coloring. Its body is composed of numerous paper scraps resembling movie ticket stubs, making it only capable of low altitude flight. However, Swallowtail seems to constantly attempt flying higher in vain.
There are many theories regarding Swallowtail's origin. The most widely circulated source is an urban legend about a girl named Butterfly who collected countless movie ticket stubs, lost herself in the fantasy of film, and eventually vanished without a trace.
The legend is incomplete, but one thing is certain: the birth of Swallowtail stems from her actions.
Swallowtail exhibits extreme aggression toward humans. Multiple witnesses claim to have seen Swallowtail kill passersby. However, no casualties have ever occurred at sighting locations, suggesting that Swallowtail possesses the ability to create illusions.
In fact, Swallowtail only inflicts actual harm on those who attack it. Several Anomaly Hunters who attempted Nullification have been attacked, with some sustaining life-threatening injuries.

Content.SourceString:
**录音中**

我去电影院的路上见过斑蝶。一只五彩斑斓的大蝴蝶，想要飞到高处却被身上的纸片拖累，只好在地面做着逃离世界的美梦。它根本不知道，即使真飞到天上，也还是要和这个世界产生联系，逃不掉。没人能逃得掉。
*一段沉默，时长3秒*
她很怕火，她害怕那些票根被烧掉。她喜欢看电影，她觉得比起生活，电影是更「值得」的东西。一切蛰伏的都要惊起，一切悬而未决的都被许诺一个结局，不像生活总是混杂无序，在生活里她是无头苍蝇，在生活之外她可以是一只蝴蝶，甚至可以拥有独一份的庞大和艳丽。她不看话剧，因为她觉得舞台和观众席之间的墙太过薄弱，她没法说服自己相信。所以只有电影。
（另一个声音：请稍等一下，您似乎不在谈论斑蝶，您在谈论谁？）
一直是斑蝶，我没有谈论过别人。
（另一个声音：但这听起来就像是，您「认识」它一样。）
*一阵爽朗的笑声*
是啊，我认识她。

**录音结束**
Content.LocalizedString:
Recording

I saw Swallowtail on my way to the cinema. A large butterfly of vibrant colors, wanting to soar high but weighed down by the paper scraps on its body, left dreaming of escaping the world. It had no idea that even if it really flew up into the sky, it would still be tied down to this world. There's no escape. No one can escape.
3 seconds of silence
She was terrified of fire. She was afraid those ticket stubs would burn. She loved watching movies. She felt that compared to real life, movies were more worthwhile. Everything dormant would be stirred awake, everything unresolved would be promised an ending. Unlike real life, which is always a chaotic mess… In life, she was a fly bumping around aimlessly. Outside of life, she could be a butterfly, one that was uniquely magnificent and beautiful. She never watched theater, because she felt the wall between the stage and the audience was too flimsy. She couldn't convince herself to believe in it. So, it was only ever movies.
(Another voice: Excuse me, you don't seem to be talking about Swallowtail. Who are you talking about?)
It's always been Swallowtail. I haven't been talking about anyone else.
(Another voice: But it sounds like… you "knew" it.)
Hearty laughter
Yes. I knew her.

Recording Ends

Content.SourceString:
这只异象挺漂亮的，正好后院有点空，我就想着把它带回伊波恩。拿管理局带出来的旧家伙试着收容，没想到它一被收容，就变成薄薄一张纸，一点都不好看了。没办法，放出来随它去吧。
这只蝴蝶没有他们说的那么危险。小动物的保护色，是用来融入环境保护自己，但这只蝴蝶丝毫不在乎这些，把自己涂得五彩斑斓。为了这份美，它不得不面对更多的危险。表现得暴躁，也是它的自保手段。不是早就知道了吗？它不会主动攻击，它是善良的。
泯除……它表现出这个样子，被泯除只是时间问题，毕竟客观的危险没法否认。这也是它自己选的，只是可惜了这漂亮的翅膀。
Content.LocalizedString:
This Anomaly was quite beautiful. The backyard was a bit empty, so I thought I'd bring it back to Eibon. I tried to contain it using some old equipment I brought from the Bureau, but the moment it was contained, it turned into a thin sheet of paper. Not pretty at all! I shrugged, then decided to let it out and set it free.
This butterfly, it isn't as dangerous as they say. Small animals use camouflage to blend into their environment and protect themselves, but it couldn't care less about that. It painted itself in vivid colors. For the sake of that beauty, it has to face even more danger. Acting aggressive is just another way it protects itself. Don't we already know this? It won't attack first, it's gentle.
Nullification… With the way it presents itself, nullification is only a matter of time. After all, the objective danger it poses can't be denied. This was also its own choice. It's just a shame about those beautiful wings…

DisplayText.SourceString: 「斑蝶」为一只鲜艳的巨型蝴蝶，属于生物异象，身体由大量电影票根状纸片组成，较为笨重。该异象表现出较强的攻击性。虽然调查表明斑蝶只会对攻击了它的人造成实质性伤害，但由于其体型庞大易引起恐慌，具有较大的潜在危险，因此需要将其泯除。
DisplayText.LocalizedString: Swallowtail is a vividly colored giant butterfly classified as a Bio Anomaly. Its body is composed of numerous paper scraps resembling movie ticket stubs, making it rather cumbersome. This Anomaly exhibits strong aggression. Although investigations indicate that Swallowtail only causes substantial harm to those who attack it first, its massive size can easily trigger panic and poses significant potential danger. Therefore, nullification is required.

DisplayText.SourceString: 「斑蝶」为一只鲜艳的巨型蝴蝶，属于生物异象，身体由大量电影票根状纸片组成，较为笨重。该异象表现出较强的攻击性。它对外表现出攻击性，让人出现可怕的幻觉，却并不真的伤害路人，这是为什么呢？莫非，它只是在伪装？但它又为何要这样伪装呢？
DisplayText.LocalizedString: Swallowtail is a vividly colored giant butterfly classified as a Bio Anomaly. Its body is composed of numerous paper scraps resembling movie ticket stubs, making it rather cumbersome. This Anomaly exhibits strong aggression. It displays hostility outwardly, causing people to experience terrifying hallucinations, yet it never actually harms passersby. Why is that? Could it be… just putting on an act? But why would it pretend like this…?

DisplayText.SourceString: 「斑蝶」为一只鲜艳的巨型蝴蝶，属于生物异象，身体由大量电影票根状纸片组成，较为笨重。该异象表现出较强的攻击性。都市传说中的少女，以及这只庞大而美丽的斑蝶，就这样消失了。可能她和它本就不属于这里，而属于虚构的故事世界——日后，少女和斑蝶的故事，兴许会被搬上银幕吧。
DisplayText.LocalizedString: Swallowtail is a vividly colored giant butterfly classified as a Bio Anomaly. Its body is composed of numerous paper scraps resembling movie ticket stubs, making it rather cumbersome. This Anomaly exhibits strong aggression. The girl from the urban legend, along with this massive yet beautiful Swallowtail, both vanished just like that. Perhaps neither of them ever belonged here, but in a world of fiction instead. Someday, the story of the girl and the butterfly might just find its way onto the silver screen.

VisionDesc.SourceString:
该异象在触发前呈现为巨大的金色火漆形态，通常静置在平坦的街道地面上。任何不慎直接接触火漆印记的人类，都会被卷入立体书样式的异象空间，并受到其核心「瓦楞城堡」的攻击。
「瓦楞城堡」会动用弹簧拉花、红毯及纸板武器，从多角度同时发起攻势。尽管其材质看似与普通瓦楞纸板类似，但硬度、弹性与单位重量都远超寻常纸制品，破坏力不可小觑。
需要特别注意的是，虽然外观酷似某种舞台布景，但这绝非某种温和的表演——一旦误入「过期请柬」的异象空间，只有两条路可供选择：要么立即与「瓦楞城堡」拉开距离并逃离异象空间，要么与之正面对抗，彻底撕裂「瓦楞城堡」。
VisionDesc.LocalizedString:
Before activation, this Anomaly appears as a massive golden wax seal, typically resting stationary on flat street surfaces. Any human who accidentally makes direct contact with the wax imprint will be transported into a pop-up book style Anomalous Realm and attacked by its core entity, the Cardboard Castle.
The Cardboard Castle employs spring-loaded streamers, red carpets, and cardboard weapons to launch simultaneous attacks from multiple angles. While it appears similar to ordinary corrugated cardboard, its hardness, elasticity, and unit weight far exceed normal paper products, making its destructive power considerable.
It's particularly important to note that while it may look like stage scenery, this is absolutely not a gentle performance. Once you accidentally enter the Expired Invitation's Anomalous Realm, there are only two options: either immediately distance yourself from the Cardboard Castle and escape the Anomalous Realm, or face it head-on and completely tear apart the Cardboard Castle.

HouseCondition.LocalizedString: Tear down the Cardboard Castle

VisionDesc.SourceString:
该异象在触发前呈现为巨大的金色火漆形态，通常静置在平坦的街道地面上。任何不慎直接接触火漆印记的人类，都会被卷入立体书样式的异象空间，并受到其核心「瓦楞城堡」的攻击——这似乎是某种手段过于强硬的「邀请」，显而易见的是，「过期请柬」并不懂得真正合宜的待客之道。
「瓦楞城堡」会动用弹簧拉花、红毯及纸板武器，从多角度同时发起攻势。尽管其材质看似与普通瓦楞纸板类似，但硬度、弹性与单位重量都远超寻常纸制品，破坏力不可小觑。
虽然「瓦楞城堡」具有相当程度的攻击力，但其机动性却与力量成反比。只要与「瓦楞城堡」保持足够距离，便可以自行脱离异象空间。一旦目标逃离，异象空间将暂时关闭，恢复为无害的金色火漆形态，留待下一个无辜的过路人。
鉴于其存在时长并无定数，等待其自然泯除并非上策。具备实力的异象猎人可通过彻底撕裂「瓦楞城堡」，将「过期请柬」完全泯除。异象泯除后，火漆将自行燃烧殆尽，并在原地留下一个宝箱。
关于宝箱的来由，目前的研究尚未有明确结论。一种主流且具有想象色彩的推测认为，这或许是原本为「宴会」宾客准备的「伴手礼」。
VisionDesc.LocalizedString:
Before activation, this Anomaly appears as a massive golden wax seal, typically resting stationary on flat street surfaces. Any human who accidentally makes direct contact with the wax imprint will be transported into a pop-up book style Anomalous Realm and attacked by its core entity, the Cardboard Castle. This appears to be some form of overly forceful invitation, and it's clear that the Expired Invitation has no understanding of proper hospitality.
The Cardboard Castle employs spring-loaded streamers, red carpets, and cardboard weapons to launch simultaneous attacks from multiple angles. While it appears similar to ordinary corrugated cardboard, its hardness, elasticity, and unit weight far exceed normal paper products, making its destructive power considerable.
Though the Cardboard Castle possesses significant attack power, its mobility is inversely proportional to its strength. Maintaining sufficient distance from the Cardboard Castle allows one to escape the Anomalous Realm independently. Once the target flees, the Anomalous Realm will temporarily close and revert to its harmless golden wax seal form, awaiting the next innocent passerby.
Given that its duration is indefinite, waiting for natural Nullification is not advisable. Capable Anomaly Hunters can completely nullify the Expired Invitation by thoroughly tearing apart the Cardboard Castle. After Nullification, the wax seal will burn itself out completely, leaving behind a treasure chest at the original location.
The origin of this treasure chest remains unclear in current research. One mainstream and imaginative hypothesis suggests it may have been the "party favor" originally prepared for the "banquet" guests.

HouseCondition.SourceString: 撕毁「瓦楞城堡」
HouseCondition.LocalizedString: Tear down the Cardboard Castle

AnnihilateCondition.LocalizedString: End the Banquet

Content.SourceString:
"……呃，这个我也要填写吗？好吧……
事情是这样的，我是个艺术家，平时喜欢搞搞街头艺术。但最近不是「波普」闹得很凶吗？我常去的几面涂鸦墙都被它们霸占了。你们也知道，「波普」不像人类艺术家那么好商量，凶得很，谁要是胆敢覆盖它们的大作，准得挨揍！咳，扯远了——我实在没地方发挥灵感，灵机一动，打算在街头找几个井盖来美化，不碍事，也不影响市容，治安所应该也不会有意见……吧！
我觉得自己简直是个天才，赶紧拎着油漆去找井盖。结果刚走到街上，就看到远处好像有个圆形的、金灿灿的东西，看着像个带花纹的井盖——我还以为是和同行想到一块去了，就凑近了想仔细瞧瞧……谁知道周围突然冒起一阵雾，等雾散开，天就变得昏黄一片，四周到处都是瓦楞纸板做成的树啊、路灯啊……还有一座城堡，像舞台剧的布景似的。
都到这时候了，我还以为是那个同行搞的装置艺术，一点儿没害怕。可正琢磨着，那个城堡就像活了一样，先是弹出几条彩带，又架起一堆机枪大炮，朝着我就开火。吓得我什么也顾不上了，扭头就跑……跑出去老远，回头再看，已经什么都没有了。抬头再看天，也是蓝色的，就像做了场梦一样。
我可没有惋惜的意思！幸亏那诡异的东西没追上来……但你别说，那个立体书设计得还真挺有创意的，让人灵感迸发……我、我就是说说。下次，我肯定老老实实找面空墙涂鸦，再也不敢灵机一动了！"
Content.LocalizedString:
"…Uh, do I have to fill this part out too? Alright then…
So here's what happened. I'm an artist, and I usually dabble in street art. But lately, the Bopp been causing quite a ruckus. They've taken over all the graffiti walls I usually go to! You know how it is, the Bopp aren't as reasonable as human artists. They're really aggressive! Anyone who dares to paint over their masterpieces is gonna get beaten up! I'm getting off track here… Anyway, I really had nowhere to express my creativity, so I had a bright idea to find some manholes on the street to beautify. Wouldn't get in anyone's way, wouldn't mess up the city's appearance, and the Security Office probably wouldn't mind… right?
I thought I was a genius, so I grabbed my paint and went looking for manholes. But as soon as I got to the street, I saw something round and golden in the distance that looked like a patterned manhole cover. I thought maybe a fellow artist had the same idea, so I got closer to take a better look… Suddenly, fog started rising all around… when it cleared, the sky had turned a sickly yellow color. There were trees and streetlights made of cardboard everywhere… and this castle that looked like a stage prop from a play.
Even then, I still thought it was some installation art by that fellow artist, so I wasn't scared at all. While I was trying to figure it out, that castle sprung to life! First it shot out some streamers, then it set up a bunch of machine guns and cannons and started firing at me. I got so scared I couldn't think about anything else and just ran… I ran really far, and when I looked back, everything was gone. When I looked up at the sky, it was blue again, like it was all just a dream.
I'm not saying I miss it or anything! Thank goodness that creepy thing didn't chase after me… Though, I have to admit, that pop-up book design was actually pretty creative and really sparked my imagination… I'm just saying, next time, I'm definitely going to stick to finding empty walls for graffiti. No more bright ideas!"

Content.SourceString:
"异象管理局内部文件

权限：内部公开
部门：收容二组
提交人：薄荷

关于「过期请柬」收容失败的检讨报告

今天收容异象C-1704「过期请柬」时出了意外，都是我搞砸了。接到市民求助后，我和组员立刻抵达现场，进入了「过期请柬」的异象空间，优先保证了受困市民的安全，随后准备按流程完成异象收容工作。按照《新收容安全条例》，我们提前准备好了收容容器，但在削弱异象时，看到它那两条纸拉花晃啊晃啊，我突然一阵心痒，不知怎的就扑过去了……等反应过来的时候，那两条拉花已经被我拽了下来，异象直接泯除了……我们只好把它遗留下的宝箱带回了局内，现在放置在临时收容层，预备之后作为异象衍生物单独处理。现在想来还是好奇怪，为什么会这样呢……难道说这个异象还有精神控制的能力？预习资料的时候我明明没睡着啊……

总之！我对此次失误深感愧疚，郑重向其他组员道歉，对不起！我的组员们在这次收容行动中操作完全规范，申请只扣我一个人的工资！T T

组员意见1：工资倒是小事，下次还是别让薄荷再出这种……有彩色条状物的异象的收容任务了。
组员意见2：也尽量不要让她出有毛线球的任务……"
Content.LocalizedString:
Bureau of Anomaly Control Internal Document

Clearance: Internal Public
Department: Containment Unit 2
Submitted by: Mint

Review Report on Failed Containment of Expired Invitation

An incident occurred during today's containment of Anomaly C-1704 Expired Invitation, and it's all Mint's fault… After receiving a citizen's distress call, Mint's team immediately arrived on scene and entered the Expired Invitation's Anomalous Realm. We prioritized ensuring the safety of the trapped citizen, then prepared to contain the Anomaly according to protocol. Following the New Containment Safety Protocol, we had prepared the containment vessel in advance, but while weakening the Anomaly, Mint saw those two paper streamers swaying back and forth, and suddenly felt this irresistible urge and lunged at them… By the time Mint came to her senses, those two streamers were already torn down, and the Anomaly was directly nullified… We had no choice but to bring back the treasure chest it left behind to the Bureau. It's currently placed in Temporary Containment, scheduled to be processed separately as an anomalous derivative later. Looking back, it's still really strange. Why did that happen? Could this Anomaly also have had mental control abilities? Mint definitely wasn't asleep when reviewing the materials…

Anyway! Mint feels deeply guilty about this mistake and formally apologize to the other team members. Mint is sorry! My teammates operated completely according to protocol during this containment operation. Mint requests that only my salary be docked! T T

Team Member Opinion 1: The salary is a minor issue, but next time let's not assign Mint to containment quests for Anomalies with… colorful dangling objects.
Team Member Opinion 2: Also try not to assign her to quests with yarn balls…

Sign.SourceString:
--薄荷
异象管理局收容二组
Sign.LocalizedString:
- Mint
Bureau of Anomaly Control, CSU-2

DisplayText.SourceString:
「过期请柬」惯以童书一样无害的面貌引诱访客深入，待对方真正接近时却骤然发难。它就像一口危险的陷阱，但却连等待猎物深入而无法脱身都缺乏耐心，迫不及待地想要亮出獠牙。它的行为，或许更像是一种情绪的宣泄。
除非摧毁作为核心的「瓦楞城堡」将其泯除，否则这一场场闹剧似的「宴会」将永无止境。「过期请柬」泯除后，火漆自行焚毁，只留下一个宝箱，像某种不合时宜的礼物。如果按照「『过期请柬』誓要报复缺席的客人」这一流行观点推断，这会是「宴会」的主人原本为来客准备的伴手礼吗？
DisplayText.LocalizedString:
The Expired Invitation typically lures visitors deeper with a harmless facade resembling a children's book, only to suddenly strike when they approach. It's like a dangerous trap, but one that lacks the patience to wait for prey to become deeply ensnared and unable to escape, eagerly wanting to bare its fangs instead. Its behavior might be more like an emotional outburst.
Unless the Cardboard Castle at its core is destroyed to achieve Nullification, these farce-like "banquets" will continue endlessly. After the Expired Invitation undergoes Nullification, the wax seal burns itself away, leaving only a treasure chest behind, like an ill-timed gift. If we follow the popular theory that the Expired Invitation vows to take revenge on guests who fail to attend, could this be the party favors that the "banquet" host originally prepared for their guests?

VisionDesc.SourceString:
「扫晴娘」原本是一种具有清扫雨水本能的温和异象。她们在晴朗的日子里休憩，雨天则精神焕发，积极地开始「打扫」——将雨水吸纳入体内暂时储存，待雨过天晴后再寻找河流将雨水排出。或许是因为承载着人类祈晴的愿望，「扫晴娘」始终坚信自己的行为可以让雨天快些过去。
然而，在吸入受污染的雨水后，「扫晴娘」会失去行为控制能力。在污水的折磨下，她们无法正常独立排水，只能不断地重复排放黑雨——将落雨重新吸纳的循环，在周遭制造出一块阴云密布、雨水逆流的异象空间。失控的「扫晴娘」会挥动她们状似吸尘软管的尾部，像原本驱除积雨云那样，对误入雨幕的一切生物发动无差别攻击，直至将其驱赶出雨幕范围。
在排放与重新吸收雨水的过程中，如果周围气温骤降，「扫晴娘」的雨水会随自然环境变化，凝结为冻雨、冰雹或雪片，雨幕随之转化为局部暴风雪。人类进入暴风雪中，同样会受到攻击。总之，无论炎夏还是寒冬，只要在晴朗的天空下看到独有一处阴云密布，一定要当心——那之中多半有一只「扫晴娘」正在痛苦中挣扎。
VisionDesc.LocalizedString:
The Rain-sweeping Maid is originally a gentle Anomaly with an instinct to clear away rainwater. They rest on sunny days and become energized in the rain, eagerly beginning their work by absorbing rainwater into their bodies for temporary storage. Then, they seek out rivers to release the water once the skies clear. Perhaps because they carry humanity's wishes for fair weather, the Rain-sweeping Maid firmly believe their actions make rainy days pass more quickly.
However, after absorbing contaminated rainwater, the Rain-sweeping Maid lose control of their behavior. Tormented by the tainted water, they can no longer drain properly on their own. Instead, they can only repeat an endless cycle of releasing black rain and reabsorbing it, creating an Anomalous Realm of dark clouds and upward-flowing rain around themselves. An uncontrolled Rain-sweeping Maid will swing its tail, resembling a vacuum hose, launching indiscriminate attacks on any creature that wanders into its rain curtain, just as it once drove away storm clouds, until the intruder is driven out of range.
During the process of releasing and reabsorbing rainwater, if the surrounding temperature drops sharply, the Rain-sweeping Maid's rain will change with the natural environment, condensing into freezing rain, hail, or snowflakes, transforming the rain curtain into a localized blizzard. Humans who enter the blizzard will also be attacked. In short, whether in the heat of summer or the depths of winter, if you see a single patch of dark clouds under an otherwise clear sky, be careful. There is most likely a Rain-sweeping Maid struggling in agony within.

HouseCondition.SourceString: 在晴天找到「扫晴娘」，通过攻击破坏其储水系统
HouseCondition.LocalizedString: On a sunny day, find the Rain-sweeping Maid and attack to break her water reservoir.

AnnihilateCondition.SourceString: 想办法排尽「扫晴娘」储存的雨水
AnnihilateCondition.LocalizedString: Find a way to drain all the rainwater stored by the Rain-sweeping Maid.

Instead, they can only repeat an endless cycle of releasing black rain and reabsorbing it, creating an Anomalous Realm of dark clouds and upward-flowing rain around themselves. An uncontrolled Rain-sweeping Maid will swing its tail, resembling a vacuum hose, launching indiscriminate attacks on any creature that wanders into its rain curtain, just as it once drove away storm clouds, until the intruder is driven out of range.
During the process of releasing and reabsorbing rainwater, if the surrounding temperature drops sharply, the Rain-sweeping Maid's rain will change with the natural environment, condensing into freezing rain, hail, or snowflakes, transforming the rain curtain into a localized blizzard. Humans who enter the blizzard will also be attacked. In short, whether in the heat of summer or the depths of winter, if you see a single patch of dark clouds under an otherwise clear sky, be careful. There is most likely a Rain-sweeping Maid struggling in agony within.
