Content.SourceString:
（一本日记中折角的一页，字迹规整清晰）

今日伊波恩于「猎人帮」上接到一桩委托：魔女小屋附近的树林上空出现一片黑白相间的积雨云，云下方雨势很大，委托人怀疑是异象「扫晴娘」所为。我和娜娜莉、早雾接取了这桩委托，在现场确认涉事异象确为「扫晴娘」，并完成了泯除。委托费用已由阿德勒先生收取。
我和早雾都是第一次亲自处理关于「扫晴娘」的异象委托。娜娜莉之前对付过一只，回来一直抱怨，说耳朵和尾巴都淋湿了，吹干好麻烦。所以这次出发之前，我准备了雨衣和雨具，结果并没有派上用场——异象的攻击远比外表凶险得多，走进她们的雨幕里……就像走进台风圈一样。伞骨差点被折断，雨衣也一下子就湿透了，早雾和娜娜莉都说很影响她们动作。下次再出类似的任务前，我会做更充分的准备。
我一直对这种异象的生活习性很感兴趣，查过很多相关资料。以前听父亲说过，他们小时候见过的「扫晴娘」的样子和现在不同。那时候，每一只「扫晴娘」的头上都顶着一根细长的木杆，像扫帚或拖把那样，让她们条纹状的身体显得更像吸水性良好的拖布了。但是，她们的身体并不是布料材质，摸上去的手感就像棉花一样柔软、轻盈又蓬松。这样的描述让我想起了云朵——虽然无论云朵还是「扫晴娘」，我都没有亲手触摸过。失控状态下的「扫晴娘」有很强的攻击性，没有人能在不制服她们的情况下靠近，而制服过程本身也不是一件容易的事——今天我亲眼见到了她们的战斗力。我原本猜测她们会使用拖尾末端的尖牙撕咬敌人，但实际的主要攻击方式却是甩动整条拖尾，用抽打的方式驱赶试图接近她们的人。这种行为方式或许是因为她们并不是真正具有恶意、想要伤人，只是体内污水的折磨让她们非常痛苦，难以保持平静。如果我自己肚子痛，恐怕也没有余力友善对待他人。
据说塞拉伊诺馆收容着一只至今仍保留着木杆形态的「扫晴娘」。如果有机会的话，真想亲眼见见她。
Content.LocalizedString:
(A dog-eared page from a diary, written in neat and clear handwriting)

Today, Eibon received a commission via Hyelp: A black and white cumulonimbus cloud appeared above the forest near the Witch's Cottage, with heavy rain falling beneath it. The Client suspected it was the work of the Anomaly known as the Rain-sweeping Maid. Nanally, Sakiri, and I took the commission, confirmed the Anomaly in question was indeed a Rain-sweeping Maid, and completed its nullification. Adler has collected the commission fee.
This was the first time Sakiri and I personally handled an Anomaly Commission involving the Rain-sweeping Maid. Nanally had dealt with one before and complained the whole way back about how her ears and tail got soaked and what a hassle it was to dry them. So before we set out this time, I prepared raincoats and rain gear… but they turned out to be useless. The Anomaly's attacks were far more dangerous than its appearance suggested. Stepping into their curtain of rain… was like walking into a typhoon. My umbrella nearly snapped, and my raincoat was instantly soaked through. Both Sakiri and Nanally said it really hindered their movements. I will be better prepared for the next assignment similar to this.
I have always been interested in this Anomaly's behavior and have researched it extensively. My father once told me that the Rain-sweeping Maid he saw as a child looked different from today's. Back then, each one had a slender wooden pole on its head, like a broom or mop, making their striped bodies look even more like absorbent cleaning cloths. However, their bodies are not made of fabric, even if they feel soft, light, and fluffy like cotton to the touch. This description reminds me of clouds, though I have never actually touched either clouds or a Rain-sweeping Maid myself. In their uncontrolled state, the Rain-sweeping Maid are highly aggressive. No one can approach them without subduing them first, and the subduing process itself is no easy task. I witnessed their combat prowess firsthand today. I had guessed they would use the fangs at the end of their tails to bite their enemies, but their primary method of attack was actually whipping their entire tail to drive away anyone who tried to approach. This behavior indicates they do not truly bear malice or wish to harm others. Perhaps the tainted water inside them causes them immense pain, making it difficult for them to remain calm. If I had a stomachache, I probably would not have the capacity to be friendly to others either.
Apparently, the Celaeno Compound contains a Rain-sweeping Maid that still retains its wooden pole form. If I ever get the chance, I'd love to see her with my own eyes.

Content.SourceString:
近日，我们关注到呗果上出现了一些讨论，将「超规格家居馆」旧款扫地机器人的经典设计与异象「扫晴娘」的外形进行类比。对于这样的细致观察和热情联想，我们首先致以衷心感谢，并在此明确回应：是的，「超规格家居馆」的扫地机器人与「扫晴娘」的外形高度类似。
然而，我们必须郑重澄清一个被长期误解的事实：「超规格家居馆」的扫地机器人并非采用当代流行的「拟异象化」设计，事实恰恰相反——是「扫晴娘」这一与我们秉持相同清洁理念和崇高理想的异象，受到了我们所引领的潮流影响。
「超规格家居馆」是首批将扫地机器人引入海特洛市的家居企业。我们欣喜地看到，数年后的今日，我们的扫地机器人与洗地机已经成为众多家庭不可缺少的清洁伴侣。提供物美价廉的商品，为市民生活创造便利，是我们品牌自创立以来的期许。我们的初代扫地机器人采用圆润机身、灵活软管与易清洁吸尘口设计，这是功能与美学高度统一的必然结果。
据《海特洛异象年鉴》记载，「扫晴娘」的形象演变，恰好发生在我们的产品问世约一年后。这一年的销售数据显示，海特洛市超半数家庭购买了我们的产品。「超规格家居馆」可以自豪地宣称，如今异象「扫晴娘」与我们产品高度趋近的外形，不仅是她们自身向更高效、更美观方向的进化，更是市场对我们产品高度认可的证明。
借此机会，我们也将荣幸地宣布：「超规格家居馆」全新一代扫地机器人，即将正式亮相。
我们不止清理雨水，更能让您住所的每个角落焕然一新。
我们无法驱散阴雨，但同样能为您带来晴日般的好心情。
相信下个世代，「扫晴娘」的外形仍将随我们共同进化。「超规格家居馆」，始终定义生活风尚。
Content.LocalizedString:
Recently, we have noticed discussions on Bagel comparing the classic design of DeLuxur Home's older robot vacuum models with the appearance of the Anomaly known as the Rain-sweeping Maid. We sincerely thank everyone for their keen observations and enthusiastic associations, and we are pleased to officially respond: Yes, DeLuxur Home's robot vacuums do bear a striking resemblance to the Rain-sweeping Maid.
However, we must solemnly clarify a long-standing misconception: DeLuxur Home's robot vacuums do not employ the trendy "Anomalize" design philosophy that is popular today. In fact, quite the opposite is true. It is the Rain-sweeping Maid, an Anomaly that shares our commitment to cleanliness and lofty ideals, that has been influenced by the trends we pioneered.
DeLuxur Home was among the first home appliance companies to introduce robot vacuums to Hethereau. We are delighted to see that, years later, our robot vacuums and floor cleaners have become indispensable cleaning companions in countless households. Providing quality products at affordable prices and creating convenience for our citizens' lives has been our brand's mission since its founding. Our first-generation robot vacuum featured a rounded body, flexible hose, and easy-to-clean suction port, the result of a perfect union between function and aesthetics.
According to the Hethereau Anomaly Yearbook, the Rain-sweeping Maid's appearance began to change approximately one year after our products hit the market. Sales data from that year shows that over half of all households in Hethereau purchased our products. DeLuxur Home can proudly proclaim that the striking similarity between today's Rain-sweeping Maid and our products represents not only their own evolution toward greater efficiency and beauty, but also proof of the market's overwhelming approval of our designs.
We are also honored to take this opportunity to announce that DeLuxur Home's next-generation robot vacuum will be officially unveiled soon.
We do more than just clear away rainwater. We make every corner of your home shine like new.
We cannot dispel the clouds, but we can still bring you a sunny disposition.
We believe that in the next generation, the Rain-sweeping Maid will continue to evolve alongside us. DeLuxur Home: Always Defining Lifestyle Trends.

放着不管足够长的时间，这种情况就会自然消失——「层级增生」与其说是一种由正常电梯转化而来的物体异象，更像是一种在原本正常的电梯中可能随机发生的故障现象。
这种现象会使电梯失控，无法抵达原有楼层，并高概率连接到随机的异象空间，同楼房的楼梯则不受任何影响。
只要整栋楼的人都坚持不用电梯而是走一年楼梯，这个异象就会自然泯除，还是很简单的……然而事实是住户们（二楼除外）总会第一时间集齐募款并向公会发布高额的紧急委托。
VisionDesc.LocalizedString:
If left alone long enough, this situation will naturally resolve itself. Level Proliferation is less of an Object Anomaly that transforms from a normal elevator, and more of a malfunction phenomenon that can randomly occur in otherwise normal elevators.
This phenomenon causes the elevator to go haywire, unable to reach its original floors, with a high probability of connecting to random Anomalous Realms. The stairs in the same building remain completely unaffected.
As long as everyone in the building commits to taking the stairs instead of the elevator for one year, the Anomaly will undergo natural Nullification. Simple enough… However, the reality is that residents (except those on the second floor) always pool their funds at the first opportunity and post high-paying emergency commissions to the Guild.

不觉得有些邻居很没公德心吗？水管坏了，因为对自己家没影响，就拖着不修，遭殃的都是楼下好吧？乌漆嘛黑的水都从天花板上冒出来往下滴了啊！恶不恶心？
我听人说他们家生活习惯差得要死，早上出门水龙头都一直忘记关的，结果就是和那根一直没修的水管构成一套完美配合，受害人家动不动就水漫金山，墙壁都发霉了，地板都被泡坏了！
你说——这家人整天没事就开着那水龙头是想干嘛？游泳吗？在房间里洗车吗？……莫非是什么美人鱼转世？非要定居到陆地，是有什么什么……真相令人潸然落泪的深刻原因不成？家里不弄得潮点过不下去了可以去住水族馆呀！
啊？你是想问异象啊？哪来的异象？
……哦，小区电梯里有异象啊。那就不清楚了，阿姨我是住别墅区的。
Content.LocalizedString:
Don't you think some neighbors have absolutely no sense of decency? Their pipes are broken, but since it doesn't affect their own home, they just leave it be. Meanwhile, everyone downstairs suffers! Murky black water is seeping through the ceiling and dripping down! Disgusting, right?
I heard their household habits are terrible. They leave in the morning, forgetting to turn off the faucet. Combined with that pipe they never fixed, it's the perfect recipe for disaster! The poor victims downstairs are constantly flooded, the walls are all moldy, and the floors are completely ruined!
Tell me, what are these people trying to do leaving the faucet running all day? Go for a swim? Wash their car indoors?…Or, maybe they're a mermaid reincarnated? Insisting on living on land for some… deeply moving, tearjerking reason? Grr, if they need that much water to live, they should just move into an aquarium!
Huh? You're asking about an Anomaly? What Anomaly?
…Oh, there's an Anomaly in the community elevator? Bah, I wouldn't know about that. I live in the villa district.

《关于管理局电梯异常粉碎事件的询问反馈记录》

（通话录音转写）

因为刚巧发生在上班高峰前3分钟左右。
……不，我不在电梯里，没出房间，只是有看着摄像头。
根据当时的计算，不考虑其余成本，对于这个问题最快、最根本的修复方案就是——立即操纵电梯从顶楼砸向底楼，破坏掉。
……
因为靠广播通知再封锁、走常规流程泯除的方式效率太低。
抱歉，不太擅长在电话里解释。文件已经放你桌面上了。

（附件：cause.txt）

内部批注A：啊，所以这次的物件损害确定是那个足不出户的队长干的了？等等，你居然敢找本人问话？
回复：开口了其实态度还可以……而且所有疑问都回答了。
内部批注B：为什么你有他的电话？
回复：给网友抱怨了一下然后网友给的，说打这个就能联系上犯人，厉害吧？
内部批注C：把后续和结论补上，白蜡树的人要确认。
回复：它就像是只针对电梯，将其随性地变化为一个异象空间入口。两种方法——摧毁入口所通向的那个异象空间，或是摧毁入口本身。一般稳妥起见我们选择前者，但那便意味着要承担每次对电梯外头随机的异象空间进行探索的风险，耗费的时间和人力不一定少于重装电梯，至于后者，撇去财务上的损失……就目前而言，同位置新安装的电梯确实没有再出现这种故障异象。
内部批注D：原因写得井井有条，行为却怎么看怎么偏激，结果竟然还是确实是OK的，此事究竟……
Content.LocalizedString:
Inquiry Feedback Record Regarding the Bureau Elevator Anomaly Destruction Incident

Phone call recording transcript

Because it happened about 3 minutes before rush hour.
…No, I wasn't in the elevator. I didn't leave my room. I was just watching the security cameras.
Based on my calculations at the time, disregarding other costs, the fastest and most fundamental solution to the problem was to immediately send the elevator crashing from the top floor to the bottom floor. Destroy it.
…
Because using broadcasts to notify people, then sealing off the area and going through standard Nullification procedures would have been too inefficient.
Sorry, I'm not good at explaining over the phone. I've already put the file on your desktop.

(Attachment: cause.txt)

Internal Note A: So the property damage this time was confirmed to be caused by that shut-in Captain? Wait, you actually dared to call them directly?!
Reply: Once they started talking, their attitude was actually okay… And they answered all the questions.
Internal Note B: Why do you have their number?
Reply: I complained to an online friend about it, and they gave it to me. Said I could reach the culprit with this number. Pretty impressive, right?
Internal Note C: Add the follow-up and conclusions. Fraxinus needs confirmation.
Reply: It seems to specifically target elevators, randomly transforming them into Anomalous Realm entrances. Two solutions: destroy the Anomalous Realm the entrance leads to, or destroy the entrance itself. Normally, we choose the former to be safe, but that means taking on the risk of exploring whatever random Anomalous Realm appears beyond the elevator each time. VisionDesc.SourceString:
「扫晴娘」原本是一种具有清扫雨水本能的温和异象。她们在晴朗的日子里休憩，雨天则精神焕发，积极地开始「打扫」——将雨水吸纳入体内暂时储存，待雨过天晴后再寻找河流将雨水排出。或许是因为承载着人类祈晴的愿望，「扫晴娘」始终坚信自己的行为可以让雨天快些过去。
然而，在吸入受污染的雨水后，「扫晴娘」会失去行为控制能力。在污水的折磨下，她们无法正常独立排水，只能不断地重复排放黑雨——将落雨重新吸纳的循环，在周遭制造出一块阴云密布、雨水逆流的异象空间。失控的「扫晴娘」会挥动她们状似吸尘软管的尾部，像原本驱除积雨云那样，对误入雨幕的一切生物发动无差别攻击，直至将其驱赶出雨幕范围。
在排放与重新吸收雨水的过程中，如果周围气温骤降，「扫晴娘」的雨水会随自然环境变化，凝结为冻雨、冰雹或雪片，雨幕随之转化为局部暴风雪。人类进入暴风雪中，同样会受到攻击。总之，无论炎夏还是寒冬，只要在晴朗的天空下看到独有一处阴云密布，一定要当心——那之中多半有一只「扫晴娘」正在痛苦中挣扎。
VisionDesc.LocalizedString:
The Rain-sweeping Maid is originally a gentle Anomaly with an instinct to clear away rainwater. They rest on sunny days and become energized in the rain, eagerly beginning their work by absorbing rainwater into their bodies for temporary storage. Then, they seek out rivers to release the water once the skies clear. Perhaps because they carry humanity's wishes for fair weather, the Rain-sweeping Maid firmly believe their actions make rainy days pass more quickly.
However, after absorbing contaminated rainwater, the Rain-sweeping Maid lose control of their behavior. Tormented by the tainted water, they can no longer drain properly on their own. Instead, they can only repeat an endless cycle of releasing black rain and reabsorbing it, creating an Anomalous Realm of dark clouds and upward-flowing rain around themselves. An uncontrolled Rain-sweeping Maid will swing its tail, resembling a vacuum hose, launching indiscriminate attacks on any creature that wanders into its rain curtain, just as it once drove away storm clouds, until the intruder is driven out of range.
During the process of releasing and reabsorbing rainwater, if the surrounding temperature drops sharply, the Rain-sweeping Maid's rain will change with the natural environment, condensing into freezing rain, hail, or snowflakes, transforming the rain curtain into a localized blizzard. Humans who enter the blizzard will also be attacked. In short, whether in the heat of summer or the depths of winter, if you see a single patch of dark clouds under an otherwise clear sky, be careful. There is most likely a Rain-sweeping Maid struggling in agony within.

Content.SourceString:
（一本日记中折角的一页，字迹规整清晰）

今日伊波恩于「猎人帮」上接到一桩委托：魔女小屋附近的树林上空出现一片黑白相间的积雨云，云下方雨势很大，委托人怀疑是异象「扫晴娘」所为。我和娜娜莉、早雾接取了这桩委托，在现场确认涉事异象确为「扫晴娘」，并完成了泯除。委托费用已由阿德勒先生收取。
我和早雾都是第一次亲自处理关于「扫晴娘」的异象委托。娜娜莉之前对付过一只，回来一直抱怨，说耳朵和尾巴都淋湿了，吹干好麻烦。所以这次出发之前，我准备了雨衣和雨具，结果并没有派上用场——异象的攻击远比外表凶险得多，走进她们的雨幕里……就像走进台风圈一样。伞骨差点被折断，雨衣也一下子就湿透了，早雾和娜娜莉都说很影响她们动作。下次再出类似的任务前，我会做更充分的准备。
我一直对这种异象的生活习性很感兴趣，查过很多相关资料。以前听父亲说过，他们小时候见过的「扫晴娘」的样子和现在不同。那时候，每一只「扫晴娘」的头上都顶着一根细长的木杆，像扫帚或拖把那样，让她们条纹状的身体显得更像吸水性良好的拖布了。但是，她们的身体并不是布料材质，摸上去的手感就像棉花一样柔软、轻盈又蓬松。这样的描述让我想起了云朵——虽然无论云朵还是「扫晴娘」，我都没有亲手触摸过。失控状态下的「扫晴娘」有很强的攻击性，没有人能在不制服她们的情况下靠近，而制服过程本身也不是一件容易的事——今天我亲眼见到了她们的战斗力。我原本猜测她们会使用拖尾末端的尖牙撕咬敌人，但实际的主要攻击方式却是甩动整条拖尾，用抽打的方式驱赶试图接近她们的人。这种行为方式或许是因为她们并不是真正具有恶意、想要伤人，只是体内污水的折磨让她们非常痛苦，难以保持平静。如果我自己肚子痛，恐怕也没有余力友善对待他人。
据说塞拉伊诺馆收容着一只至今仍保留着木杆形态的「扫晴娘」。如果有机会的话，真想亲眼见见她。
Content.LocalizedString:
(A dog-eared page from a diary, written in neat and clear handwriting)

Today, Eibon received a commission via Hyelp: A black and white cumulonimbus cloud appeared above the forest near the Witch's Cottage, with heavy rain falling beneath it. The Client suspected it was the work of the Anomaly known as the Rain-sweeping Maid. Nanally, Sakiri, and I took the commission, confirmed the Anomaly in question was indeed a Rain-sweeping Maid, and completed its nullification. Adler has collected the commission fee.
This was the first time Sakiri and I personally handled an Anomaly Commission involving the Rain-sweeping Maid. Nanally had dealt with one before and complained the whole way back about how her ears and tail got soaked and what a hassle it was to dry them. So before we set out this time, I prepared raincoats and rain gear… but they turned out to be useless. The Anomaly's attacks were far more dangerous than its appearance suggested. Stepping into their curtain of rain… was like walking into a typhoon. My umbrella nearly snapped, and my raincoat was instantly soaked through. Both Sakiri and Nanally said it really hindered their movements. I will be better prepared for the next assignment similar to this.
I have always been interested in this Anomaly's behavior and have researched it extensively. My father once told me that the Rain-sweeping Maid he saw as a child looked different from today's. Back then, each one had a slender wooden pole on its head, like a broom or mop, making their striped bodies look even more like absorbent cleaning cloths. However, their bodies are not made of fabric, even if they feel soft, light, and fluffy like cotton to the touch. This description reminds me of clouds, though I have never actually touched either clouds or a Rain-sweeping Maid myself. In their uncontrolled state, the Rain-sweeping Maid are highly aggressive. No one can approach them without subduing them first, and the subduing process itself is no easy task. I witnessed their combat prowess firsthand today. I had guessed they would use the fangs at the end of their tails to bite their enemies, but their primary method of attack was actually whipping their entire tail to drive away anyone who tried to approach. This behavior indicates they do not truly bear malice or wish to harm others. Perhaps the tainted water inside them causes them immense pain, making it difficult for them to remain calm. If I had a stomachache, I probably would not have the capacity to be friendly to others either.
Apparently, the Celaeno Compound contains a Rain-sweeping Maid that still retains its wooden pole form. If I ever get the chance, I'd love to see her with my own eyes.

Content.SourceString:
近日，我们关注到呗果上出现了一些讨论，将「超规格家居馆」旧款扫地机器人的经典设计与异象「扫晴娘」的外形进行类比。对于这样的细致观察和热情联想，我们首先致以衷心感谢，并在此明确回应：是的，「超规格家居馆」的扫地机器人与「扫晴娘」的外形高度类似。
然而，我们必须郑重澄清一个被长期误解的事实：「超规格家居馆」的扫地机器人并非采用当代流行的「拟异象化」设计，事实恰恰相反——是「扫晴娘」这一与我们秉持相同清洁理念和崇高理想的异象，受到了我们所引领的潮流影响。
「超规格家居馆」是首批将扫地机器人引入海特洛市的家居企业。我们欣喜地看到，数年后的今日，我们的扫地机器人与洗地机已经成为众多家庭不可缺少的清洁伴侣。提供物美价廉的商品，为市民生活创造便利，是我们品牌自创立以来的期许。我们的初代扫地机器人采用圆润机身、灵活软管与易清洁吸尘口设计，这是功能与美学高度统一的必然结果。
据《海特洛异象年鉴》记载，「扫晴娘」的形象演变，恰好发生在我们的产品问世约一年后。这一年的销售数据显示，海特洛市超半数家庭购买了我们的产品。「超规格家居馆」可以自豪地宣称，如今异象「扫晴娘」与我们产品高度趋近的外形，不仅是她们自身向更高效、更美观方向的进化，更是市场对我们产品高度认可的证明。
借此机会，我们也将荣幸地宣布：「超规格家居馆」全新一代扫地机器人，即将正式亮相。
我们不止清理雨水，更能让您住所的每个角落焕然一新。
我们无法驱散阴雨，但同样能为您带来晴日般的好心情。
相信下个世代，「扫晴娘」的外形仍将随我们共同进化。「超规格家居馆」，始终定义生活风尚。
Content.LocalizedString:
Recently, we have noticed discussions on Bagel comparing the classic design of DeLuxur Home's older robot vacuum models with the appearance of the Anomaly known as the Rain-sweeping Maid. We sincerely thank everyone for their keen observations and enthusiastic associations, and we are pleased to officially respond: Yes, DeLuxur Home's robot vacuums do bear a striking resemblance to the Rain-sweeping Maid.
However, we must solemnly clarify a long-standing misconception: DeLuxur Home's robot vacuums do not employ the trendy "Anomalize" design philosophy that is popular today. In fact, quite the opposite is true. It is the Rain-sweeping Maid, an Anomaly that shares our commitment to cleanliness and lofty ideals, that has been influenced by the trends we pioneered.
DeLuxur Home was among the first home appliance companies to introduce robot vacuums to Hethereau. We are delighted to see that, years later, our robot vacuums and floor cleaners have become indispensable cleaning companions in countless households. Providing quality products at affordable prices and creating convenience for our citizens' lives has been our brand's mission since its founding. Our first-generation robot vacuum featured a rounded body, flexible hose, and easy-to-clean suction port, the result of a perfect union between function and aesthetics.
According to the Hethereau Anomaly Yearbook, the Rain-sweeping Maid's appearance began to change approximately one year after our products hit the market. Sales data from that year shows that over half of all households in Hethereau purchased our products. DeLuxur Home can proudly proclaim that the striking similarity between today's Rain-sweeping Maid and our products represents not only their own evolution toward greater efficiency and beauty, but also proof of the market's overwhelming approval of our designs.
We are also honored to take this opportunity to announce that DeLuxur Home's next-generation robot vacuum will be officially unveiled soon.
We do more than just clear away rainwater. We make every corner of your home shine like new.
We cannot dispel the clouds, but we can still bring you a sunny disposition.
We believe that in the next generation, the Rain-sweeping Maid will continue to evolve alongside us. DeLuxur Home: Always Defining Lifestyle Trends.

VisionDesc.SourceString: 该生物异象外观类似苍蝇等蚊虫，通常附着于受害者的头部，通过口器吸取灵感。得手数量可观的灵感后，它们会构建一个异象空间藏身。泯除「灵感终结者」需要进入异象空间，抵达它的藏身处。由于异象空间基于被「灵感终结者」吸食的灵感构成，其内容往往复杂多变且无规律性，异象猎人需要随机应变，灵活应对。
VisionDesc.LocalizedString: This Bio Anomaly resembles flies and other insects in appearance. It typically attaches to the victim's head and absorbs inspiration through its mouthparts. After obtaining a considerable amount of inspiration, it constructs an Anomalous Realm to hide in. Nullifying an Inspiration Terminator requires entering the Anomalous Realm and reaching its hideout. Content.SourceString:
都说「灵感终结者」是创作者的死敌，「灵感终结者」出没之处犹如蝗虫过境，谁都别想留下一个好点子。但我必须为这群讨厌的小东西们正名一下，它们也不是什么都吃。
没错，我亲眼看到了「灵感终结者」进食的瞬间。它晃晃悠悠，一飞一颤地降落在猎物的后脑勺上。一看就是久没吃饭，都饿到飞不动了。
可惜有那家伙的头发挡住，实在看不清它吸灵感的细节。总之我远远看见茂密的头发间逐渐亮起了一个小点儿，就知道它得手了。我立刻捏好了我的苍蝇拍，屏息等待着……
结果你猜怎么着？那个亮点飞到半空，忽闪忽闪，猛地抽搐了一下，震出来个灰色的小光球。那光球飘飘忽忽地晃回原主人那里，而「灵感终结者」悬在半空，像是半天没晃过神来。我见此眼疾手快，一苍蝇拍击毙灵感小偷。
然而被盯上的受害者仿佛完全没意识到刚刚发生了什么，依旧伏案奋笔疾书着。不由得让人好奇，他这失而复得的灵感……究竟是在想什么呢？不管怎么说，灵感小偷肯定觉得这玩意不好吃，宁可饿着肚子都要吐出来。
Content.LocalizedString:
They say Inspiration Terminators are the bane of creators, devouring good ideas like locusts. But honestly, they're quite picky eaters.
I saw one in action once. It wobbled through the air, barely staying aloft, and landed on its target's head. The poor thing was starving and couldn't go any further.
I couldn't see much through the victim's hair, but a tiny light appeared, and I knew it was feeding. I readied my flyswatter and waited.
And guess what? The light flickered and twitched, then expelled a small grey orb back to its owner. But the Inspiration Terminator just hung there, stunned. One swift smack from me, and it was history.
The victim, oblivious, kept writing furiously. Makes you wonder what kind of inspiration got returned… Whatever it was, the thief clearly found it unpalatable, even on an empty stomach.

Content.SourceString:
「灵感终结者」偷取的灵感可能存在某种「关联性」，绝不仅仅只是偷走了你的一个点子。
这个结论基于我的亲身经历，说来还怪不好意思。总之情况大概是这样的：
前阵子给编辑寄去了我的新书稿后，我原打算好好放松一阵，没想到大脑怎样都没办法停下来！既然如此便趁热打铁，补充补充新作完结后的故事……没曾想被「灵感终结者」盯上，偷走了番外的灵感。
乘着灵感这阵东风而畅快疾奔的思路，就这样硬生生踩了个急刹车！那滋味别提多难受了。更糟糕的是，不仅是番外受到影响，就连本篇写作的思路，我都想不起来分毫。编辑给我打电话来讨论稿子的修改，我支支吾吾什么都说不出来。我当时为什么要这么写？心里只有这一个念头。
直到请异象猎人来解决掉「灵感终结者」，桌上那一沓白纸重回书稿，这场恐怖的噩梦才总算结束。现在想来，番外的设定和思路，某种意义上来说是本篇的延续，所以「灵感终结者」所影响的，不仅仅是正在构思的这个灵感，和它联系紧密的想法思路也会被阻遏。
哎呀哎呀，看来下次写稿前我得先备足杀虫剂。
Content.LocalizedString:
Inspiration Terminators don't just steal one idea—they seem to feed on all related thoughts.
I came to this conclusion based on my own experience, though it's still embarrasing:
After sending my manuscript to my editor, I tried writing a spinoff since I couldn't relax. That's when an Inspiration Terminator struck.
It felt like slamming the brakes on a speeding train. I couldn't remember anything about my main story either, and sounded like an idiot when my editor called…
Only after hiring an Anomaly Hunter did my nightmare end, and my manuscript finally came back to life. Reflecting on it, the spinoff's setting and plot were extensions of the main story. So, when an Inspiration Terminator strikes, it doesn't just block your current idea—it suppresses all related thoughts and concepts too.
Looks like I'll need more insecticide for my next writing session.

VisionDesc.SourceString:
据委托人所述，该异象主体为一所名为「██医院」的废弃医疗设施。其地理位置尚未确认，被委托人描述为「位于噩梦深处」，调查者需接受其催眠、引导，方可进入其所述「梦境」并观测到该设施。据其介绍，在接受催眠后，调查者将进入半小时至数日不等的深度睡眠状态，期间可能伴随呓语、躯体震颤、无意识抓挠、呼吸过速等不良反应，但在催眠终止、调查者苏醒后，上述反应均会消失。关于进入该区域的原理，委托人拒绝透露。
截至目前，无任何关于该异象内部构成的影像资料，相关调查记录也极少。在自称接受过催眠的受访者中，半数以上表示委托人疑似存在精神障碍，或称其涉嫌欺诈；少数受访者则确认曾在催眠状态下进入过一处名为「██医院」的设施，并在内部观测到「由绷带组成的异象」，除此之外的内容，不同受访者的陈述存在差异。
补充记录：历史档案中尚未查询到任何以「██医院」命名的现实医疗机构。它并不存在。
VisionDesc.LocalizedString:
According to the client, this Anomaly's main body is an abandoned medical facility called ██ Hospital. Its geographical location has not been confirmed. The client describes it as "located deep within nightmares," and investigators must accept hypnosis and guidance to enter the described "dreamscape" to observe the facility. According to the client's explanation, after accepting hypnosis, investigators will enter a state of deep sleep lasting anywhere from thirty minutes to several days, potentially accompanied by adverse reactions including sleep talking, body tremors, unconscious scratching, and rapid breathing. However, these reactions all disappear once the hypnosis ends and the investigator awakens. The client refuses to reveal the principles behind entering this area.
As of now, there is no visual documentation of this Anomaly's internal structure, and related investigation records are extremely limited. Among interviewees claiming to have undergone hypnosis, over half indicate the client likely suffers from mental disorders or is suspected of fraud. A minority of interviewees confirm having entered a facility called ██ Hospital under hypnosis and observing "Anomalies composed of bandages" within. Beyond this, different interviewees' accounts vary significantly.
Supplementary record: Historical profiles contain no queries for any real medical institution named ██ Hospital. It does not exist.

VisionDesc.SourceString:
——█ █ █ 限既往调查人员查阅。请勿外传。█ █ █——
经███审议，该异象评级已上调至V，该委托条目已封存，相关资料及条目编辑权限已移交尤克阿什庭。本条目最终解释权归尤克阿什庭所有，如无书面许可，禁止引用本条目中的任何信息。
该异象为一处名为「冷山医院」的废弃大型医疗设施，推测其存在于█████。该设施主体为四层的钢筋混凝土结构建筑，占地面积未知，设施内时间及空间状态不稳定，存在混沌叠加的可能；各楼层内分布有包含U-6009-1[Or]在内的多种伴生型异象，部分已被验证具有攻击性或██威胁。此外，该委托人存在解离性失忆症及其它精神病史，病因不明，目前在海特洛市立医院接受长期治疗。
调查者进入「冷山医院」的方式唯一：必须接受委托人的异能影响，方能进入，而该过程疑似存在精神安全隐患。已知既往调查人员中，约60%报告出现幻听、幻视、心悸、噩梦等后遗症，个别体内发生器质性损伤，极个别██。
关于「冷山医院」的废弃原因，多名调查者声称在设施内收集到重要文件，但原件或抄录的副本都未能以任何形式带离该空间，调查者仅能凭借模糊的记忆陈述内容。多名调查者提及该设施废弃前「曾发生过异象事故」，该事故或与医院废弃、U-6009-1[Or]的出现有重要联系，但事件细节仍未查明。
经排查确认，未查询到任何名称为「冷山医院」或建筑布局与之相似的医疗设施，亦无与「██」特征相符的异象事故记录。该异象设施的所有现象、实体及记录文件，均未发现与现实世界存在任何历史或逻辑关联。
***如您出现任何肢体幻痛、体表灼烧感、或对绷带产生依赖心理的症状，请您保持冷静，停止一切与他人产生肢体接触的活动，并立即联系异象管理局或异象猎人公会，有关人员将为您提供诊疗与咨询服务。

——█ █ █ FOR PREVIOUS INVESTIGATION PERSONNEL ONLY. DO NOT DISTRIBUTE. █ █ █——
Following review by ███, this Anomaly's classification has been elevated to Class V. This commission entry has been sealed, and related materials and editing permissions have been transferred to Yggash Court. Final interpretation rights for this entry belong to Yggash Court. Citation of any info from this entry is prohibited without written authorization.
This Anomaly is an abandoned large-scale medical facility known as Coldmount Hospital, presumed to exist in █████. The main structure is a four-story reinforced concrete building with unknown floor area. Time and space conditions within the facility are unstable, with potential chaotic overlaps. Various surge-type Anomalies are distributed throughout the floors, including U-6009-1(Or), some verified to possess aggressive or ██ threat capabilities. Additionally, the client suffers from dissociative amnesia and other psychiatric conditions of unknown origin.  Currently undergoing long-term treatment at Hethereau Municipal Hospital.
There is only one method for investigators to enter Coldmount Hospital: they must be affected by the client's Esper Ability to gain access, and this process is suspected to pose mental safety risks. Among the identified investigation personnel, approximately 60% reported experiencing aftereffects including auditory hallucinations, visual hallucinations, heart palpitations, nightmares, and other symptoms. Some individuals experienced organic damage, and a very few ██.
Regarding the abandonment of Coldmount Hospital, multiple investigators claim to have collected important documents within the facility, but neither original nor transcribed copies could be removed from that space in any form. Investigators can only relay contents based on vague memories. Multiple investigators mentioned that "an Anomaly incident occurred" before the facility's abandonment, which may have important connections to the hospital's abandonment and the appearance of U-6009-1(Or), but event details remain unclear.
After comprehensive verification, no medical facility named Coldmount Hospital or with a similar architectural layout has been found, nor are there any Anomaly incident records matching "██" characteristics. All phenomena, entities, and documented files from this Anomaly facility show no historical or logical connections to the real world.
***If you experience any phantom limb pain, skin burning sensations, or psychological dependence on bandages, please remain calm, cease all physical contact activities with others, and immediately contact the Bureau of Anomaly Control or Anomaly Hunter Guild. Qualified personnel will provide diagnostic and consultation services.

Content.SourceString:
那家伙要么是个疯子，要么是个骗子，碰上他算我倒霉。
你没见过那委托人的样子吗？一个糟老头，穿个病号服，对着墙壁念念叨叨，看着就邪门儿！
我当时按照指引到了医院，在一个没人的楼梯间见到了他，我还以为找错了！这看着就不像什么正常的委托。我感觉不对，想悄悄离开完事，结果他突然就开始说话……
我哪听得清他说了什么！他还面对着没人的地方，都没转过身来。我最讨厌说话时不看着我的人了。
……反正就是叽里咕噜一大串，神神叨叨的，好像是说什么……催眠、噩梦？
——啊？！要接受他的催眠？！
我不知道！我接委托的时候没瞧仔细，只是来医院顺路，看看是怎么回事，要是简单的活儿，我就顺手赚个外快……但看到委托人是个疯老头，我就打消念头了。
是啊，我没理他，当然没接受——得亏我走得果断，要知道他还懂催眠，我碰都不会碰这个委托！
……什么叫「难怪没事」？
你……是在调查接过这个委托的异象猎人吗？
其他人呢？接受催眠的人……都怎么了？
[采访结束]
Content.LocalizedString:
That guy's either a lunatic or a con artist, just my luck running into him…
You haven't seen what the client looks like, have you? Some decrepit old man in a hospital gown, muttering at the walls. Creepy as hell!
I followed the directions to the hospital and met him in this empty stairwell. I thought I'd gone to the wrong place! Something felt off, so I was planning to quietly slip away, but then he suddenly started talking…
How was I supposed to make out what he was saying?! He was facing some empty spot, and didn't even turn around. I hate it when people won't look at me while they're talking.
…Anyway, it was just a bunch of rambling nonsense, all mystical and weird. Something about… hypnosis? Nightmares?
Wait, what?! Accept his hypnosis?!
I don't know! I didn't read the commission details carefully. I was just passing by the hospital, figured I'd check it out… if it was simple work, I'd make some quick cash on the side… Once I saw the client was some crazy old geezer, I gave up on the idea.
Yeah, I ignored him. Of course I didn't accept! Good thing I left when I did! If I'd known he was into hypnosis, I wouldn't have touched that commission with a ten-foot pole!
…What do you mean "no wonder nothing happened"?
You… are you investigating Anomaly Hunters who took this commission?
What about the others? The people who accepted the hypnosis… what happened to them?
[Interview End]

「黑之书」是形似巨大书本的物体异象，其显著特征为封面上嵌有一颗硕大的紫色眼球，不住左右转动，窥视着一切想要接近它的人。
黑之书能够操控部分低级异象的行为，也可以将它们泯除。它通过展示自身的力量，来获取人类对其的信仰。而人类对黑之书的信仰，又会进一步增强它的力量。
VisionDesc.LocalizedString:
The Black Tome is an Object Anomaly that resembles a massive book. Its most distinctive feature is the large purple eyeball embedded in its cover, constantly rolling side to side, watching anyone who tries to approach it.
The Black Tome can manipulate the behavior of certain low-threat anomalies, as well as nullify them. The book exudes its power to harvest faith from humans, which in turn amplifies its powers.

HouseCondition.SourceString: 将其击败泯除。
HouseCondition.LocalizedString: Defeat and nullify.

AnnihilateCondition.SourceString: （推测）通过攻击，切断「黑之书」与其信徒的联系
AnnihilateCondition.LocalizedString: (Speculation) Attacking may sever the connection between the Black Tome and its followers.

VisionDesc.SourceString:
在未被唤醒时，「黑之书」是形似巨大书本的物体异象，其显著特征为封面上嵌有一颗硕大的紫色眼球，不住左右转动，窥视着一切想要接近它的人。一旦翻开黑之书，就会被强行拖进它连通的异象空间——「书库」，并被迫与之本体作战。黑之书的本体近似人形，头部形似一本打开的书，数只类似手臂的器官缠绕在身体周围。战斗时，它会召唤出记载有信徒信念的书本，从中发射由「文字」与火焰交织而成的锁链，或是信仰能量凝成的光束，以此重创对手。除「魔法攻击」外，黑之书也具备一套强劲的「物理攻击」手段，能够操纵自身的腿部、长尾，或是挥动锁链袭击近身的对手。
黑之书的力量来源主要有两个：一是吞噬低级异象；二是通过控制部分低级异象的行为，或将其泯除，来获取人类对其力量的信仰，而这种盲信会进一步增强它的力量。随着力量增长，黑之书的维特海默值波动也会不断增强。目前尚不清楚，如果不对其成长加以抑制，黑之书的力量上限会达到何种程度。
黑之书吸收信徒的信仰作为力量来源，这一过程本身并不会对信徒造成直接伤害，但他们可能会因信仰而做出非理性、不科学的行为，从而伤害自己或他人。黑之书泯除后，其信众就会从盲信中解脱，不会留下后遗症。除非他们曾长期持有或过分接近黑之书，可能会因此受到异象侵凌的影响。
VisionDesc.LocalizedString:
Before being awakened, the Black Tome was an Object Anomaly resembling a massive book. Its most distinctive feature is the large purple eyeball embedded in its cover, constantly rolling side to side, wary of anyone approaching. Once the Black Tome is opened, the reader will be forcibly dragged into the Anomalous Realm it connects to, known as the "Library," and forced to battle its true form, which is roughly humanoid, with a head resembling an open book, and multiple arm-like appendages coiled around its body. In battle, it summons books inscribed with the beliefs of its followers, from which it fires chains woven from text and flames, or beams of condensed faith energy to devastate its opponents. In addition to these "magical attacks," the Black Tome also possesses a powerful array of physical attacks, capable of manipulating its legs, long tail, or swinging its chains to strike enemies at close range.
The Black Tome draws its power from two main sources: first, by devouring low threat anomalies or nullifying them; second, by controlling low-level anomalies to act in a way that inspires belief in the tome's power, which further amplifies its strength. As the tome's power grows, its Wertheimer Index fluctuates with more intensity. It remains unknown what limit the Black Tome's power could reach if left unchecked.
It must be noted that although the Black Tome absorbs faith from its followers, this process itself is not immediately harmful. Still, its followers may engage in irrational behaviors out of their faith, potentially harming themselves or others. Once the Black Tome is nullified, its followers are freed from their blind faith without lasting effects. However, those who have held the Black Tome for extended periods of time or remained too close may suffer from anomaly encroachment.

HouseCondition.SourceString: 将其击败泯除。
HouseCondition.LocalizedString: Defeat and nullify.

AnnihilateCondition.SourceString: 通过攻击，动摇信徒对「黑之书」的「信仰」。
AnnihilateCondition.LocalizedString: Attack to shake the followers' faith in the Black Tome.

Content.SourceString:
*一段嘈杂的声音*

……你是什么人？找我有事吗？我不接受采访。
（另一个声音：我们不是媒体。）
嗯？我看你这「长枪短炮」的……哦，是因为之前那件事吗？

*长时间的沉默*

进来吧。别站在门口了。
（另一个声音：打扰了。）
你想知道什么？
（另一个声音：说说事情的经过就好。）
没什么特别的。下班路上，我被一台突然动起来的自动贩卖机袭击了，吓得魂飞魄散的时候，社长突然出现在那里，轻而易举地把贩卖机变成了一颗噗卡好梦棉花糖。我本来以为他是路过的好心异能者，向他道谢时，却听到他说，这不是异能，而是「魔法」。异能者只能泯除异象，魔法却能做到更多。而且，他也只是和我一样的普通人。只要认真学习魔法，普通人也能做到这种看似不可思议的事。
（另一个声音：所以你相信了他？）
一开始只是将信将疑。但跟着他来到社团后，我一次又一次地看到了奇迹。
（另一个声音：「奇迹」？）
你们可能会有别的词来形容吧。在我眼里，那就是奇迹。每次集会上，他都会展示一些曾经伤过人或者差点伤了人的异象，宣布要用魔法的力量把它们净化。他在地上画一个魔法阵，接着地上就亮起光芒，那些一直扭动挣扎的异象转眼间就变成最普通不过的东西。他说，这就是「黑之书」的力量。社长把奇迹当做稀松平常的东西随手展示，告诉我们只要勤加练习，每个人都能拥有这样的力量……他性格有点奇怪，嘴里总是念叨着奇怪的话，但很随和。无论什么时候，有人向他请教魔法的问题，他都会放下自己手上在做的事，认真地回答。他让人想起那种亲切的尖子生，乐于助人的班长……总之，不像外人说的那样。
（另一个声音：你看过「黑之书」了吗？上面写了什么？）
远远地见过，但没读过里面的内容。只有社长能读那本书。他说，只有「被选中的人」才能接触黑之书，其他人碰会有危险。不是没人想趁他不注意把黑之书偷走，但不知道他们经历了什么……总之，最后他们都放弃了那个念头。社长经常捧着那本书，朗诵一些奇怪的句子，说那就是咒语。我抄下过其中的几句，经常练习。
（另一个声音：练习有成效吗？）
没有。当然没有。

*短暂的沉默*

你找上我，大概找错人了。我只是黑之书和社长的一个普通信徒，从没近距离接触过他们，也没因为这段经历损失什么。那次事件……黑之书暴走，失控的异象占领整座楼的时候，我也没有受伤。
对我来说，那段时间就像做了场梦，每天听社长传授魔法，回家认真练习。每次念出咒语时，虽然什么也没发生，但也不会让我因为失败气馁，只觉得是自己火候还不够。只要再努力一些，成为被黑之书选中的人，我也能学会魔法。我真的这么相信过。
我不怪社长。人活一辈子，谁能完全不被骗啊。「每个人都是独一无二的」……这不就是社会最大的谎言吗。
……你回去吧，我没有更多要说了。

*沉默，持续到录音结束*
Content.LocalizedString:
(Background noise)

…Who are you? What do you want? I don't do interviews.
(Another voice: We're not from the media.)
Hm? With all that equipment… Oh, is this about what happened before?

(Prolonged silence)

Come in, then. Don't just stand at the doorway.
(Another voice: Thanks for letting us in.)
What do you want to know?
(Another voice: Just tell us what happened.)
It was nothing special. On my way home from work, I was attacked by a vending machine that suddenly came to life. I was scared out of my wits when the president of the society appeared out of nowhere and effortlessly turned the vending machine into a Puka Sweet Dreams Marshmallow. I thought he was just a kind Esper passing by. When I thanked him, he told me it wasn't an Esper Ability. It was "magic." Espers can only nullify anomalies, but magic can do so much more. And he was just an ordinary person like me. As long as you study magic seriously, even ordinary people can do seemingly impossible things.
(Another voice: So you believed him?)
I was skeptical at first. But after following him to the society, I witnessed miracle after miracle.
(Another voice: "Miracles"?)
You might have other words for it. To me, they were miracles. At every gathering, he would present anomalies that had hurt people or nearly hurt people, and announce he would purify them with the power of magic. He'd draw a magic circle on the ground, and then the ground would glow. Those struggling anomalies would instantly transform into the most ordinary objects. He said this was the power of the Black Tome. The president of the society would casually perform these miracles like they were nothing, telling us that with enough practice, anyone could have this power… He was a bit odd, always muttering strange things, but he was easygoing. No matter when someone asked him about magic, he would set aside whatever he was doing and answer seriously. He reminded you of that friendly top student, or the helpful class representative… Anyway, he wasn't like what outsiders say.
(Another voice: Have you seen the Black Tome? What's written in it?)
I've seen it from a distance, but I've never read what's inside. Only the President could read that book. He said only "the chosen ones" could touch the tome, and it would be dangerous for anyone else to do so. Some people did try to steal the Black Tome when he wasn't paying attention. But I don't know why they all gave up in the end. The President often held that book and recited strange sentences, saying they were incantations. I copied down a few of them and practiced often.
(Another voice: Did the practice work?)
No. Of course not.

(Brief silence)

You've got the wrong person. I was just an ordinary follower of the Black Tome and the President. I never got close to either of them, and I didn't lose anything from this experience. During that incident… when the Black Tome went berserk and anomalies out of control took over the building, I wasn't hurt either.
To me, that time was like a dream. Every day I'd listen to the President talk about magic, then go home and give some serious practice. Every time I recited an incantation, nothing happened, but it never discouraged me. I just thought I wasn't skilled enough. If I had tried a little harder and became someone chosen by the Black Tome, I could've learned magic too. I really believed that.
I don't blame the President. Who goes through life without ever being deceived? "Everyone is unique and special"… Isn't that society's biggest lie?
…You should go. I have nothing more to say.

(Silence continues until the end of the recording)

Content.SourceString:
从小我就觉得，我是与众不同的。我成绩很好，有很多特长，体育成绩也不差，家长、邻居、老师、同学……没人不喜欢我。我的人生就像游戏里的简单模式，轻轻松松就能刷到Lv.99，横扫新手村。我相信，我就是漫画里的主角，是被上天选中的人。
但这种优越感，在我转学之后就荡然无存了。在以前的学校，我稳坐年级第一的交椅；可在这边，我熬夜苦读到凌晨，也才将将混到中游水平。我曾经引以为豪的才艺，在这里也不过是别人的入门级。更绝望的是，越努力，越能意识到自己的平平无奇。就连在午睡部，我的入睡速度和睡眠质量都比不上别人。
……你那是什么表情。哈，你们这帮人生赢家当然不懂了，身为异能者是一件多特殊、多了不得的事啊。你们什么都不用做，不必付出任何努力，就能获得普通人毕生难及的力量。
但我仍然相信，自己一定是特别的。就算遇到种种挫折，只能站在山脚仰望天才的荣光，我依旧这么觉得。因为我就是世界的中心，这个世界是围着我转的，漫画里不也是这么写的吗？真正的救世主，都是一开始人群里最不起眼的那个。所以，现在我所经历的一切，都不过是命运给予我的试炼。没错，天才有很多，只是各自的领域不同。我也只是暂时还没找到那个独属于我的天赋。等到我天赋觉醒的那一天，一切就会回到正轨。
然后，我真的找到了。
第一次听说「黑之书」，是在某个现在已经停止运行的都市传说网站上。在异象走入人类的视野之前，我们把一切无法用科学原理解释的特殊现象称之为魔法。与异能不同，魔法并不是被某一类人群垄断的孤高之物。像我这样的人，只要足够努力，也能掌握这种强大的力量——这就是我在苦苦寻觅的命运的召唤，是我的天命。
得到黑之书之后，后面的一切就都变得理所当然了。最初，它弱得让我失望，上面记载的所谓咒语也没有一点效用。但很快，我发现，只要用低级异象喂养它，它很快就会成长起来，变得无所不能。而比起低级异象效率更高、它更渴望的养料，是人类的信仰心。我当然信仰它，但只有我一个人，没有任何意义。
嗯？是啊，成立社团就是那个时期的事。那时的我，恐怕真的被它彻底蒙蔽了双眼。我满脑子都是把这份来之不易的强大力量抓牢些、再抓牢些，让我成为它唯一的、永远的主人……我不允许任何人觊觎这份力量。然而，为了发展黑之书的信众，增强它的——我的——力量，我用冠冕堂皇的话骗了很多人。和我一样的人。
我犯了个大错。还好没有人在那起事件里受伤，不然，我真的会悔恨一生。不，欺瞒、利用了这些人的责任，已经足够我背负一生了。
我明白了。并不是每个人都是特别的。我也是，你也是，大家都是。就算是异能者，可能能力也不过是能空运一支勺子。被命运选中的特殊之人，在整个历史上都寥寥无几。这个世界上有那么多人，以至于「自认为特别」都是一件普通又大众的事。我也只是芸芸众生之一，这么多年过去，犯下了这么严重的罪过，绕了这么远的路，我终于愿意承认了。
……从拘留所出来后，在街对面等着我的父母和朋友的表情，我这辈子都无法忘记。
虽然由我来说这句话好像很奇怪，但我现在真的是这样想的。不需要异能、魔法、黑之书或谎言，不需要是特别的人，我也能活下去。
Content.LocalizedString:
Ever since I was little, I believed I was special. I had great grades, many talents, and my athletic abilities weren't bad either. Parents, neighbors, teachers, classmates… everyone liked me. My life was like a game on easy mode. I could effortlessly grind to max level and breeze through the newbie village. I was convinced I was the MC of a manga, who wielded the power of gods and anime.
But that sense of superiority vanished after I transferred schools. At my old school, I was firmly seated at the top of my grade. But here, even studying until dawn barely got me to average. The skills I once took pride in were just beginner-level here. What made it more hopeless was that the harder I tried, the more I realized how ordinary I was. Even in the napping club, I couldn't fall asleep as fast or sleep as the others.
…What's with that look? Ha, of course you normies wouldn't understand. Being an Esper is such a special, incredible thing. You don't have to do anything, don't have to put in any effort, and you get powers that ordinary people could never achieve in a lifetime.
But I still believed I had to be special. Even after all those setbacks, even standing at the foot of the mountain looking up at the glory of geniuses, I still felt that way. Because I was the center of the world. The world revolved around me. Isn't that how it works in manga? The true Savior is always the most unremarkable person in the crowd at first. So everything I was going through was just a trial from destiny. That's right, there are many geniuses, each in their own field. I just hadn't found my own unique talent yet. Once my talent awakened, everything would fall into place.
And then, I really did find it.
The first time I heard about the Black Tome was on some urban legend website that's no longer running. Before anomalies entered the public eye, we called all phenomena that couldn't be explained by science "magic." Unlike Esper Abilities, magic wasn't some lofty power monopolized by a select few. Someone like me, as long as I worked hard enough, could master that incredible power. This was the call of destiny I had been searching for. My calling.
After obtaining the Black Tome, everything that followed felt natural. At first, it was disappointed that I was still weak, not to mention the so-called incantations written in it did nothing whatsoever. But soon, I discovered that if I fed it low threat anomalies, it would quickly grow and become all-powerful. And even more efficient than low threat anomalies, what it craved most, was human faith. Of course I had faith in it, but just me alone was meaningless.
Hm? Yes, that's when I started the secret society. Back then, I was probably completely blinded by it. All I could think about was holding onto this hard-won power tighter and tighter, making myself its one and only master until the end of times… I wouldn't allow anyone to covet this power. Nonetheless, to grow the Black Tome's followers and strengthen its power, my power, I deceived many people with pretty words. People just like me.
I made a terrible mistake. Thankfully, no one was hurt in that incident. Otherwise, I really would have regretted it for the rest of my life. No, the responsibility of deceiving and using all those people is already enough to carry for a lifetime.
I understand now. Not everyone is special. Not me, not you, not anyone. Even Espers might only have the ability to move a spoon by telekinesis. Throughout all of history, there have been very few people truly chosen by destiny. Many people in this world believe they are special, to the point that such belief has become commonplace. I am but one with the masses. After all these years, after committing such a serious mistake, after taking such a long detour, I'm finally willing to admit it.
…After I got out of the detention center, I saw the faces of my parents and my friends as they waited for my release… I'll never forget them as long as I live.
It might sound strange coming from me, but this is truly how I feel now. I don't need Esper Abilities, magic, the Black Tome, or lies. I don't need to be special. I can still live a good life.

DisplayText.LocalizedString: The Black Tome takes the form of a massive, heavy book. A purple eye is embedded on its pitch-black cover, unsettling to behold. Once opened, the reader is drawn into its Library, where they face attacks from the Black Tome's manifested body. The tome has beguiled many humans who yearned to learn magic in hope of escaping mundane lives, convincing them to offer their faith and become fuel for its power. The Black Tome's might is the accumulation of all the low threat anomalies it has devoured and the faith of its human followers. Whenever it whips its chains, one cannot help but ask: Is this the power of the written word?

VisionDesc.SourceString:
"只要拉起警戒线并严格阻断人员靠近，这片水域的威胁评级理论上可以降至极低。「水镜伥」并非主动扩张型灾害，而是一种仅限于封闭型自然水体的局部环境异象。
该异象主要表现为：目标水体特定区域的表面张力会出现违背物理常规的「绝对静止」，连带周边区域产生轻微的地磁偏转。根据外围勘探与搜救报告推测，该现象会引发高度的视觉认知危害，部分特定人群在观测水面后会出现幻视幻听，最终导致非典型的「概念性溺亡」事件。*注：已知受害者均呈直立姿态悬浮于水面以下，且呼吸道无任何液体残留。
防范这种异象本该极其简单，只需依靠物理隔绝让其自然休眠即可……然而事实是，总有带有复杂心理病史或极端情绪的个体，如同受到某种低频雷达牵引一般，不择手段地突破封锁线前往该地。随着近期失踪人数突破阈值，间接引发社会恐慌，管理局不得不定期执行现场实地勘探与肃清委托。"
VisionDesc.LocalizedString:
So long as barriers are erected, and all entrances are firmly blocked, the threat level of this body of water can, theoretically, be reduced to low. The "Mirror Wraith" is not an actively expanding disaster, but a localized environmental Anomaly limited to natural bodies of water.
Its primary manifestations are as follows: within specific areas of the water, the surface tension is manipulated into a state of complete stillness. Based on perimeter surveys and search-and-rescue reports, this phenomenon is believed to induce severe cognitive hazards in its victims. Susceptible individuals will experience visual and auditory hallucinations after observing the water's surface, typically resulting in drowning incidents. *Note: All known victims have been found suspended upright beneath the water's surface, with no liquid found in their respiratory tracts.
Preventing an Anomaly of this caliber should be simple. Physical isolation should render it dormant… However, in reality, individuals are often drawn to this Anomaly, even going so far as to risk their livelihoods to come into contact with it. Considering the number of recent disappearances has crossed the normally accepted threshold and thus indirectly triggered a public panic, the Bureau has no choice but to carry out an investigation.

民间委托需求的是彻底消除该水域的诱捕效应。

这意味着肃清行动的本质，是在其构筑的碎镜封闭域内，直面被水体具象化的内心恐惧与阴暗面，亲手击碎那个与自身同源的倒影。"

Civilians have demanded the complete removal of this body of water's luring capabilities.
Direct contact has confirmed that this Anomaly is a mimetic Anomaly driven by a human's "self-perception". As a result, the Anomaly will instantly tear away its disguise and enter a highly aggressive defense state.

Content.SourceString:
"兄弟们，泪湖夜钓太邪门了！刚跑回来，竿都扔那了。 
 
说出来你们可能不信。我大半夜去那儿夜钓，空杆就算了，主要是那水根本不对劲。
那边晚上风大，结果湖心那块一点波澜都没有，平得像块玻璃。我夜光漂砸下去连个波纹都没有，死气沉沉的。后来我实在不信邪，拿着强光手电往水边照，想看看是不是水底有暗流。结果手电筒一打，我就看见靠近湖心，水深差不多半米的地方直挺挺地站着个人！我当时腿直接就软了，连滚带爬上的岸。
 我发誓我没看错，那个人是脚朝下站在水里，脸紧紧贴着水皮朝上看。最邪门的是，我大着胆子拿手电照了一下，那张惨白惨白的脸看着居然跟我自己有几分像……我*现在打字手都在抖。这绝对是里面的水鬼在找替身，还提前把我的脸给印下来了！
谨以此贴提醒各位钓友，半夜别去那破湖夜钓！
听劝啊，真的别去了！"
Content.LocalizedString:
Guys, night fishing at Tearlake is a total no-go! I just ran from there, and even left my rod behind! 
 
I know you'd never believe this, but I went there in the middle of the night to fish, and sure, I wasn't getting any bites or whatever…. But I swear something was wrong with the water!
It gets really windy at night, so you'd think the water would at least have ripples, right? Wrong! Dead still. I couldn't believe my eyes, so I took out a flashlight and shined it at the water, thinking that something might've been affecting the water from below. Instead, the second I turned the flashlight on, I saw a person standing upright, about a couple feet below the water's surface at the center of the lake! I almost screamed in terror, scrambling back to shore.
 I swear that I'm telling the truth. A person was standing there in the middle of the lake! The freakiest part was when I actually shined a light on that… "person" the face on it looked eerily similar to my own. My hands are still shaking while typing this. THAT WAS DEFINITELY A WATER GHOST!!!
I'm posting this as a warning to my fellow anglers: don't fish at that damn lake at night!
Seriously!

Content.SourceString:
"「管理局常规巡查日志」
 
巡查区域：泪湖 
记录员：奥涅伊洛伊

现场情况：在岸边草丛里捡到一副喜玛龙的钓竿和一个马扎。看来昨晚有人在这儿违规夜钓，而且走得太急连装备都不要了。除此之外一切正常。

（纸张背后，潦草的随笔）
之前听薄荷说泪湖这边似乎有危险的异象出没，但我在这儿绕了好几圈，却什么都没看到。不过我听见，水面下有一些不太清醒东西想往上探头，它想让我跟它作伴，可惜我一点儿也不想。它不知道自己离开了水就会死掉吗？它不知道我落进水里也会死掉吗？
话说回来，真不该那么早过来。泪湖实在太潮湿了，真怕自己走着走着就融化在水汽里……还是早点回去让暴躁龙请我吃碗热汤面好了~"
Content.LocalizedString:
"Bureau Routine Patrol Log"
 
Patrol Area: Tearlake 
Recorder: Oneiroi

On-Site Findings: Recovered a fishing rod and a folding stool from the grass by the shore. It seems someone was fishing illegally recently and left hastily, leaving their equipment behind.

(Scribbled note on the back of the page)
Mint had said there might be a dangerous Anomaly lurking around Tearlake, but after walking around for a bit, I didn't see anything. I did hear some movements from the water, but I wasn't interested. What is some aquatic creature gonna do to me?
Come to think of it, I shouldn't have come so early. Tearlake is way too humid at this time of day. I feel like I'm melting through my clothes.

Sign.SourceString: 奥涅伊洛伊——异象管理局收容二组
Sign.LocalizedString: Oneiroi - Bureau of Anomaly Control, CSU-2

DisplayText.SourceString:
"「水镜伥」的本质并非某种不可名状的超自然力，而是一个拟态陷阱异象。它宛如一株巨型猪笼草，潜伏于绝对静止的水面下，窥探着凝视者最深刻的记忆。它将人类心底最强烈的遗憾与羁绊转化为诱捕的「蜜汁」，引诱心怀执念之人越过门扉，甘愿沉溺水底。
然而，一旦猎物看破并展露敌意，它便会撕下温和又甜蜜的伪装，合上「盖子」。它会将入侵者内心的恐惧与阴暗面具象化为致命的倒影。若要将其泯除，就必须在它构筑的碎镜牢笼中，亲手击碎另一个「自我」。
鉴于其运行逻辑的隐蔽性与危害程度，建议管理局将此类依靠生物情绪诱捕猎物的异象纳入较高级别的管控范围中。"
DisplayText.LocalizedString:
The "Mirror Wraith" is not some indescribable supernatural force, but instead a mimicry-based trap Anomaly. Like an alligator, it lurks beneath the water's surface, impossible to detect. For those who peer into the lake, the Anomaly peers back, probing into the deepest memories of the onlooker. It will transform the strongest regrets and desires in the human heart into a "pseudo-nectar", luring those consumed by obsession across the lake's threshold and into the depths willingly.
However, if its prey are aware of the trap, the Anomaly will tear away its disguise and "snap" shut. In these situations, the Anomaly will materialize the onlooker's deepest fears into tangible reflections. To cause nullification, one must personally shatter "themself" within the elusive cage it constructs.
Given the degree of harm this Anomaly poses, it is recommended that the Bureau place this class of Anomaly under higher-level security.

VisionDesc.SourceString:
「歧花」具有植物与动物结合的特征。其具有一定的智力，但智力水平低下，只能作出最基本的空间判断，驱使其行动的主要是本能。在有人靠近时，歧花会对靠近者发起攻击。
主要会使用自身有力的尾部作为身体的支撑，驱动相对瘦弱的四肢进行抓挠或飞踢，也会观察到其旋转身体用尾巴横扫的攻击模式。
近期的目击记录有增加的趋势。
VisionDesc.LocalizedString:
A "Divergent Flower" exhibits both plant and animal traits. It possesses a limited degree of intelligence and acts primarily on instinct. It will attack anyone who approaches.
The Divergent Flower supports its body with its powerful tail, while using its weak limbs to swipe at those that get within range. It's been observed to have the ability to sweep its tail in a wide arc.
The number of recent sighting reports has been steadily increasing.

Content.SourceString:
我记的你说的那些家伙……你了解植物吗？有些植物适应不了城市的环境，只有在野外才能展露出最可爱的一面。在海特洛的郊外，就有一些……
不对不对，跑题了！那天我出门去寻找独特的植物，结果出去后不久，就看到地面上有一个巨大的花苞，我从来没见过这么大的花苞！我兴冲冲地走过去，结果没走几步就闻到一股奇怪的味道，然后头就变得昏昏沉沉的。
紧接着，我看到那个花苞变成了两个、三个，周围开满了红色的花朵，我就知道这花香应该是有毒的——毕竟中毒这种事情也不是第一次发生了，我觉得没什么大不了的。我准备先远离它，结果那朵花居然站了起来，一蹦一跳地朝我靠近……
还好，我的求生本能战胜了好奇心，赶紧跑掉了。第二天，我准备了过滤面具和护目镜，回到了那个地方，却发现那朵奇怪的花已经消失了……要不是你来问我，我真以为当时只是我中毒后的幻觉呢。
Content.LocalizedString:
I remember what you said about those guys… You know plants? Some plants just can't adapt to the city environment—they only show their cute side out in the wild. There are some like that on the outskirts of Hethereau, actually…
No, no… Anyways! That day, I went out looking for unusual plants, and not long after I left, I spotted a giant bud on the ground. I'd never seen one that big before! I went to take a look, but after just a few steps, I caught a strange smell and started to feel dizzy.
What was once one bud became two, then three… then red flowers began to bloom all around it. That's when I realized the flower's aroma must've been poisonous—but hey, getting poisoned wasn't exactly a first for me, so I didn't think it was a big deal. I was about to back away, and then that flower actually stood up and started hopping toward me…
Luckily, my survival instincts beat out my curiosity, and I made a break for it! The next night, I came back properly suited up, only to find that the weird flower had mysteriously vanished… Had you not asked, I would've thought the whole thing to be a hallucination…

Content.SourceString:
和它们战斗并非易事。对于一般市民来说，这些异象会很危险。
当时店里接到一个加急委托，没有其他空余人手，所以由我来处理。委托人要求我驱逐闯入花园里的花朵。你问……「闯入」？没错，这朵花有移动的能力。
未被惊扰时，它就像是普通的植物一样。当我靠近，我闻到了一股甜腻的味道，那种味道会让人眩晕，反应力变得迟钝。几乎同时，它站了起来，蹦跳着朝我靠近，试图攻击我。在被我重创后，它从两个「头部」投射出「种子」，并迅速生长，成为了两个新的个体。这次我瞄准它们的「头部」攻击，顺利解决掉了。
如果遭遇异常巨大的花朵，最好还是避开。不得不战斗的话，迅速、准确地攻击「头部」，是最有效的手段。
Content.LocalizedString:
These Anomalies are a danger to the public.
Late one night, the shop received an urgent commission. The client said a flower had "trespassed" onto their yard. Everyone else was asleep, so I handled it. Do I seriously mean… "trespassed"? That's right. This flower can move.
When left undisturbed, it looks like any ordinary plant. But when you approach it, your head begins to spin, and your reactions aren't quite as quick anymore. When I got close, it began hopping towards me, as if to attack. After I wounded it, it began to launch "seeds" from its two "heads", which quickly began to regrow into two new individual plants. I made sure to target their heads and dispose of them without future trouble.
In my opinion, if you come across any unusually large flower, avoid it at all costs. If you must fight, focus on the heads.

Sign.SourceString: 达芙蒂尔——伊波恩古董店

工单编号：101775-8-4-星期日
维修情况：未完成
故障检测：电路问题排除/设备损坏问题排除/设备老化问题排除
详情：晚上十点二十一分到达指定修理地点。路灯呈现不断闪烁的状态，频率不定。初步判断为接触不良。首先对附近的电箱进行电路检修，未发现明显问题。对其余路灯进行检查后，确认排除是电路问题。推断为该电灯的设备存在老化的可能，遂对灯泡进行更换。搭好梯子后，手接触到灯泡时感到异常的冰凉，完全没有因为能耗而产生的发热现象。将灯泡取下后进行通电检测，结果完全正常，灯泡没有任何损坏。
此时突然有人抽掉了脚下的梯子，导致我直接摔了下来。起身后发现附近无任何路过的人，而维修梯已经不见踪影。考虑到事态异常，猜测可能会涉及异象方面的事情。在保证自身安全后离开了现场，返回维修部并将反馈提交给异象管理局。
海特洛市电力维护和管理公司。
Content.LocalizedString:
Work Order No.: 101775-8-4-Sunday
Repair Status: Incomplete
Fault Diagnosis: Circuit issue ruled out/Equipment damage ruled out/Equipment aging ruled out
Details: Arrived at the designated repair location at 10:21 p.m. The streetlight was flickering on and off at irregular intervals. My initial assessment was a faulty circuit breaker. I first inspected the nearby electrical box and found no obvious issues. After checking the other streetlights, I confirmed it was not a circuit issue. I then inferred that the fixture might be affected by aging equipment and proceeded to switch out the bulb. After setting up the ladder, I found the bulb was unnaturally cold to the touch, with no heat buildup from the light. After removing the bulb and performing a power test, the results were completely normal, and the bulb showed no damage.
At that point, someone suddenly pulled the ladder out from under me, causing me to fall. After getting back up, I found no bystanders nearby, but the maintenance ladder was gone without a trace. Given the unusual circumstances, I suspected the matter might involve an Anomaly. After ensuring my own safety, I left the scene, returned to the maintenance department, and submitted the report to the Bureau of Anomaly Control.
Hethereau City Power Maintenance and Management Company.

"「巡山日志·林地区域异常反馈」
反馈人：西西里安-驻地护林员
日期：周三03:30，雨转阴

……虽然已经反馈过很多次了，但直到今天依然没人来解决。我有必要再次向管理局提交申请，请尽快派专员来处理这片林地里的异常。
师父当年退休前就严肃警告过我这片林地的问题。他说从他年轻巡山的时候起，就能撞见两套空衣服在一个根本不可能出现在树林里的幻象舞厅里跳舞。
那时候他们以为那是山里的雾气，或者某种海市蜃楼之类的光学现象，以为过阵子自然就散了。 可结果是，师父巡了一辈子山，它们也跳了一辈子。
现在我接管这片区域也快一年了，它们一秒钟都没停过，甚至风雨无阻。这根本不是什么自然现象，这就是一个诡异的异象！管理局要是再不派人进行物理清除，不然哪天普通人闯进去，真不知道还要出多大的乱子。"
Content.LocalizedString:
"Mountain Patrol Log: Forest Area Anomaly Report"
Submitted by: Sicilian - Resident Forest Ranger
Date: Wednesday, 03:30; Weather: Overcast, with rain

…I've reported this many times already, but even now no one has come to deal with the problem. I need to submit another request to the Bureau, and especially request that a specialist come to handle the Anomaly in this forest immediately.
Before he retired, my mentor warned me about the dangers of these parts of the woods. He said that, ever since he was a young ranger, he would repeatedly run into two sets of empty clothes dancing endlessly in the middle of the forest.
Back then, most had considered it some sort of mirage created by the mountain fog—but my mentor had spent the better part of his life patrolling these paths, and had seen those two dancing regularly.
I've been in charge of this area for almost a year now, and those two have yet to stop! This is no natural phenomenon, I assure you. It's some weird Anomaly! If the Bureau won't do anything, who knows how much trouble it'll cause.

Content.SourceString:
"「市民事务联络函·关于深林异象的清理申请」
申请人：海月
所属区域：玉饼街居民协会

……关于本周接报的辖区市民野营遇袭事件，特此提交补充说明。
上周六，我辖区内的几位居民前往城外林地进行露营。据当事人后续向我协会提交的事件笔录与医疗备案显示，他们在林中深入探险时，偶然发现了处于「幻象舞会厅」内的旧小提琴与指环。
笔录指出，其中一位当事人出于好奇，试图触碰并捡拾指环，这一行为瞬间激起了该区域「瑰夜魅影」男款个体的极端排斥反应，并对当事人发起了凶猛的进攻。万幸的是，该异象的攻击行为似乎受到「舞台范围」的严格界限约束。几位居民在惊慌弃置随身露营装备，狼狈逃离幻象覆盖的范围后，男款个体便停止了追击，折返场中继续舞步。目前当事人仅因擦伤和受惊在社区诊所休养，无生命危险。
尽管此次事件未造成严重伤亡，但作为辖区安全事务的责任方，我协会对此深感担忧。经查，该林地近期在户外探险论坛上的讨论热度正持续上升，若不尽早介入，市民再次误入并遭遇危险的可能性极高。出于对辖区居民人身安全的负责，我谨代表本街道向管理局提交正式申请，请务必尽快协调专员前往该处，对徘徊在林间的「瑰夜魅影」执行彻底的泯除或收容工作。"
Content.LocalizedString:
"Citizen Affairs Liaison Letter: Application to Clear the Deep Forest Anomaly"
Applicant: Aurelia
Affiliation: Tamamochi Street Resident Association

Concerning the assaults on citizens camping within our jurisdiction, I hereby submit this supplementary statement:
Last Saturday, several residents went camping in the forest outside the city. According to the incident reports and medical records, the campers discovered an old violin and ring inside a "Phantom Ballroom" while exploring the woods.
The statements noted that one of the individuals tried to pick up the ring. This immediately triggered an extreme response from the nearby male-form "Scarlet Phantom", which began to attack the individual responsible. The residents then proceeded to abandon their camping equipment and fled beyond the illusory stage. The individuals are currently recovering at the local clinic from minor injuries and shock, and none are in life-threatening condition.
Although the incident resulted in no serious injuries, our association remains concerned for public safety. Without prompt intervention, there's a high risk that an incident like this could be repeated. On behalf of the public, I hereby submit a formal application to the Bureau and respectfully request that Specialists be dispatched as soon as possible to quell the "Scarlet Phantom" roaming the woods.

Sign.SourceString: 海月——玉饼街居民协会商店街管理员
Sign.LocalizedString: Aurelia — Shopping Street Administrator, Tamamochi Street Resident Association

DisplayText.SourceString:
"「瑰夜魅影」普遍被认为会被高品质的演艺活动吸引，并且会伴随演出的谢幕而自然泯除。大多数情况下，出现在舞台环境中的「瑰夜魅影」不仅不会构成大危害，甚至会被艺术家视作演出成功的象征。
然而，该异象容易受到附有强烈人类执念的实体物影响，并根据执念的不同，为自己构建出相应的舞台，无法按照常规逻辑泯除。
若要清除该隐患，执行者必须介入其构筑的舞台幻象中，依靠物理手段击溃区域内核心个体，让演出强制落幕，促使该个体满足底层法则从而自然泯除。
那对企图在荒野中超越终幕的人类大师或许从未料到，他们用生命和傲骨搭起的完美舞台，最终也只是一座荒诞的牢笼。而见证这段伟大戏剧谢幕的，既没有掌声也不是观众，只有来自一个不解风情者的白刃。"
DisplayText.LocalizedString:
"Scarlet Phantom" is widely believed to be drawn to world-class performances and undergoes natural nullification once the curtains close. Typically, the appearance of a "Scarlet Phantom" poses little to no threat and is often regarded as complementary to the artists.
However, this Anomaly can be easily influenced by objects imbued with human "obsession". Depending on the nature of that obsession, the "Scarlet Phantom" will construct a corresponding stage for itself, therefore causing natural nullification to no longer be possible.
To then nullify this Anomaly, the executor must enter the stage's illusion and utilize physical force to destroy the Core entity—thus bringing the performance to an end. This will then satisfy the Anomaly's underlying rules and lead to its natural nullification.
The masters who once sought to transcend the final curtain of existence may have never imagined the perfect stage they built would eventually become nothing more than a bizarre prison. When that legendary epic was finalized, there was neither an audience nor applause.

VisionDesc.SourceString:
"异象「伤心英熊」与异象「罐头锡兵」在同一区域内诞生后，自然形成的一种独特现象。
两种异象共同占据一片区域，「伤心英熊」通常站立在高处观望，周围的「罐头锡兵」则来回踱步，举行着类似于军队练兵的活动。「伤心英熊」如同将军般统领着周围的「罐头锡兵」，后者则心甘情愿地接受前者的统领，并像真正的士兵那样保护着自己的将军。如有行人靠近，「罐头锡兵」会对其进行驱逐。如若行人执意要进入此区域，则会受到攻击。异象们占据的区域时常位于某些必经之路上，这极大影响了周围居民的正常生活。"
VisionDesc.LocalizedString:
This is a unique phenomenon that forms naturally when the Anomalies "Saddy Teddy" and "Tin Soldier" emerge in the same location.
The "Saddy Teddy" usually stands on high ground, keeping watch, while the surrounding "Tin Soldiers" pace back and forth, carrying out actions resembling military drills. Resembling a general, the "Saddy Teddy" commands the nearby "Tin Soldiers". The Tin Soldiers obey willingly, protecting their "general" like true soldiers… If pedestrians approach, the "Tin Soldiers" will drive them off. If the pedestrian insists, they will inevitably be attacked. The locations that these Anomalies frequent are often found along routes people frequent, therefore greatly disrupting nearby residents' daily lives.

HouseCondition.SourceString: 优先击败「伤心英熊」，再击败所有「罐头锡兵」
HouseCondition.LocalizedString: Defeat Saddy Teddy first, then defeat all Tin Soldiers.

AnnihilateCondition.SourceString: 头顶的拉环与心脏的玩具，先击破哪个呢？
AnnihilateCondition.LocalizedString: The pull ring above its head and the toy in its heart—which should we break first?

Content.SourceString:
"不好意思啊，我已经记不清这群家伙是什么时候出现的了。当时我刚在河道测试完新摩托艇，刚准备歇会儿，转个头就看到一头熊带着一群小兵人在那训练，太有意思了就多看了会儿。他们的队形莫名其妙的，看着有点难受！不过小兵的身体结构很精巧，单拎出来看它们走路的样子也不错。
没多久突然有个小伙子闯进来对熊一顿暴揍，中途小兵围了上来，他又去揍小兵；收拾到一半，好像又觉得自己应该去和熊单挑，结果折腾了很久，明明我看他三两下就能先解决掉一边的。收拾完小兵之后，那熊就变得跟发了狂一样，大概是因为自己的「部下」被干掉了在生气吧，哈哈哈。不过这也不是那个小伙子的对手，最后还是圆满解决了。
问我在干什么吗？我没有异能不会打架，没必要上去添乱，所以就是在边上看着咯。
——哦哦，原来你就是那个小伙子啊，换了身衣服我没认出来，不好意思啊。你很厉害，为你鼓掌！
对了，那几个小兵的外观还挺有意思的，不知道是什么材质。下次要是再遇到，能让我上手摸摸吗？"
Content.LocalizedString:
Sorry, I can't really recall when this bunch first showed up. I'd just finished testing a new motorboat when I turned around and saw a bear attacking a bunch of Tin Soldiers. It was quite entertaining, so I watched for a while. Their formation was bizarre, though—kind of painful to watch, frankly. Still, the Tin Soldiers were constructed with impressive precision, and the way they marched was mesmerizing.
Not long after that, some random guy suddenly rushed in and started fighting the bear! The Tin Soldiers swarmed him, so he ended up chasing them instead. Halfway through, it seemed as if he couldn't decide who to fight. After he took care of the Tin Soldiers, the bear went wild. The guy managed to take care of the bear, too.
Curious why I was just watching? I don't have any Esper ability, so I figured I was better off just watching.
—Oh, so you're actually that young guy! I couldn't recognize you after you changed your clothes. Kudos to you!
Oh, and those Tin Soldiers looked pretty interesting. I wonder what they were made of. If we run into them again, mind if I touch them?

Content.SourceString:
"XX月XX日 任务记录
接到任务通知，前往处理异象「伤心英熊」与异象「罐头锡兵」。
过程有点小小波折，，，最后顺利解决。

我一开始就想，当然是要「擒贼先擒王」了！就直冲着那头熊去了。但是边上有个老先生坐着，我怕罐头锡兵伤到他，所以又觉得应该先解决锡兵。打着打着发现锡兵好像只围着我，不会去攻击别人，所以还是先打倒熊重要！可是一群锡兵围在这也很麻烦……
……幸好有小罗在，小罗帮我把锡兵解决了，我才能专心跟这位「英熊」对决。
其实不是什么难搞的异象，只是昨天不小心喝了咖啡一晚上没睡着，脑子很混乱……再也不喝咖啡了。"
Content.LocalizedString:
XX/XX Mission Log
Got the mission notice and went to handle the Anomalies "Saddy Teddy" and "Tin Soldiers."
There were a few hiccups along the way… but it was managed in the end.

I had initially thought to focus on the bigger enemy, so I charged straight at the bear. An old gentleman was sitting nearby, however, and I was worried for his safety—so I turned my focus to the Tin Soldiers. After I realized the Tin Soldiers' focus was primarily on me, I shifted my target back to the bear.
Luckily, Dally was there and helped me get rid of the Tin Soldiers so I could put my full focus on this "Saddy Teddy".
Honestly, the whole thing was no big deal.

DisplayText.SourceString: 「伤心英熊和它的罐头锡兵」是一种奇特的异象共存现象，「伤心英熊」统领着「罐头锡兵」，模仿人类军队的操练方式，只不过这种模仿较为粗糙。可以看出，异象之间并非隔离的个体，不同的异象有可能联结出独特的关系，而这种关系所带来的不确定性与危险性，需要得到关注。

This indicates that Anomalies are not isolated entities—different Anomalies can form unique relationships, though the uncertainty and danger those relationships introduce warrant close attention.

VisionDesc.SourceString:
「空若」，一种形似鹿的歧骸，是物体异象「圆觉」盔甲的伴生歧骸，其具体诞生原因随着时代动荡，许多资料佚散，现已不可考。空若按照其出现早晚的顺序，依次为「识」、「行」、「想」、「受」、「色」，共计5只，在圆觉认主后，空若也会成为盔甲持有者的帮手，提供不错的助力。
空若个体之间存在差异，能力各有侧重，性格也各不相同。「色」最为年幼，时常出现在盔甲外，帮助处理日常琐事，「受」最亲人，「想」擅书画，「行」善战，而「识」最为年长，几乎不出现在人前。
VisionDesc.LocalizedString:
A "Sunya" is a deer-like Oddity. They are also the surge oddity associated with the Object Anomaly: "Enlightenment". Due to the recent upheavals over the years, much of the documentation on the exact origin of the armor has been lost. The five currently documented Sunya are "Vinnana", "Sankhara", "Sanna", "Vedana", and "Rupa". Once "Enlightenment" recognizes an owner, the Sunya also tag along as assistants to the armor's bearer.
It's important to note that each individual Sunya is unique in their own way, and even has distinct abilities and personalities. "Rupa" is the youngest of the Sunya, and often appears to help with daily chores. "Vedana" is the most affectionate toward people. "Sanna" excels in calligraphy and painting. "Sankhara" is quite skilled in combat. "Vinnana", on the other hand, is the eldest, and prefers to stay out of the limelight.

Content.SourceString: 要我说啊，空若可比那群小鬼头们省心多了，不仅能帮衬着阿德勒做些事情，那个叫「想」的小鹿，在品鉴古画上面颇有一手，收回来的古画还知道怎么保养，真是让我省心不少。还有那个叫「识」的老头，虽然说话啰里啰嗦的，却懂品酒，连便利店里的罐装啤酒他都能说上几句，据他所说，他还有好几坛藏起来的私酿，都是大几百年的存货……总有一天能让我找着。
Content.LocalizedString: If you ask me, the Sunya are an easy bunch to take care of. They can assist Adler with all kinds of things—for example, that cute little thing, Sanna, is quite good at appraising old paintings. She even knows how to maintain the paintings we bring back, which saves me a ton of hassle. Then there's that old fellow Vinnana. He's a rambler for sure, but he knows his alcohol! He's got an opinion on every single thing you can find on the shelf at the convenience store. According to him, he's got several jars of homebrew tucked away for centuries. One of these days, I'm gonna make sure to find them!

Content.SourceString:
这是我失明后第一次写日记，以前的日记本被丢了，现在这本是月退家的管家给我的，希望这本能保存的时间长一点。
……
打扫储藏室很轻松，这样我有更多时间可以学习一些新东西。
……
原来这副盔甲的名字是「圆觉」。
……
在空若的帮助下，我把以前的日记重新誊写了一遍，看不见之后写的字也变形了，很多字都认不出，只能依靠上下文猜测，还好能猜出不少。
……
我现在正在月退家的后山上，今天下了一点小雪，好在上山前就停了。「行」带来了帐篷和毛毯，「色」带了锅，「受」背着食材，我们煮了一锅胡萝卜汤，空若们都很喜欢胡萝卜，「识」还带了一壶酒，「想」在这天画了一副我们的合照并送给了我，我决定就放在这本日记本里。
……
娜娜莉喜欢小羊排和蛋卷，早雾喜欢甜牛奶，埃德嘉喜欢曲奇饼，塔吉多喜欢新鲜的海胆，达芙蒂尔小姐喜欢高甜的蛋糕，小姐喜欢，酒。鉴定师似乎没什么特殊的偏好，有很健康的饮食习惯。
……
「受」和「识」最近胡萝卜摄入太多，有点变色，苦恼。
……
另外三只空若也变色了。
Content.LocalizedString:
This is my first diary entry since losing my sight. My old diary was thrown away, and this new one was given to me by the butler of the Tsukinoki household.
…
Cleaning out the storage room was no big deal, so nowadays I have more time to dedicate to learning.
…
Turns out, there's this set of armor deemed "Enlightenment".
…
With the help of Sunya, I was able to recopy my old diary entries after my sight left me. My handwriting's become completely illegible, and I can barely understand my own writing.
…
As of right now, I'm currently on the hill behind the Tsukinoki residence. It snowed a bit today, but luckily it had already stopped by the time we were headed up. Sankhara brought some blankets and a tent, Rupa, a pot, and Vedana carried all the ingredients we needed. We ended up making a pot of carrot soup. Unsurprisingly, all the Sunya love eating carrots! Vinnana also slipped in a bottle of wine, and Sanna ended up drawing a group portrait of us all. I'm including the drawing in this diary.
…
For Future Reference: Nanally really likes lamb chops and egg rolls, Sakiri enjoys sweet milk, Edgar loves cookies, Taygedo likes sea urchin, Ms. Daffodill always wants extra slices of sweet cake, and for the young lady… wine. Weirdly enough, the Appraiser doesn't seem to have any particular eating preferences, and surprisingly eats very healthily!
…
Vedana and Vinnana have eaten a bit too many carrots lately, and are actually… starting to change color. Very worrying.
…
The other three Sunya have changed color… too.

DisplayText.SourceString: 对于伊波恩的大家来说，空若是和家人一样的存在，而家人，就是在遇到事情时可以尽情倾诉的对象，即使那件让人烦恼的事情，小的就像是一块胡萝卜蛋糕一样。空若带着锅「离家出走」，是为了给阿德勒先生一个惊喜，阿德勒先生对空若们来说，是伊波恩的管家先生，也是从更早前开始就要相伴一生的家人。
DisplayText.LocalizedString: To Sunya, everyone is family. Family is those you can pour your heart out to when something is bothering you… even something as small as what to eat for dessert that day. Sunya may have "run away from home" with Mr. Adler's pot, but it was just to surprise Mr. Adler! To Sunya and the others, Mr. Adler is a lifelong member of their family.

VisionDesc.SourceString:
在这副镜子的一角刻有的「爱丽丝」告诉了我们它的主人的名字，除此之外便再无其他信息。通过调查海特洛市的人口普查表单，并没有获得比这个名字更多的信息。这说明有两种情况：要么这是一个假名；要么，这是一个很久以前的人留下的作品，久到人口普查还未开展，甚至久到海特洛还不存在。
所有接触过镜子的游客统一声称周围的事物在眼里变得巨大，他们发现自己来到了一个陌生的屋子里，准确的说是一个「巨人房间」。他们声称自己经历了一场前所未有的冒险旅程，并尝试着从那个房间里逃离。在成功逃离房间后，游客会陷入昏迷失去意识，等醒来后发现自己回到了现实世界，就趴在那副镜子旁边，好似刚才的一切经历不过是像是一场梦。
VisionDesc.LocalizedString:
The name "Alice," engraved in one corner of this mirror, is the only clue we have of its owner. Beyond that, no further information has been found. A search of Hethereau's census records yielded nothing beyond the name itself. This suggests two possibilities: either it's an alias, or this object was left behind by someone from so long ago that the census had not yet begun—perhaps even before Hethereau itself existed.
All visitors who have come into contact with the mirror have consistently reported that the objects around them appeared enormous. Then, they found themselves in an unfamiliar room—or more precisely, a "Giant Room." They claimed to have undergone an unprecedented journey and attempted to escape. After successfully escaping, the visitors would lose consciousness. When they awoke later, they found themselves back in real life, lying beside the mirror, as if the entire experience had been nothing more than a dream.

VisionDesc.SourceString:
在这副镜子的一角刻有的「爱丽丝」告诉了我们它的主人的名字，除此之外便再无其他信息。通过调查海特洛市的人口普查表单，并没有获得比这个名字更多的信息。这说明有两种情况：要么这是一个假名；要么，这是一个很久以前的人留下的作品，久到人口普查还未开展，甚至久到海特洛还不存在。
所有接触过镜子的游客统一声称周围的事物在眼里变得巨大，他们发现自己来到了一个陌生的屋子里，准确的说是一个「巨人房间」。他们声称自己经历了一场前所未有的冒险旅程，并尝试着从那个房间里逃离。在成功逃离房间后，游客会陷入昏迷失去意识，等醒来后发现自己回到了现实世界，就趴在那副镜子旁边，好似刚才的一切经历不过是像是一场梦。
在临床医学里存在一种特殊的病症——视物显大症。这是一种空间感知障碍，患者眼前的一切事物会变得比实际更大。相较于幻觉来说，该症状存在更多解释的可能和诱因。
然而问题在于，所有游客都声称那个「巨人房间」内的一切东西都是真实存在，可以触碰的。这使得幻觉或是病症的解释原因站不住脚。因此推断那个所谓的「巨人房间」是该异象所生成的一个异象空间。相较于其他异象空间来说，其特殊之处在于这个空间不存在于现实中的任何一个地方或是任何一个位面，它不存在一个切实的本体，而是依托与人的梦境之中（当然，若要将梦境看作一个位面也是可以的）。
在后续的观察中，部分游客回到现实后仍然会展现出对镜子里的那个世界的眷恋。经过检查后排除了生理上的依赖性，推断为心理产生的某种依赖作用。除了这批待观察的游客外，其余均无生理和心理上的影响。综合考虑后，决定降低对该异象的危险度评定。
VisionDesc.LocalizedString:
The name "Alice," engraved in one corner of this mirror, is the only clue we have of its owner. Beyond that, no further information has been found. A search of Hethereau's census records yielded nothing beyond the name itself. This suggests two possibilities: either it's an alias, or this object was left behind by someone from so long ago that the census had not yet begun—perhaps even before Hethereau itself existed.
All visitors who have come into contact with the mirror have consistently reported that the objects around them appeared enormous. Then, they found themselves in an unfamiliar room—or more precisely, a "Giant Room." They claimed to have undergone an unprecedented journey and attempted to escape. After successfully escaping, the visitors would lose consciousness. When they awoke later, they found themselves back in real life, lying beside the mirror, as if the entire experience had been nothing more than a dream.
In clinical medicine, there is a rare condition known as macropsia. It is a disorder of spatial perception in which everything seen by the patient appears larger than it actually is. Compared with hallucinations, this symptom allows for a wider range of possible explanations and triggers.
The issue, however, is that all visitors insist that everything inside the "Giant Room" was real and could be touched and interacted with. This makes explanations based on hallucination or illness untenable. We therefore infer that the so-called "Giant Room" is an Anomalous Realm generated by an Anomaly. Unlike other Anomalous Realms, this Realm's unusual trait is that it exists neither anywhere in reality nor on any other plane. It has no concrete physical form of its own, and instead depends on the human dream for its existence (though the dream could, of course, also be treated as a plane in its own right).
In subsequent observations, some visitors continued to display a lingering attachment to the world inside the mirror after returning to reality. Examinations ruled out any physiological dependency, instead suggesting a form of psychological dependence. Aside from the visitors who remain under observation, all others showed no physiological or psychological effects. After considering all the factors, we have decided to lower this Anomaly's danger rating.

爱丽丝，爱丽丝，小小鸽子长不高。
镜子先生帮帮我，想要长大如何好？
何故着急长大个，白白胖胖才叫妙。
不要急，不要慌，镜子总能来帮忙。
看看这里看看那，变大变小随你挑。
只要身处镜子中，美妙愿望任你想。
快醒醒，快醒醒，管家先生把你叫。
张张嘴吧打哈欠，伸伸胳膊抻懒腰。
原来方才梦一场，肚子咕咕晚饭到。
金餐盘，银刀叉，晚餐宴会真热闹。
兔子先生柴郡猫，皇帝皇后来驾到。
头晕眼花冒金星，快快端菜上桌角。
爱丽丝，爱丽丝，小小乳鸽味道棒。
Content.LocalizedString:
Alice, Alice, little pigeon that can't grow tall.
Mr. Mirror, help me, please—how can I grow big at all?
Why rush to grow up so fast? Plump and healthy's best of all.
Don't be hasty, don't be scared—Mr. Mirror's here to aid.
Look here, look there—grow big or small, whichever choice you've made.
So long as you're inside the mirror, any lovely wish comes true.
Wake up now, wake up now, Mr. Butler's calling you.
Open wide and give a yawn, stretch your arms and shake off sleep.
KooKoo tummy says dinner's here—turns out it was just a dream.
Golden plates and silver forks—the dinner party's in full swing.
Mr. Rabbit, Cheshire Cat—the Emperor and Queen arrive.
Dizzy, dazzled, seeing stars—hurry, any dish will suffice.
Alice, Alice, the little pigeon that tastes so fine.

Content.SourceString:
「采访开始了，卡罗尔先生。先前已经经过了您的同意，允许对本次采访进行录音。在正式开始之前再和您确认一下。」
「是的，我同意。」
「那么能否请你谈谈整个经历的全部过程。」
「我在报告中都写全了。」
「但是我想听你亲口说，毕竟在录音。」
「好……当时我进入到游乐园的那个设施后，四周有点昏暗，两边摆满了各种各样的镜子。我还不小心打碎了一个。然后……然后我就接着往里走，看到了一副镜框和一面镜子并排摆放到一起。我上前摸了摸那镜子的镜面……再然后就就是一阵头晕目眩。我想我是昏过去了。」
「当你再次醒来的时候，就发现自己变小了，来到了一个陌生的房间，对吧？」
「对……或者说，是周围的东西变大了。我闹不清。总之，为了找到回去的方法，我就开始在那个房间里到处乱转。」
「抱歉打断您一下，请问那个房间里，除了其他东西都变大了，还有什么不同的地方吗？比如……有什么你平日里不会见到的东西。」
「没……应该没有了。」
「好的，请继续，卡罗尔先生。」
「然后……然后在我四处闲逛时，有一只猫，一只大猫！它开始追我，像是要把我当作它的食物！我吓坏了！你能明白吗？比一栋房子还大的猫！」
「冷静点，卡罗尔先生。」
「不，我怎么冷静？那猫跑得飞快，我躲在下水道里才没被抓住。要是被抓住，我肯定早被它吃了！」
「然后呢，你是怎么成功逃出来的？」
「我不知道，下水道很黑，我像没头苍蝇一样乱转。不知道过了多久，从远处能够看到光亮，我想我逃出去了。但是那强光越来越刺眼，紧接着是一阵翻江倒海的恶心后又昏过去了。」
「等你再醒来，你发现自己晕倒在镜子旁边，回到了那个设施里。」
「对……对……然后回来后的几天我精神状况一直不是很好，夜晚总之做噩梦，梦见那只大猫追我！」
「恕我直言，卡罗尔先生。您的这个遭遇……听上去像是某种童话故事？」
「童话故事？是噩梦！噩梦！你居然把它叫做童话故事！那只大猫差点把我吃掉！你还在这里说风凉话！你个——」
「冷静！冷静！卡罗尔先生！」
「喂！把他们拉开，把安保叫来！快点！」
Content.LocalizedString:
"We're beginning the interview now, Mr. Carol. You previously consented to this interview being recorded. Before we formally begin, I'd like to confirm that once more."
"Yes, I consent."
"Could you please walk me through everything that happened?"
"I already wrote it all in the report."
"But I'd like to hear it in your own words, since we're recording."
"All right… After I went into that amusement park attraction, it was kind of dim inside, and both walls were lined with all kinds of mirrors. As I continued going further in, I saw a mirror frame and a mirror placed side by side. I reached out and touched the mirror's surface… and then… then I just got horribly dizzy. I must've blacked out."
"When you woke up again, you found that you'd shrunk and had ended up in an unfamiliar room, correct?"
"Right… or maybe everything around me got larger. I couldn't tell. Anyway, I started wandering around that room, trying to find a way out."
"Sorry to interrupt. In that room, aside from everything being bigger, was there anything unusual? For example… anything you wouldn't normally see in your day-to-day?"
"No… Not that I remember."
"All right. Please continue, Mr. Carol."
"Then… while I was wandering around, there was a cat—a huge cat! It started chasing me, like it wanted to make a meal out of me! I was terrified! A cat bigger than a house!"
"Please calm down, Mr. Carol."
"How am I supposed to calm down? That cat was unbelievably fast. I only avoided getting caught by hiding in the sewer. If it had caught me, it would've eaten me alive!"
"And then? How did you manage to escape?"
"I don't know. The sewer was pitch-black, and I was running around like a headless chicken. I don't know how much time passed, but eventually I saw light in the distance, and I thought I had finally escaped. But the light kept getting brighter and brighter, then I was hit with this violent nausea and blacked out again."
"When you woke up again, you found that you'd collapsed beside the mirror and were back inside the amusement park".
"Right… right… And for days after I returned, I wasn't doing well. I kept having nightmares that huge cat was chasing me!"
"Forgive my bluntness, Mr. Carol, but your experience… sounds rather similar to some kind of fairy tale."
"A fairy tale? It was a nightmare! A nightmare! And you're calling it a fairy tale? That huge cat almost ate me! And you're standing there making light of it! You—"
"Calm down! Calm down, Mr. Carol!"
"Hey! Pull them apart and call security! Now!"

DisplayText.SourceString: 对于「爱丽丝的梳妆镜」的来源进行调查是徒劳的。相比之下，它所创造的那个异象空间和那段奇妙之旅更值得探讨。镜子并不总是忠实地还原我们本来的面貌。相反，比起表象与面貌，它往往反映出的是我们内心的欲望。那片如梦般的童话世界，蕴含着一场所有人在幼年时期都渴望的奇幻冒险。富有童心的游客们以一种独特的方式补完了自己童年时期的遗憾和幻想。
DisplayText.LocalizedString: Investigating the origins of "Alice's Looking Glass" is futile. Far more worthy of discussion are the Anomalous Realm it creates—and the wondrous journey within. Mirrors do not always faithfully reflect our "true" appearance. More often than not, it reveals the desires hidden deep within our hearts. The dreamlike fairy-tale world of Alice's Looking Glass holds the kind of fantastical adventure everyone longs for in their childhood. Visitors who still carry a childlike whimsy can atone for childhood regrets by fulfilling old fantasies.
