Mirrors do not always faithfully reflect our "true" appearance. More often than not, they reveal the desires hidden deep within our hearts. A strange Anomalous Realm is connected to reality through the mirror. As long as you can escape that odd room, you can return to reality. The room itself resembles an Anomaly attraction at an amusement park.

PreviewText.LocalizedString: Recorded from the Perspective of the Superego

DisplayText.SourceString: 对于「爱丽丝的梳妆镜」的来源进行调查是徒劳的。相比之下，它所创造的那个异象空间和那段奇妙之旅更值得探讨。镜子并不总是忠实地还原我们本来的面貌。相反，比起表象与面貌，它往往反映出的是我们内心的欲望。那片诡异的巨人世界，它究竟存在于现实中，还只是梦境里？贸然进入来历不明的异象空间无疑是危险的。或许，这副镜子的主人在这异象空间中曾遭遇过什么。而我们永远也不会知道了。
DisplayText.LocalizedString: Investigating the origins of "Alice's Looking Glass" is futile. Far more worthy of discussion are the Anomalous Realm it creates—and the wondrous journey within. Mirrors do not always faithfully reflect our "true" appearance. More often than not, they reveal the desires hidden deep within our hearts. Did that eerie world of giants truly exist, or was it only a part of the dream? Entering an Anomalous Realm of unknown origin rashly is unquestionably dangerous. Perhaps the mirror's owner once encountered something there—though we'll never know.

VisionDesc.SourceString:
由现代软枕转化而来的物体异象。无人使用时，不对周围产生影响。如有人使用该异象枕头睡着并入梦，则梦境会呈现为几个连续且怪异的房间。一旦有人使用该异象入梦，周围一定范围内的其他所有人都将持续做场景相同的梦，直到该异象被泯除。
大部分人会在梦中不受控地做出与周围人群相同的行为。经调研，该异象大致不影响睡眠质量。部分受访者表示，在梦里跟随人群做出相同行为后，醒来时心情会变得更轻松。
VisionDesc.LocalizedString:
An Object Anomaly transformed from the modern soft pillow. When unused, it does not affect the surrounding area. If someone falls asleep while using this anomalous pillow and enters the dream, the dream will manifest as several consecutive, bizarre "rooms". Once someone enters the dream through this Anomaly, other people within a certain radius will be drawn into the host's dreams until the Anomaly undergoes Nullification.
Most people will unconsciously perform the same actions as those around them in the dream. According to investigations, this Anomaly does not generally affect sleep quality. Some respondents stated that, after following the crowd and performing the same actions in the dream, they actually felt more relaxed upon waking.

大部分人会在梦中不受控地做出与周围人群相同的行为。经调研，该异象大致不影响睡眠质量。部分受访者表示，在梦里跟随人群做出相同行为后，醒来时心情会变得更轻松。
少部分人则表示，他们在梦中清醒过来并主动离开了人群，随后立刻从梦中醒来，并且在异象被泯除前再也无法入梦。
枕头使用者离开梦中的房间后，该异象的影响会自动解除。离开梦中房间的使用者，无法再次使用该异象入梦。
VisionDesc.LocalizedString:
An Object Anomaly transformed from the modern soft pillow. When unused, it does not affect the surrounding area. If someone falls asleep while using this anomalous pillow and enters the dream, the dream will manifest as several consecutive, bizarre "rooms". Once someone enters the dream through this Anomaly, other people within a certain radius will be drawn into the host's dreams until the Anomaly undergoes Nullification.
Most people will unconsciously perform the same actions as those around them in the dream. According to investigations, this Anomaly does not generally affect sleep quality. Content.SourceString:
枕头？我老妈从二手市场淘来的。不要用这种眼神看我，我是拿它睡了一觉才知道它是二手的。老妈被摊主骗了，说用这个枕头睡觉能安神、增强记忆力、稳定情绪，她居然全信了。
我很讨厌这个枕头让我做的梦，好不容易不用上学了，还让我坐到教室里。幸好出口不算难找，在梦里走出去之后就不会再回来了。
我知道你想问什么。头顶那些怪物都笨笨的，稍微动点脑筋就能躲开了。
虽然让我讨厌，但这个异象本身很值得深究。社会的规训化作有形的监视者，而在人们的集体潜意识中，监视者以怪物的形象示人。诞生于人类社会的集体共识竟不再是人类吗？我们害怕逾越规则，因此将自己完全托付于规则的框架内，让这个坚不可摧的框架保护我们，以自主选择权的丧失来逃避个人的责任……
Content.LocalizedString:
The pillow? My mom snagged it from a secondhand market for me. Don't look at me like that—I only found out it was used after I had already slept on it. Some stall owner spun a story to my mom, saying this pillow was able to alleviate stress, boost your memory, and make you feel calmer, and she actually believed all of it.
I hate the dreams this pillow gives me. I finally get a break from school, and yet, almost every night, it dumps me into a classroom. Luckily, the exit isn't hard to find. Once you leave the room in the dream, you won't return.
I know what you're going to ask. Those monsters above my head are dumb as rocks. Use your brain, and they're easy to dodge.
I hate it, sure, but the Anomaly itself is pretty interesting. In people's collective unconscious, civic discipline manifests as a monster. How can a shared consensus born from human society somehow no longer be human? We're afraid of breaking the rules, so we hand ourselves over completely to some amorphous framework, with the belief it'd protect us and let us escape personal responsibility, at the cost of our free will…

Sign.SourceString:
--丽雅
抽风猫奶茶店员工

Content.SourceString:
这里是别人的梦，但我进去的时候没有敲门。这里没有门。梦的主人邀请我进去作客。
我看到人们在生死的夹缝里跋涉，他们的脑袋里抽出黑线，黑色的线团升上天空织出黑色的神明。神明注视着一片片潮水，在潮水里人们走上岸又走向另一个岸，然后落下海流，又回到最初的岸。没有人敢走向其他的方向，因为这是一座岛，四处都是岸，你总有一天要回到海里去，向别处走只是白费力气。我们总有一天要回到海里去。我们为什么要向别处走？我们当初为什么要上岸？
为什么啊，伊洛——
（记录中断）
这个异象产生影响后，周围的人都会被拖入同样的梦境，但那些人的梦并没有链接在一起。梦里的面孔并非做梦的彼此，他们只是这个枕头最初的主人留下的幻影。这个枕头，应该是受到最初主人思绪的影响，才成为的异象，因此那些幻影来自最初主人的回忆。
这是我目前能掌握的信息，记录结束。
Content.LocalizedString:
This is someone else's dream, yet I didn't knock before entering. There's no real door here, however. The dream's host themself actually invited me in as a guest.
I saw people trudging through the gap between life and death. Black threads were spun from their heads, tangling into one black mass in the sky: a god. The god monitors the tides, in which people swam from shore to shore, in a torturous cycle, forever lost. No one dared deviate from the group, and all headed in the same direction. One day, everyone will have to return to the sea. Attempting to go elsewhere was simply wasted effort. Why go anywhere else? Why come ashore in the first place?
Iroi—
(Recording interrupted)
After this Anomaly takes effect, anyone nearby is dragged into the same dream, though their dreams are not linked together. The faces in the dream are not of the dreamers themselves. Instead, they are merely phantoms left behind by the pillow's original owner—likely a byproduct from the influence of the original owner's thoughts.
This is all the information I have for now. Signing off.

Sign.SourceString:
--奥涅伊洛伊
异象管理局

DisplayText.SourceString: 「无忧枕」能够让使用者及其周围人做一个同样的梦，唯有使用者主动离开这个梦境，异象的影响才会被解除。我认为，需要对受到该异象影响的人们进行深入的心理测评，以评估该异象对人们心理健康状况的影响。
DisplayText.LocalizedString: The Dreamaway Pillow causes the user and those around them to share dreams. The Anomaly's effects are lifted only when a user voluntarily exits the dream. I believe everyone affected by this Anomaly should undergo a thorough psychological evaluation to assess the pillow's impact on their mental state.

DisplayText.SourceString: 「无忧枕」能够让使用者及其周围人做一个同样的梦，唯有使用者主动离开这个梦境，异象的影响才会被解除。随波逐流固然带来安逸，但这真的是正确的吗？我们要如何判断自己是否盲从？
DisplayText.LocalizedString: The Dreamaway Pillow causes the user and those around them to share dreams. The Anomaly's effects are lifted only when a user voluntarily exits the dream. Going with the flow may feel comfortable, but is it truly the best way to live? How do we know whether we're paving our own path, or just following the herd?

DisplayText.SourceString: 「无忧枕」能够让使用者及其周围人做一个同样的梦，唯有使用者主动离开这个梦境，异象的影响才会被解除。假如世上人人都不平庸，世界会是什么样？假如人人不平庸，恐怕「平庸」的定义又要被重构了。
DisplayText.LocalizedString: The Dreamaway Pillow causes the user and those around them to share dreams. The Anomaly's effects are lifted only when a user voluntarily exits the dream. If no one in the world were mediocre, what would that world look like? If everyone were truly average, the very idea of "mediocrity" would probably need to be redefined.

VisionDesc.SourceString:
"趣奇诡乐屋异象位于噗卡乐园内，通常情况下被认定为无害，仅表现为一种持续处在「营业」状态的室内游乐项目。据已知信息推测，该异象原为噗卡集团施工未完成的乐园项目，停滞期间演变为地点异象。其外部仍然维持原貌，是一间状似蝙蝠展翅的深色小屋，但内部却是一座幽深古堡，与现实建筑结构并不相符。
人在进入趣奇诡乐屋之前，几乎不会感受到任何波动，但一旦进入，就会被趣奇诡乐屋自动识别为「游客」，从而开启营业状态，进入者需要支付方斯、领取道具、遵守规则，方有顺利离开的机会。当然，趣奇诡乐屋本身及空间内衍生出来的「鬼管家」对游客并无敌意，尽管它们会主动追逐游客，却不会表现出真正的攻击意图，反而像是尽职尽责的演员一般，希望游客和它们能共同经历一场精彩的游玩之旅。
当游客顺利离开后，趣奇诡乐屋会陷入暂时的休眠状态，直到新的「游客」到来，趣奇诡乐屋将重新活性化。"
VisionDesc.LocalizedString:
Located within Pukaland, the Spooky Cookies Anomaly is generally considered harmless, manifesting only as an indoor haunted house attraction that remains perpetually "open for business." Based on what we know, this Anomaly is believed to have originally been an unfinished Puka Group amusement-park project that developed into a Location Anomaly while construction was stalled. Its exterior still retains its original form—a small dark house shaped like a bat with spread wings—but inside is a deep medieval castle-like space that does not match the outside structure of the building itself.
Before entering Spooky Cookies, people will rarely sense any unusual fluctuations. Once inside, however, they are automatically identified by Spooky Cookies as "visitors," which triggers its operating state. To have any chance of leaving safely, entrants must pay Fons, collect a few items, and follow the stated rules. Naturally, Spooky Cookies itself and the "Ghost Butler" entities that emerge within it are not hostile toward visitors. Although they actively pursue visitors, they show no real intent to attack. Instead, they resemble dedicated haunted house actors to enhance each visitor's experience.
After a visitor leaves safely, Spooky Cookies enters a temporary dormant state. It will not reactivate until a new "visitor" arrives.

趣奇诡乐屋内需遵守的具体规则为：首先，支付方斯后方可进入，领取手电筒工具，可用于照明、探测、爆闪。其次，游玩期间需要寻找钥匙，躲避形态各异的「鬼管家」追逐，并在集齐钥匙后击败「伯爵先生」，方能顺利离开。「伯爵先生」与「鬼管家」均疑似过去设计师和施工者的意志残留，似乎分外致力于维持过程中的趣味性，并乐在其中。最后，游客离开后，还会依据过程表现获得相应奖励，疑似「伯爵先生」为吸引回头客的妙计。
趣奇诡乐屋的营业表现出近乎执著的完整性，因其稳定无害，被认为是噗卡乐园独特的游玩体验项目。"
VisionDesc.LocalizedString:
Located within Pukaland, the Spooky Cookies Anomaly is generally considered harmless, manifesting only as an indoor haunted house attraction that remains perpetually "open for business." Based on what we know, this Anomaly is believed to have originally been an unfinished Puka Group amusement-park project that developed into a Location Anomaly while construction was stalled. Its exterior still retains its original form—a small dark house shaped like a bat with spread wings—but inside is a deep medieval castle-like space that does not match the outside structure of the real building.
Before entering Spooky Cookies, people will rarely sense any unusual fluctuations. Once inside, however, they are automatically identified by Spooky Cookies as "visitors," which triggers its operating state. To have any chance of leaving safely, entrants must pay a set amount of Fons, collect a few items, and follow the stated rules. Naturally, Spooky Cookies itself and the "Ghost Butler" entities that emerge within it are not hostile toward visitors. Although they actively pursue visitors, they show no real intent to attack. Instead, they resemble dedicated haunted house actors to enhance each visitor's experience.
After a visitor leaves safely, Spooky Cookies enters a temporary dormant state. It will not reactivate until a new "visitor" arrives.
The specific rules to be observed inside Spooky Cookies are as follows: First, entry is permitted only after paying Fons. Visitors then receive a flashlight. Second, during the attraction, visitors must search for keys, evade pursuit from the many different forms of the "Ghost Butler," and, once all keys have been collected, defeat "The Count" in order to leave successfully. Both "The Count" and the "Ghost Butler" are suspected to be remnants of the will of former designers and construction workers. They seem especially devoted to preserving the fun of the experience—and genuinely enjoy doing so. Finally, after leaving, visitors will receive rewards based on their performance—supposedly one of "The Count's" many clever ploys to attract repeat customers.
Spooky Cookies operates with an almost obsessive level of perfectionism. Because it is otherwise stable and harmless, Spooky Cookies is regarded as one of Pukaland's unique attractions.

Content.SourceString:
"最早发现不对劲的是我们一起负责乐园翻新的同事，他总跟我说趣奇诡乐屋晚上一直有灯亮着，还有奇怪的声音，但那项目停工好久了，谁知道是不是他喝多了自己吓自己~他看我不信，非要和我打赌，我们就在一天收工后去探了探，结果的那本打不开门！我跟他争论了几句，结果门又突然开了？？（事后我才发现是我们争论的时候我钱包掉了，这么大一间屋子竟然看上了我那几个破方斯吗？）
趣奇诡乐屋里面根本不是它当时停工时的样子！它变成一间深深的古堡，我们吓坏了，根本不知道该怎么出去，好在没走两步就拿到一支手电筒。本来想回去的，但门早就打不开了，只能硬着头皮往前。
期间我和我的同事还走散了，他胆子很小，不知道是不是吓晕在哪躲起来了，里面实在是太黑了，我的手电筒电量又一直在掉，根本找不到他，只能硬着头皮往前走。路上还碰到了好多鬼，不知道到底是什么可是看起来就很像鬼啊！！！但好像我用手电筒一照它好像就走了，也可能是刚刚它黑我看花眼了？
天呢我本来一直在怀疑是我看花眼了，直到我看见一只吸血鬼才知道这都是真的！我好像误入什么异象空间了……那吸血鬼自称「伯爵先生」，说我只要打败他就可以离开。我看他一直在那桀桀桀地笑，对我也没什么恶意就照做了，没想到真的逃出生天！！
我在趣奇诡乐屋门口找到了我的同事，他说他一睁眼就在外面了完全不知道发生了什么，根本不相信我经历的一切！直到我上报给了异象管理局，趣奇诡乐屋被定性为异象之后，他才不敢再跟我争论，因为他知道我说的全是真的！！"
Content.LocalizedString:
The first one to notice something was off was a coworker of mine who was helping renovate the amusement park. He kept telling me Spooky Cookies had its lights on at night, with weird noises coming from the inside. That project had been shut down for ages, though, so how was I supposed to know he wasn't just drunk and freaking himself out! When he saw I didn't believe a word he said, he insisted on making a bet, so after work one day, we went to check it out. Once we got there, the door just wouldn't open! I argued with him for a bit, but then the door opened suddenly. (I only realized later that I'd dropped my wallet while we were arguing. Was the thing really after my lousy few Fons?)
Spooky Cookies looked nothing like it had when the project was shut down! It had turned into this huge medieval castle. We were scared out of our minds and had no idea how to get out. Luckily, we found a flashlight pretty quickly. We wanted to go back, but the door wouldn't budge, so we had no choice but to keep going.
At some point my coworker and I got separated. He's a total scaredy-cat, so who knows—maybe he passed out somewhere and hid. It was way too dark in there, and my flashlight battery kept draining, so there was no way to find him. I just had to keep pushing forward. I also ran into a whole bunch of ghosts on the way. I don't know what the things actually were, but they sure looked like ghosts!!! Whenever I shined my flashlight on them, they seemed to back off. Maybe I was just seeing things after all?
God, I kept thinking that maybe I was imagining the whole thing, but the second I saw a vampire, I knew deep in my bones that everything was real! I think I accidentally wandered into an Anomalous Realm… That vampire called himself "The Count" and claimed that if I beat him, I could leave. He kept standing there doing that creepy "heh-heh-heh" laugh, but he didn't seem to actually have any malice toward me, so I went along with it. I never thought I'd actually make it out alive!!
Thankfully, I found my coworker outside Spooky Cookies. He said the moment he opened his eyes, he was already outside and had no idea what had happened. He totally refused to believe anything I said! It wasn't until I reported it to the Bureau and Spooky Cookies was officially classified as an Anomaly that he finally stopped arguing with me!!

Content.SourceString:
"噢！你也喜欢逛那个鬼屋吗！那我们就是同好了——
诶？只是采访调查？好吧……
第一次去那座趣奇诡乐屋的时候，还是爸爸带我来的，说是想找一些灵感，但我们撞见管家爷爷之后，爸爸就说想上厕所提前出去了，我就一个人在里面玩了很久……你说管家爷爷？就是那个很和善的老爷爷啊，他和我聊了好久，是个很和善好客的人……噢，抱歉，应该是鬼。
那个伯爵大叔虽然笑声很难听，其实性格也还挺好的。以前我来玩的时候，他看我年纪小，每次都用石头剪刀布和我决胜负，然后就放着我不管了。等我加入E.T.D，带着小贞再来的时候，就变成和他对打……不过他的招式很好记，我和小贞每次来都会刷新一次速通记录~
嗯？噢，你说小贞啊……她似乎还挺排斥来这里的，因为管家爷爷和伯爵都叫她「小幽灵」，她觉得作为恶灵很没面子。我对他们说，小贞是海特洛最强最可爱的恶灵，管家爷爷直咳嗽，伯爵大叔一遍道歉一遍笑得超大声，然后小贞就不是很愿意来这里了……现在每次见到他们俩，小贞都会躲在电视里不出来。
趣奇诡乐屋的电波？嗯……要说的话，就像是吱吱呀呀、声音有些失真的老唱片？如果没有人去的话，它的旋律还会变得有些寂寞……哦对！我还在鬼屋里感受到过一个很奇妙、和它风格完全不同的电波，听上去很明亮、开朗，像是一整支交响乐团的乐器一起大笑，听着就让人很愉快，但我不知道来源是谁……我和管家爷爷、伯爵大叔都聊起过，他们看上去很惊讶，互相使了好久眼色，最后神神秘秘的，只说是一位身份特殊、偶尔会来造访的「老朋友」，还让我替他保密，真奇怪……他会是谁呢？"
Content.LocalizedString:
Oh! You like that haunted house too? Then we're really on the same wavelength—
Huh? This is just an interview? Okay…
The first time I went to Spooky Cookies, my dad brought me. He said he wanted to find some inspiration, but after we ran into Grandpa Butler, he said he had to use the bathroom and left early, so I stayed in there playing by myself for a long time… Who's Grandpa Butler? He's a really kind old man. He talked with me for ages, and was super kind and welcoming… Oh, sorry, I suppose I should say "ghost".
The Count's laugh sounds awful, but he's actually pretty nice too. Back when I used to come here, he'd see I was still little, so every time we'd settle it with rock-paper-scissors and then he'd just leave me alone. After I joined ETD and came back with Xiaozhen, though, it was no longer just rock-paper-scissors. Instead, I had to go toe-to-toe with him… But his moves are easy to remember, so Xiaozhen and I break our speedrun record every time we return~
Hm? Oh, Xiaozhen… She really doesn't like coming here, because Grandpa Butler and the Count both call her "little ghost," and she finds that super embarrassing. I told them that Xiaozhen is the strongest, cutest ghost in all of Hethereau, and Grandpa Butler started coughing up a storm while the Count kept apologizing and laughing super loud, so after that Xiaozhen wasn't interested in coming back… Now whenever she sees those two, she hides in the TV and won't come out.
Spooky Cookies' frequency? Hmm… If I had to describe it, it's like an old record, all squeaky and a little warped. If nobody goes there, its melody even starts to sound kind of desolate… Oh, right! I've also noticed a really strange frequency in Spooky Cookies before, totally different from the norm. It sounded bright and cheerful, like every instrument in an entire symphony joyously harmonizing. Just hearing one note filled you with giddiness, but I have no idea where it came from… I asked Grandpa Butler and the Count about it before, and they both looked genuinely surprised. They kept exchanging looks for a while, and in the end they got all cryptic and would only say it was an old special "friend" of theirs who stops by once in a blue moon. They even told me to keep the whole thing hush-hush. So weird… I wonder who it could be?

Sign.SourceString: 灵可——异象管理局禁制机动队（E.T.D）六队
Sign.LocalizedString: Linko — Bureau of Anomaly Control ETD-6

DisplayText.SourceString:
"「趣奇诡乐屋」会自动表现为营业状态的游乐项目，需要消耗方斯进入，期间通过躲避「鬼管家」、搜集钥匙、打败「伯爵先生」可顺利离开，另外需要留意手电筒电量和自身受惊吓状态。成功离开后趣奇诡乐屋会陷入暂时的沉寂，但似乎仍然在等待着下一个人的到来。
海特洛一定不存在比趣奇诡乐屋还有趣的异象空间！也不存在比趣奇诡乐屋还吓人的鬼屋！"
DisplayText.LocalizedString:
Spooky Cookies is an Anomalous Realm that automatically shows up as an attraction that's open for business and costs Fons to enter. Once inside, you can exit safely by dodging the Ghost Butler, collecting keys, and beating the Count. You also need to keep an eye on your flashlight battery and your sanity. Once you clear it, Spooky Cookies goes quiet, as if lying in wait for its next victim.
There can't be a more fun Anomalous Realm in Hethereau than Spooky Cookies! And there's definitely not a scarier haunted house in existence!

VisionDesc.SourceString:
"「歧路巡游」最初只是一辆平平无奇的公交车。它的主人生前是一位负责接送乘客的公交车司机。这里使用「生前」这个字眼，是因为该司机曾在一次意外事件中失踪，在数年搜寻无果后，警方最终只好判定为死亡。司机生前会按照交通公司规定的路线接送不同的乘客。意外发生在下班后驾车返回总站时，本应该由司机驾驶的公交车却空无一人地回来了。该车不具备任何自动驾驶的功能，司机本人也去向不明。
每逢大雾的日子，「歧路巡游」会沿着司机原本的路线运行，在路过不同站台时将乘客接上车。不过这次接送的不再是普通的乘客们，而是各种各样的异象。
「歧路巡游」似乎对低级异象有一种特殊的吸引力，像是捕蝇草般吸引着低级异象进入其中。公交车内部有压抑异象能力的作用，可以将异象困在其中。因此该公交车在某种程度上可以当作押运低级异象的工具。
如果不对行驶路线加以干涉，公交车会在路线终点处消失，进入一个无法探测的异象空间。那些作为乘客的异象也会连带着一起消失，如同那位消失的司机一样。

"
VisionDesc.LocalizedString:
The "Wayward Line" was originally nothing more than an ordinary bus. Initially, its owner, while still alive, was a bus driver responsible for transporting passengers. The term "while still alive" is used in this context since the driver disappeared in an accident, and after years of fruitless searching, the police were ultimately forced to declare him dead. During his lifetime, the driver transported various passengers along the routes designated by the transit company. The accident occurred when he was driving back to the terminal after finishing his routes for the day. The bus, which should have naturally been driven by the driver, surprisingly returned empty. The vehicle had no autonomous driving functions, yet the driver himself was nowhere to be found.
On days of heavy fog, the "Wayward Line" runs along the driver's original route, picking up passengers at various stops all the while. Nowadays, however, it no longer carries ordinary passengers, but instead all kinds of Anomalies.
The "Wayward Line" appears to have a unique pull on Low Threat Anomalies, drawing them inside akin to a Venus flytrap. The bus's interior can suppress Anomaly abilities, therefore trapping any Anomalies who enter. To some extent, then, the vehicle can be used to transport Low Threat Anomalies under containment.
As long as its route is not interfered with, the bus will disappear at its last stop, Terminal Station, and enter an undetectable Anomalous Realm. The Anomalies riding as passengers disappear along with it, just like that missing driver so long ago.

HouseCondition.LocalizedString: Monitor Anomaly Passengers

AnnihilateCondition.SourceString: 在没有乘客逃离的情况下，将异象送回收容
AnnihilateCondition.LocalizedString: Return the Anomaly to containment without allowing any passengers to escape.

VisionDesc.SourceString:
"「歧路巡游」最初只是一辆平平无奇的公交车。它的主人生前是一位负责接送乘客的公交车司机。这里使用「生前」这个字眼，是因为该司机曾在一次意外事件中失踪，在数年搜寻无果后，警方最终只好判定为死亡。司机生前会按照交通公司规定的路线接送不同的乘客。意外发生在下班后驾车返回总站时，本应该由司机驾驶的公交车却空无一人地回来了。该车不具备任何自动驾驶的功能，司机本人也去向不明。
每逢大雾的日子，「歧路巡游」会沿着司机原本的路线运行，在路过不同站台时将乘客接上车。不过这次接送的不再是普通的乘客们，而是各种各样的异象。
「歧路巡游」似乎对低级异象有一种特殊的吸引力，像是捕蝇草般吸引着低级异象进入其中。公交车内部有压抑异象能力的作用，可以将异象困在其中。因此该公交车在某种程度上可以当作押运低级异象的工具。
如果不对行驶路线加以干涉，公交车会在路线终点处消失，进入一个无法探测的异象空间。那些作为乘客的异象也会连带着一起消失，如同那位消失的司机一样。
如果将异象的行为拆开来看，很难不认为该异象具有类似生命体的智能。将低级歧骸作为乘客载入车内，并且运送到某一独特的异象空间内，可近似地看作生物的捕食行为。
但因此而将异象归类为生物类异象显然是不够严谨的。「歧路巡游」的行为并非一种自主行为。例如可以通过人为的手段来控制车辆，甚至偏离原本路线，而不会遭受任何来自于异象本身的阻挠。用更好理解的话来说，「歧路巡游」的行为更像是被设定好的程序，而非一种自发性的主动行为。
对此有两个推断：要么在异能的某种作用下，异象「记住」了司机的生前习惯和记忆。要么是该异象本身被其他人做过某种手脚，如同植入了代码般让其按照既定程序运行。
综合考虑后，认为前者的可能性更高一些。异象管理局已介入相关事件的调查当中。"
VisionDesc.LocalizedString:
The "Wayward Line" was originally nothing more than an ordinary bus. Initially, its owner, while still alive, was a bus driver responsible for transporting passengers. The term "while still alive" is used in this context since the driver disappeared in an accident, and after years of fruitless searching, the police were ultimately forced to declare him dead. During his lifetime, the driver transported various passengers along the routes designated by the transit company. The accident occurred when he was driving back to the terminal after finishing his routes for the day. The bus, which should have naturally been driven by the driver, surprisingly returned empty. The vehicle had no autonomous driving functions, yet the driver himself was nowhere to be found.
On days of heavy fog, the "Wayward Line" runs along the driver's original route, picking up passengers at various stops all the while. Nowadays, however, it no longer carries ordinary passengers, but instead all kinds of Anomalies.
The "Wayward Line" appears to have a unique pull on Low Threat Anomalies, drawing them inside akin to a Venus flytrap. The bus's interior can suppress Anomaly abilities, therefore trapping any Anomalies who enter. To some extent, then, the vehicle can be used to transport Low Threat Anomalies under containment.
As long as its route is not interfered with, the bus will disappear at its last stop, Terminal Station, and enter an undetectable Anomalous Realm. The Anomalies riding as passengers disappear along with it, just like that missing driver so long ago.
When the Anomaly's behavior is analyzed thoroughly, it is difficult not to conclude that it possesses intelligence resembling that of a living organism. Loading Low Threat Oddities into the vehicle as Passengers and transporting them to a unique Anomalous Realm can be roughly compared to predatory behavior in living organisms.
However, classifying the Anomaly as a Bio Anomaly on this basis would clearly be insufficient. The "Wayward Line" does not act autonomously. For example, the vehicle can be controlled by human means—and even diverted from its original route—without encountering any resistance from the Anomaly itself. Put simply, the "Wayward Line" behaves more like a preset program than an autonomous behavior.
There are two possible explanations: either, through some effect of an Esper Ability, the Anomaly "remembered" the driver's habits and memories from while he was alive, or someone tampered with the Anomaly itself, implanting something like "code" that made it operate according to a predetermined program.
After considering all the factors, the former possibility is considered more likely. The Bureau has intervened in the investigation of this incident.

Content.SourceString:
"海特洛交通提醒您，为了您以及其他乘客的乘车体验，请遵守《海特洛公交车守则》：
1.为避免浓雾弥散进车内，车辆行驶过程中门窗将会自动紧锁。请勿将头或肢体伸出窗外。若不小心吸入浓雾，请及时向乘务员汇报。
2.车辆行驶过程中不会因为任何原因停车，只有到下一站时才会停车。该班次仅允许上车，不能在除终点站以外的其他站台下车。
3.请勿在行驶过程中干扰司机驾驶。如若司机被打扰影响正常驾驶，那么司机可以使用任何手段来保护自己和确保汽车正常行驶。
4.每周一、三、五请从前车门上车，周二、四及周六、日请从后车门上车。请乘客严格遵守，切勿随意上车。
5.单数排座位每排只允许坐一位乘客，双数排座位可以坐满。如果无可用空位，请抓好扶手，避免摔伤。
6.如果有其他乘客向您搭话，请用「是」或「不是」回答。禁止除此以外的其他方式进行回答。同样，您在向其他乘客提问时，请将话语控制在三句以内，避免打扰司机。
7.路线全程一小时三十七分钟，如果您佩戴有任何可以显示时间的设备，请与汽车上的时钟进行同步校准。并在每分钟的第42秒高高举起手臂一次，确保您没有睡着。
如果有任何问题，请联系我们：■■■■■■
"
Content.LocalizedString:
Hethereau Transit reminds you: For your comfort and that of other passengers, please comply with the Hethereau Bus Code:
1. To prevent dense fog from entering the vehicle, all doors and windows will lock automatically while the vehicle is in motion. Do not stick your head or any body parts out of the windows. If you accidentally inhale the fog, please report it to a bus attendant immediately.
2. The vehicle will not stop for any reason while in motion. It will stop only at the next station. This service is for boarding only; passengers may not get off at any stop other than the Terminal Station.
3. Do not interfere with the driver while the vehicle is in motion. If the driver is disturbed and their ability to drive safely is affected, the driver may use any means to protect themselves and ensure the vehicle continues operating normally.
4. On Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays, please board through the front door. On Tuesdays, Thursdays, Saturdays, and Sundays, please board through the rear door. Passengers must comply strictly. Do not board through the wrong door at any time.
5. Only one passenger may occupy each odd-numbered row. Even-numbered rows may be filled to capacity. If no seats are available, hold on to the handrails to avoid injury.
6. If another passenger speaks to you, answer only with "Yes" or "No." All other forms of response are prohibited. Likewise, when speaking to another passenger, limit yourself to no more than three sentences to avoid disturbing the driver.
7. The full route takes one hour and thirty-seven minutes. If you are wearing any device that displays the time, synchronize it with the time displayed on the vehicle. Once every minute, raise your arm high at the 42-second mark to ensure that you have not fallen asleep.
If you have any questions, please contact us: ■■■■■■

Sign.SourceString: 公交内张贴的《海特洛公交车守则》（官方宣称为他人伪造，非官方撰写）
Sign.LocalizedString: "Hethereau Bus Code" posted inside the bus (officially claimed to be forged by an unaffiliated party; not officially authored)

Content.SourceString:
"1104-RC录音：观众朋友们大家好！我是喜欢灵异探险的大岚！今天和几个好哥们一起，来看看网上很火的「幽灵公交车」事件！我们现在已经到了传闻中的137号路线的其中一个站台。接下来会发生什么呢？让我们拭目以待！别忘了点赞、分享、关注！
1105-RC录音：
「欸来了来了！真来了！」
「居然是真的？！」
「喂，我们不会真的要上去吧？」
「到这了你开始怕了？快走快走。」
1107-RC录音：
「观众朋友们，我们真的坐上这班公交车了。我得小声点，你们看……喏，刚才上来几个乘客，看着不像人类。」
「是异象吧？传闻中这个公交车专门接异象的。」
「那几个木头人就是异象么？看起来有点吓人。」
1108-RC录音：
「喂，岚哥。下一站我们就下车吧？」
「啊？为什么？你们不坐到终点站吗？」
「不……不是说坐到终点站的人和异象都会消失吗？」
「所以我们才要坐到终点站看看到底怎么回事啊？真是的，怎么你也害怕了。算了算了，你们愿意下就下吧。我要坐到终点站。」
1110-RC录音：
「好……现在我的那俩哥们都已经胆小下车了。而我……稍等，我看一下表……还有五分钟就要进终点站了。我倒要看看终点站到底是什么样子，会不会真像传闻中的那么邪乎。刚才……刚才又经过一个站台，上来了最后一波乘客。」
1111-RC录音：
「好的观众朋友们，我已经进站了。这里看起来……有点黑。那些木头人们都已经下车了，我现在还躲在车上。外面……外面好像有什么声音，等我探出头去看一下……」
「……」
「我看到了……那是■■……在闪烁■■■■」
「是■■！我看到了■■！■■■■■■」
「■■■■■■■■■■」
「…………」"
Content.LocalizedString:
1104-RC Recording: Hey, everyone! I'm Darren, and I'm really into paranormal adventures! Today, I'm here with a few buddies to check out the Ghost Bus everyone's been talking about online! We've made it to one of the stops on the rumored Route 137. What's going to happen next? Let's wait and see! Don't forget to Like, Share, and Follow!
1105-RC Recording:
"Hey, it's here! It's really here!"
"No way, it's real?!"
"Hey, are we seriously getting on this thing?"
"You're getting cold feet now? Come on, let's go."
1107-RC Recording:
"Hey, everyone, we're really on the bus. I'd better keep my voice down. Look there—some passengers just got on. They don't look human."
"They're Anomalies, right? I heard this bus specifically picks up Anomalies."
"So those Wooden Men are Anomalies? They're kind of creepy."
1108-RC Recording:
"Hey, Darren. Let's get off at the next stop, okay?"
"What? Why? Aren't you coming all the way to the Terminal Station?"
"No… Didn't you hear? They say anyone who rides to the Terminal Station disappears, along with the Anomalies."
"That's exactly why we're going to the Terminal Station—to see what's really going on! No way, seriously? You're getting scared? Fine, fine. Get off if you want. I'm going to the Terminal Station."
1110-RC Recording:
"Okay… My two buddies have already chickened out and gotten off. And me… Hang on, let me check the time… We're entering the Terminal Station in five minutes. I want to see what the Terminal Station is really like, and whether it's as creepy as the rumors say. Just now… We passed another stop, and the last group of passengers got on."
1111-RC Recording:
"Okay, everyone, I've made it to the Terminal Station. It looks… kind of dark. All those Wooden Men have finally gotten off. I'm still hiding on the bus. Outside… There's something out there, I think. I'm going to stick my head out and take a look…"
"…"
"I see something… It's ■■… flickering ■■■■"
"It's ■■! I can see ■■! ■■■■■■"
"■■■■■■■■■■"
"…………"

Sign.LocalizedString: Audio file extracted from an urban-legend vlogger's damaged recording device (video is damaged and unavailable for viewing)

DisplayText.SourceString: 对于「歧路巡游」本身的收容是成功的。公交车本身对低级歧骸有着异常的吸引能力，而一旦这些歧骸上车，便难以再逃脱。目前对于终点站的异象空间仍然一无所知。这辆车与其上的乘客们最终的去向如何可能会永远是一个谜团。异象管理局现已将「歧路巡游」异象收容。由异象管理局机械修理师布洛凯德进行改装后，可以作为收容低级异象的押送容器，执行歧骸押运任务。
DisplayText.LocalizedString: The Wayward Line itself has been successfully contained. The bus has an unusual pull on low-level Oddities, and once they board, escaping is incredibly difficult. At present, nothing is known about the Anomalous Realm beyond the Terminal Station. The ultimate fate of the bus and its passengers may remain a mystery forever. The Bureau has now contained the Wayward Line anomaly. After being modified by Barracuda, the Bureau mechanic, it can now serve as a transport container for Low Threat Anomalies and carry out Oddity escort missions.

DisplayText.SourceString: 对于「歧路巡游」本身的收容是成功的。公交车本身对低级歧骸有着异常的吸引能力，而一旦这些歧骸上车，便难以再逃脱。目前对于终点站的异象空间仍然一无所知。这辆车与其上的乘客们最终的去向如何可能会永远是一个谜团。对于终点站后的那个异象空间，贸然地派遣人员进行探查无疑是过于鲁莽的行为。或许可以尝试将低级歧骸作为诱饵，通过追踪的方式了解到那片未知且危险的异象空间。
DisplayText.LocalizedString: The Wayward Line itself has been successfully contained. The bus has an unusual pull on low-level Oddities, and once they board, escaping is incredibly difficult. At present, nothing is known about the Anomalous Realm beyond the Terminal Station. The ultimate fate of the bus and its passengers may remain a mystery forever. Sending personnel to investigate the Anomalous Realm beyond the Terminal Station without adequate preparation would be too reckless, without a doubt. Perhaps low-level Oddities could be used as bait, allowing us to track them and learn more about that unknown and dangerous realm.

DisplayText.SourceString: 对于「歧路巡游」本身的收容是成功的。公交车本身对低级歧骸有着异常的吸引能力，而一旦这些歧骸上车，便难以再逃脱。目前对于终点站的异象空间仍然一无所知。这辆车与其上的乘客们最终的去向如何可能会永远是一个谜团。有这么一种在网络上流传的说法：或许「歧路巡游」只是像是接送人类一样接送异象们下班。这些异象说不定也存在人类社会的结构，那么也就有加班的可能。这样的说法的确更加有趣，也更加可爱一些。
DisplayText.LocalizedString: The Wayward Line itself has been successfully contained. The bus has an unusual pull on low-level Oddities, and once they board, escaping is incredibly difficult. At present, nothing is known about the Anomalous Realm beyond the Terminal Station. The ultimate fate of the bus and its passengers may remain a mystery forever. One theory circulating online is that the Wayward Line simply gives Anomalies a ride home from work, much as it transports humans. Perhaps these Anomalies even have their own social structures modeled after human society, which would mean they might have to work overtime, too. It is certainly a more interesting—and somewhat more endearing—theory.
